title: Goo-Gone for your sensitive skin!
text:
I first became acquainted with these when nurses at my local hospital gave me some to remove the EKG pad adhesive from my skin. I have pretty sensitive skin that really dislikes adhesive, and if you've ever been to the hospital for anything and been hooked up to a heart monitor or received an EKG, you know the adhesive is pretty tenacious and only comes off with a lot of scrubbing and soap. With the MediSol wipes, you almost don't need to scrub at all, and the aloe is very soothing to irritated skin.

What makes this product even better becomes apparent if the adhesive pads were placed somewhere hairy, like men's chests, arms, or legs. No, it won't make EKG pad removal COMPLETELY painless, I don't think anything will, but if you wipe in the direction of the hair growth, toward the pad (and rubbing the adhesive and hair off of it), it's MUCH faster, and MUCH less painful, as my husband can attest. It'll still sting, but between this or just ripping it and a large swath of hair off in four or five places? Go with this. I'm serious. You don't want to do the latter. (Besides, if you just rip them off, then you'll have weird bare patches on your chest).

The wipes have a really pleasant citrus aroma just like Goo-Gone, and the oils wash off with a little soap and water.

Buy a box. Buy two and give one to your friend with a heart condition who gets EKGs all the time. They'll thank you, and you'll be glad you did.

title: Do you know the benefits of wearing essential oils as a locket? Read my review for great information about oils and lockets!
text:
Jaroma has put out a really nice Aromatherapy Essential Oil Diffuser Necklace Locket Pendant. It is a nice length on a 24 inch chain and comes with 6 washable pads. The chain itself is Hypo-allergenic and the pendant itself is a Jasmine Flower.

Do you know the benefits of Aromatherapy? Essential oil aromas stimulate the part of the brain that affects emotion, Inhaling essential oils can help you attain a pleasurable emotional balance. A balanced emotional state in turn can have a therapeutic effect on physical problems.

Wearing an oil diffuser locket will allow you to use direct inhalation which in turn gives you immediate relief in most cases. There are so many scents and each scent has a purpose. I have several scents for various reasons. I have peppermint to help with upset stomach. I have an ongoing problem with acid. It is also good for relieving headaches, joint pains, toothaches, and repel mosquitoes. So if you are out on your patio and the mosquitoes are thick, just put some Peppermint on one of your felt tabs and wear around your neck.
I sniff my locket and it calms my stomach.

I have eucalyptus to help with sinus and headaches. This is really good as I get almost instant relief.

Lavender will benefit you in keeping you calm. Having a stressful day at work or with the kids, 1-2 drops of a good Lavender Oil and you will keep calm and have a good day.

I could go on and on as there are so many essential oils. They are out there to help you with balancing, energizing, meditation, passion, purifying, relaxing, headaches, stress, digestive and stomach issues, sinus and colds, body aches and this is just to name a few.

It is also important that you do your research and purchase only 100% pure essential oils. Some of the oils that are not 100% are a waste of money and for me caused huge headaches.

In my first picture I am just showing you how pretty the locket itself is. The second picture shows you how the locket opens and you just slip the felt pad in your locket. The last picture shows you the various felt pads you can interchange with. Maybe you want to change your pad based on color or maybe you are like me and color code your pad to your essential oil. I have one pad for each of my different oils. The felt pads are easy to clean though. You just rinse them warm water and let them air dry.

I truly do like my locket. It is a nice length, looks good. It comes with 7 pads. It does not come with any essential oils, but you can buy them anywhere. I bough some of mine from Amazon and others from my local whole foods market. I would suggest you not invest a bunch of money into the essential oils till you find a brand you really like. Oils can be as cheap as $1.00 and some bottles are over $50.00. The higher the price does not make them the better one. I spent $4.95-$19.95 for my oils and have been pleased with them

I did receive my locket at a discounted rate for my unbiased, truthful and factual review. I felt this locket deserved a 5 star for numerous reasons.
#1 - The cost of the locket is reasonable. Some lockets are hundreds of dollars, and that is just not in my budget.
#2. The quality of the locket
#3. The looks - it looks amazing and I like the longer chain

I have a girlfriend who really likes essential oils, but she does not have a necklace. I like this product so much that I am going to purchase her one for her birthday. It is priced reasonably and if you have Prime it will be here within 2 days.

title: Prior IQ: 67. Current: 193
text:
It is incredible. What more can I say? Prior to taking this I had an IQ of 67. In fact, this was so low that I wasn't even capable of dressing myself, much less telling you my IQ (I had to review previous documentation by my care taker which I recently fired as her services are now useless).

My only concern (should this be a concern at all) is that my intelligence is steadily increasing. When I first encroached on an IQ of 140, I felt superb. I anticipated diminishing returns... a sort of welcome plateau if you will. Why would anyone wish to be smarter?

But now I scratch at an IQ of 200 which, until now, was thought impossible. I am hardly able to relate to the general population. I now find human trifles and emotions agitating. This product has given a sort of clarity that can't be defined with mere words alone.

All is but a spiral within countless spirals, and time is most definitely not linear. We are utterly alone, but we are not at all. We are most vulnerable but we are infinite. We are an illusion but, in a sense, we are a certainty.

title: Revised review….It last less then 2 years!
text:
Revised: The chair lasted less then two years.
Now it’s either repairable or a large brick. Nice while it lasted. I’ve had this chair for over 8 months. I did a lot of research before making this purchase on chairs in this price range. This chair comes in a large box. The foot rest is attached with a stationary pin and a pin that’s on a spring. You also connect two small air tubes and an electric connection. It took me less then 5 minutes to put together. ( it’s not difficult at all). Connect the remote and power cord and your ready to go.

This chair has a LSS track which means the rollers go all the under your butt checks! This feels incredible. There is rolling, tapping, kneading, and other motions. There are 5 auto modes and I love the “Extend” program as it compresses your calves and the foot rest raises and lowers to stretch out those muscles. The foot rollers are strong! I wear thick socks for the first few weeks, but I have gotten used to it. The heat is therapeutic, but you would definitely never get burned and it does not get as hot as a heating pad.

Some have said it does not do the neck and shoulder blades well. The auto programs don’t seem to hit those areas; just hit the Manuel button and up button and it will hit your neck and shoulder blades perfectly! I was also surprised by the Bluetooth speakers, they are pretty good to play relaxing music or a meditation beat.

If you have arthritis, neck or back problems, this is the chair for you. Sore after working out or doing yard work? This will take care of it and get you back up and running.

If you like your neck and shoulder blades rubbed hardier, just flip the pillow back and it will really go to town. This chair seems very well made and I’m hopeful it will last a long time! There are also air bags on your upper shoulders, places to skip both arms into, calf area airbags. If this is your budget for a chair I don’t think you can do any better. My neck pain is reduced and no more restless legs at night. You will sleep like a baby! Just do it!

text:
Nicely made. The knot is very tight, and the handle really fits well in your hand. Love how it lathers.

However, I am sorry to report that this very brush, which I was to use as my primary, as been relegated to the travel bag because of one major problem. I originally purchased this to replace my primary shaving brush, and was greatly looking forward to it, despite Amazon's assertion that this brush will fit the immensely popular and highly rated Perfecto Deluxe Chrome Razor and Brush Stand [http://www.amazon.com/Perfecto-Deluxe-Chrome-Razor-Brush/dp/B00KO46CTA/ref=pd_sim_121_1?ie=UTF8&refRID=1F1ZDAXA2PVTWA4JYKG7&dpSrc=sims&dpST=_AC_UL160_SR116%2C160_], it does NOT. The neck is far too wide to fit in the slot. So basically you are stuck with one of three options: Lay it on its side each time after use - not ideal, stand it on its cap - DEFINITELY not ideal, or return it - which in my case, I am pretty torn about doing.

Having said that, you may or may not consider this a big deal. But it does give one pause to reflect whether any of the other available holders will work. If you can get past that, you have yourself one hell of a brush!!

title: SIZE MATTERS!
text:
Make sure you get a mask that fits right! They have instructions on their website for how to measure your face and select the proper size.

Pros:
•Looks nice
•Soft
•Comfortable against skin
•Doesn’t dig into ears (if properly fitted)
•Doesn’t fog glasses (if metal nose piece is squeezed to fit the nose snugly)
•Comes in 4 sizes (I ordered medium+)

Cons:
•Hot - my face sweats a lot while wearing this
•Hard to breath - forget talking because it uses too much air and fills the mask with hot air, which makes it difficult to breath, but if you breath slowly and don’t do any physical tasks that get your breathing up (like brisk walking or climbing stairs) then you should be fine (not for severe asthma or COPD patients!).
•Due to the material used for the straps, it seem like they might stretch out quickly over time, which could potentially cause the mask not to fit right.

Reason for buying & full review:
I have been trying to get a mask since before covid started because I have medical issues that make me extremely susceptible to illness. I mainly wanted protection for when I go out in public. I’ve heard good things about VogMask from some of my friends who also have medical issues, so that’s why I chose this brand.

Overall, this is a decent mask. It definitely looks nice and I hope they come out with even more prints and colors. If you get claustrophobic or have severe asthma, I don’t recommend you get this type because it can get hard to breath sometimes. The mask in the picture is also not the mask they sent me, instead I received one with black trim and black vents, which was a little disappointing. Their mistake with sending the wrong mask doesn’t impact the efficiency of the mask, of course, so I am going to keep it instead of sending it back because I am high risk and need some sort of protection. If I send it back, I’ll be without a mask and I’m not risking my life over the color of a mask.

-Do I recommend this mask for people with medical issues?
Yes (depending on the issue). I feel this will give a lot of protection against illness, pollens, and other inhalants. I just wouldn’t recommend it for people with severe breathing issues.

-Do I recommend this mask for use against covid?
Yes. It’s much better than using a plain cloth mask like the ones you can find on Etsy or made from a tshirt. But I think you should buy the VogMask without the filters instead because the valves on this mask don’t filter the air you exhale, which means while the mask may protect you, you could be spreading covid to others around you.

***I also recommend buying the head strap if you have issue with masks pulling on your ears.***

title: I so wanted to love this...
text:
but I can not love something that was so unbelievably frustrating to use and then DID NOT WORK!!

I have fairly long but super straight lashes. Every single day I would curl my lashes with a heated up eyelash curler and wear waterproof mascara. In the summer months, no matter how great they looked in the morning the heat and humidity would make them fall flat instantly! How excited was I to find out there was something called eyelash perming and that I could do it myself!!

I quickly set out to find out how to do this and do it well! Watched many videos and read all the reviews. Finally settled on this kit. It came with TONS of stuff! Everything I knew I would need and more! Watched a few more videos and get right down to perming my straight lashes! Oh my gosh was this a pain to use! I expected it to be hard to get my lashes glue on correctly from watching the videos and reading the reviews but this was ridiculous! The glue was awful! Gloppy and soooo hard to get to work (just as hard to remove the huge glops of glue when you're finished too by the way!)

I persisted and managed to get the job done...Only problem...It didn't work! It curled some lashes slightly, others not at all making it way worse because I couldn't even get them to look good with my eyelash curler anymore!

I assume it was user error, watched more videos, waited a week and tried again! Exact same result! I was doing everything exactly as directed and had done considerable research on this before starting so I was confident it was not something I was doing wrong at this point.

Soooo, I ordered Dolly's Lash Lift kit (sold on Amazon for 49.99 but I found mine online elsewhere for ten dollars less). Dolly's worked beautifully! Everything about it is better!
-The silicone pads are more comfortable and easier to use.
-The glue was awesome! I had absolutely NO trouble gluing the pads to my lid or my lashes to the pad. It brushed on easily. Stuck to everything it was supposed to and nothing it wasn't. And it was super easy to get off too!
-The lotions are colored (pink for the perming lotion and blue for the other) making it really easy to make sure you've got it on evenly
-It came with easy to follow instructions
-Most importantly...It worked!! My lashes look amazing! Curled perfectly. Got up this morning and threw on a little mascara and I was good to go for the day!

I suppose it is possible that I just got a bad batch of this product. There is no expiration date on it...Maybe it was old and that's why it didn't work?? This kit did come with a lot of extras that the other, more expensive kit (Dolly's) didn't. Some of which I used with the Dolly perming kit. Some of which I'm not even sure what the purpose is?? Not sure but I highly recommend checking out this one before buying!! https://www.amazon.com/dp/B008RN1QQO/ref=cm_sw_r_cp_dp_T2_imctzb1MF94X2

title: This is a LOT of plastic wrap. Be sure you have the right space at home for it.
text: I do like this plastic wrap generally, and it is wonderful not to have to worry about tiny little boxes of plastic wrap running out. But this is a LOT of plastic wrap in a very big and heavy box. You are not going to want to be lifting and using this like you would a small box. I did not think about home kitchen storage for it -- but it really demands to be left out and used the way it would be in a professional kitchen. Make sure you have room to put it somewhere solid above (or near the edge of) your counters since pulling and tearing the product takes both hands to be done correctly -- and you need to be able to pull it up and then tear down without smacking your hands on the counter. Just think about how it is used in a professional kitchen and the description might make more sense. I don't use the separate included slider-cutter, but, thinking about it, that might help the tearing issue. The cutting blade on the cardboard that is included is really great. The film itself has a slight odor to it, but that odor was only transferred to some baked goods when I covered the pan with it instead of using my regular waxed paper; it has been perfect for everything else and seems much easier to unwrap than regular plastic wrap.

title: NOT Titanium
text:
They work for what they're intended to do. I gave one star because they claim to be "bonded titanium". However, as other reviews have mentioned, these are magnetic. Titanium is not magnetic. Only ferrous (iron-based) metals are magnetic.

I've had them for three years and there is no indication of rust, so they are probably some form of stainless steel. However, because the seller(s) / manufacturer are lying about them being titanium, it's hard to tell what kind of. If they are stainless they are probably a 304 SS, which is decent. 316 is much better, but is also non-magnetic secondary to how the atoms are arranged. So, they aren't "the best" of steel if they are steel at all.

title: Gave me horrible insomnia.
text:
This was my big lesson in how "natural" doesn't necessarily equal "good" and your mileage may vary with supplements.

The product itself is great. I didn't find the taste all that bad and had no problem downing a spoonful. It is oil, of course, so having a glass of water afterwards to wash it down is a good idea. I had no fish burps, I didn't turn into a fish - none of that. Wasn't nearly as bad as I was expecting.

The effects, though, weren't so great. It did lift my mood, marginally, but gave me persistent sleep issues. I often wasn't able to fall asleep for hours and even then couldn't get more than 3-4 hours or sleep before I'd start waking up every 20-30 minutes. I tried various sleep aids, went to see a doctor and even got a sleep study done. We eliminated tons of other factors and eventually saw that the only significant change in my diet or lifestyle had been the addition of a fish oil supplement. Sure enough, once I stopped taking it I was able to sleep soundly again.

It's been a little while so I don't remember my exact dosage but I was taking whatever the bottle recommends daily.

I'm sure this does wonderful things for many people but just keep in mind that your mileage may vary with supplements!

title: WonderGel for computer chair and sciatica
text:
This WonderGel Extreme works very well but while it cushions great, the abrupt edge,isn't ideal for my sciatica in a car. It works very well in a chair where I can put my feet up a bit on a stool below the computer desk, then the 90 degree angle edge doesn't create a problem for my leg/sciatica. It its defense, everybody and every BODY is different It might be great for you in a chair and in a car as well. I bought this one first based on reviews and am happy with it, for use in a chair at the computer, feet up a bit on a stool.
I also bought the Conformax Airmax Gel Car/Truck Seat Cushion by Crinnis Corp (here on Amazon) which I use in the car on road trips, they are 15 hrs long. As my issue is sciatica, I use the Conformax in the car, then take it out from under me for a time, changing pressure, replacing it a few hours later. Alternating with/without works better than all of the time using the Conformax and definitely much better than without the Conformax
Read the issues about the Conformax and this WonderGel Extreme Seat Cushion and high temperatures in cars. When not in use I keep in covered, in the car, in back under a cover with insulating blanket over it. Sitting on it in high (summertime/in sun, closed car) may mess it up and the limited warranty. I use this AND the Conformax, very happy. The cost of both is far less than neurologist visits! Prevention is the best medicine (this from a retired healthcare worker!)
In short, well worth the money, both of them together, one for the car, one for the computer chair.

title: Good adjustable pillow for car or travel
text: I used this pillow for 2.5 years until it finally died, and I'm going to buy another one.  I used it in my car all the time, and on airplanes when I fly.  The inflatable feature lets me adjust the support for whatever seat I happen to be in.  It also helps on long trips to be able to change the inflation level.  The support isn't perfect - I have to move it around and try different inflation levels, and at best it offers some relief but not complete relief for an L4-L5 herniation.  (Try turning it vertical.)  I have tried several other types of support for seats and this is the best.  A good purchase, but the product has some faults.  The check valve in the bulb failed after about a year, so I had to use a binder clip as a clamp on the hose to keep it from deflating.  That worked OK until the rubber hose deteriorated at the connection to the pillow and now it's not fixable.  There are more durable materials than natural rubber for the hose and bulb - it's disappointing that silicone wasn't used instead.  Because it's rubber, avoid getting any oils, greases or lotions on the tubing.  These can cause rapid deterioration.

title: Handy Sanitizer
text: This little gadget works just like promised. Very handy and you don't have to handle a dirty bottle to get to your gel. The plastic case is housing for the refill cartridges. The cartridges work by placing your fingers underneath the front and squeezing the cartridge against the front of the unit. The cartridges have a little (plastic/rubber?) membrane with a tiny slit that expels the gel when pressed. I haven't had any trouble with leakage, even leaving it in a hot car.  As for the refills, they are pricey and the cartridges are "not refillable". It's easy to go through a cartridge in a couple of days. However, if you have access to a large (20cc or so) syringe and an 18 gauge needle, you can refill them with ease. Just fill the syringe with gel from the plunger end. Then put a little pressure on the cartridge so you can see the opening in the membrane and gently insert the needle. Then fill. Takes about 30 seconds. The cartridge holds about 40ccs. I've done it four times now without damaging the membrane.  I figure if I get 5 or 6 refills out of each cartridge it is still economical. Hope this idea helps. This really is a handy device. I keep one clipped on the outside of my handbag and one clip in a handy place in the car.

UPDATE: 7/21/18 99 Cent Store has similar product under brand name of "Perfect Purity". Both bottles say 10 oz, but when I held both bottles up to a bright light, it appeared that the Equate bottle had significantly more powder in it than the Perfect Purity. I don't have a scale, but both bottles felt like they weighed about the same. The Equate label says product of India while Perfect Purity says made in USA.

text:
I just wanted to update my review. I purchased this massager on 12/15/2015 and it still gives great massages.

I would only offer one caution about this product. The massage is so deep tissue and gets those knots out, that I had an inclination to press too hard and get a small bruise. I have learned to adjust the pressure now so that I don't get self-inflicted damage anymore. lol

Once I use this Massager, it will last me for several days before I feel pain or tight again. I use it on my neck, shoulders, back and the back of my legs. I use the computer several hours a day and my body really feels the pain on the top and back of my shoulder so much so, that I started to lose sleep. I'm happy to say now, that this is no longer a problem.

For those of you who are on the road a lot, my massager came with a plug for the lighter. I thought that this would be a big plus for those of you don't want to wait to go home and use it.

I noticed that some of the customers were complaining that it broke prematurely. My suggestion would be to use a credit card that would double the warranty. At least you'll get twice as much usage out of it.

Even if your massager broke in 2-3 months, it would still be way cheaper than going to a masseuse once a month. My massage used to cost $60 for an hour session and it would only last a few days. I haven't seen mine since I purchased this awesome product. It's way better than that vibrating pounding massager.

Based on some of the negative reviews, I was hoping for a maximum of 6 months usage until it broke, but it still works fine. I use mine on an average of 2 -3 times a week. If mine breaks again, I wouldn't hesitate to order one immediately. It feels great to have my muscles feel loose again! The return on my investment was well worth it as you can see.

I gave the first one away immediately to my friend who has the same condition and ordered mine before I gave it away. Her response was, OMG!!! I hope this helps those of you who were like me suffering from muscle pain and tightness. This product is a life changer for me.

Btw, I rarely write any reviews. I felt that this one was worth talking about once more after 7 months. Amazon keeps reminding me that I have about 6 requests outstanding. I probably won't time. lol

title: Great product, worth a buck a pill.
text:
My vision plan buys me six sets of contacts per year. We're only supposed to wear them for a month at most. I had been in the habit of wearing them for far too long.

I remember the old days when we would use enzymatic cleaner every so often. So I gave this a try, and I'm glad I did.

I use Clear care hydrogen peroxide solution to sterilize my lenses overnight. I just fill the vial and drop one of these pills in, and wait for it to dissolve. Then I put the contacts in and let it marinate overnight.

I do use regular solution to clean them off in the morning just in case there's something in the enzymatic cleaner that's bad for the eyes.

First time I used it, I had been wearing contacts so long that they felt like they had sand in them. An overnight soak in this and they felt like new.

So just get these if you want to get more use out of your contacts.

title: Great Eye Mask for Headaches or Stress Relief
text:
My wife and I both often deal with headaches and oftentimes we like to use warm compresses across our eyes to try to help alleviate them. I saw this item and thought it might be a convenient way to apply heat to our head/eyes when we have headaches.

What’s in the Box:
Inside the box you get the eye mask, a USB charging cable (about 6 feet in length), a sheet of instructions and a set of foam earplugs.

Quality:
I was very impressed with the quality of this eye mask. The mask itself is a very soft fabric, and sewn between the sheets of fabric is a very soft foam that contours the shape around your eyes and the bridge of your nose, similar to the way a ski mask or swim mask does.

The stitching on the material also looks well done, and the elastic strap seems sturdy. The strap also has Velcro on it so that you can adjust the size of the mask depending on the size of your head.

The included USB cable is about 6 feet long and also has a small area on it that allows you to turn the heat off and on.

Ease of Use:
Using the heated eye mask is super simple. You first need to connect the mask to the USB cable. This is done by simply connecting it via the magnetic clip. After that you will need to plug the USB cable into a USB outlet, I used the white USB brick that came with my iPhone

The mask has 3 heat settings, low, medium and high. To choose one of these heat levels, simply click the power button until the little light turns the corresponding color (Blue is for low, Green is for medium and Red is for high). After that, just slide the mask over your head and eyes and sit back and relax.

Final Verdict:
This is a great heated eye mask, the fabric is very soft and overall it seems to be well made. I don’t sleep with eye masks, so I won’t sleep with this one on, but as I mentioned earlier, I would definitely wear this to try to alleviate some stress and headache or sinus pain. I do wish it got a little bit hotter than it does, but since this is technically a sleep mask, the manufacturer probably did want people to fall asleep with a very hot mask on their faces. Overall I’d recommend this product.

title: Search for natural deodorant is over
text:
My search is done. This is the last brand of natural deodorant I'll be buying!!! I'm dry, odor-free, my pits are healthy, and I feel good about reducing my consumption of single-use plastic.

I have been trying to find a natural deodorant for years. After so many failed attempts, I had just about given up when I saw that Ethique offered a deodorant. I've been happy with their shampoo, conditioner, and lotion bars so I decided to try one more natural deodorant before giving up for good. I'm so glad it tried it. This deodorant checks all the boxes for me. It is free from baking soda so I don't get that horrible rash. The magnesium hydroxide is super effective for controlling odor. The scent is pleasant and not too strong. THE BIG THING is... it actually absorbs perspiration. It's like some sort of sorcery or black magic!! It's not a true antiperspirant in preventing sweating, but it's so effective at absorbing that I don't miss antiperspirant at all.

I will say, there are a few things to know going into this. The minimal-waste design means no applicator. I have learned to just trim the parchment type paper it comes in to provide a finger hold so it's not all over my hands after applying That works great down to the last little bit of the bar when my hands get a little messy.

The other thing to know... it goes on a bit chalky, but I think that is unavoidable with the combo of tapioca and bamboo that makes it so absorbing. I'll deal with chalky in exchange for this level of moisture control. The consistency can make it hard to apply. It doesn't exactly glide on. In summer it's not so bad. In winter, I just hold it against my armpit for 5-10 seconds to warm it before I start applying. It does not go on clear. There is a whitish residue and it will leave white marks on clothes if you're not careful, but it does not stain and again... it's a small price to pay for dry pits.

We were also taking a couple black peppercorns along with the turmeric powder, as I had read that it increases the absorption of the cur curcumin by a whopping 2,000%. This did not upset my stomach, but my mother felt that it was upsetting her stomach, so we are pleased to see that there is Bioperine (black pepper) already included in the capsules. Also I had not realized that there is only a small amount of curcumin in Turmeric which is the beneficial component. We were excited to find this product which contains 95% curcumin compared to the 3% that is contained in the powder form that we had been taking previously.

I am taking Turmeric as a digestion aid and my mother is taking Turmeric for cholesterol maintenance as well as for digestion.

My mother and I are both very pleased with this product and would order it again as well as recommend it to others.

I was lucky enough to receive this product at a discount in exchange for my review and honest opinion.

title: Amazing stuff, keep your nail from getting chazzed and your glass show room clean
text:
This is an amazing cleaner for Qtip tech, or for cleaning glass, or nails (soaking) in general. I recommend heating up the solution to clean your glass, keep an eye on it and make sure it doesn't boil over; or rather, heat up the solution in the microwave just until it starts to bubble. You also don’t need salt, or need to shake it up. Just let it sit for 30 seconds to 3 min, and your glass will be spotless. You can repeat as many times as needed. I use this in combination with 99% Isopropyl Alcohol (ISO) for a clean that’s so clean, it’s safe to fly with. I usually use ISO first, then finish with the DC glass cleaner, and save it to re-use it again. For travel I do the same first two steps, but I hit it with the ISO again after the DC glass cleaner, save the rest of the ISO for another time, and then let whatever is left evaporate. This ends up giving you zero water spots.

For nails, just make sure the nail isn’t super hot, if the nail is still too hot, it can and *will stain your quartz. You want the nail to be hot, but not so hot that the cleaner will evaporate (that’s when it leaves stains.) Qtip tech regularly, then hit it with the clean end with a small amount of DC glass cleaner on the Qtip, if you need you can always hit with the dry side of a fresh Qtip. Then when finished, and you’re ready to go. You can do this however many times you feel you need to. Sometimes once is good, other times I’ll do it 3 times in a row if I got nail a little too hot.

I always have to have some on me, look on YouTube for a more detailed analysis on how to use. This will change your life. A must have for an owner of headies, or high end glass. I included photos of my ships right after cleaning them, and they look like they’ve never been used.

text:
I have severe Piriformis pain, and have tried different pillows including Tempur-pedic. I have been showing everyone at my work the Purple mattress commercial (comedy is always a big seller to me!) and when one of the guys asked me to look up their site, I found this. If you have any type of Sciatica or Piriformis pain, or general hip pain or problems, this pillow is worth it.

I have also used SONY 900mah NiMH AAA rechargeable batteries.  The SONY battery also self drains but will retain power for around 1 month if left unused after a full charge.  However, the SONY battery will take hours to get a full charge.  If you like battery that can retain power longer, try the new hybrid battery by Sanyo, Rayovac, and SONY. title: If you get "WIFI ERR", the scale's broken!
text:
I was really excited to get this scale and start my new video fitness blog today. Unfortunately, it's broken. I guess I should have bought it a month ago, but I assumed it would work out of the box.

The first thing you notice when you take it out is the build quality and aesthetics are exquisite. It seems really solid and well made, with a smooth glass top that would fit in elegantly with any bathroom. They're available in black and in white. I actually wanted the white more, but the rounded spots where you put your feet are actually off-white, like a cream color - which you can't see in any photo on the site but is really apparent in person. You can see it a bit in this photo: [...]
Also, the digital display on the white one is a cheap-looking black-on-grey that just smacks of 'original Gameboy', compared to the sexy light blue-on-black of the black model.

Setting it up was an exercise in futility. After 40 minutes of trying, I was ready to pull my hair out.
First off, know that YOU CANNOT SET IT UP WITH A WIRED COMPUTER. If you're hooked up via an ethernet cable, you need to switch to a wireless device like a laptop, tablet, smartphone, or newer desktop with wifi. This is because you'll be asked to switch from your regular wifi network to a temporary "Aria" wifi network (the scale itself acts like another computer in the network), and then back again. I wish this weren't necessary, but since I got the thing to interact with my smartphone it wasn't a huge deal.

From my Android smartphone, I navigated to the setup page on the Fitbit website and followed the simple, direct instructions on the site PRECISELY. I did this many times. I can connect to the Aria wifi network in my smartphone wifi settings, but NOT in the list of available networks on the scale setup page. The scale itself reads "networks detected" at first, and finally "wifi err". I should note that my wireless network works perfectly with my Chromebook, smartphone, and my housemates' devices.

I tried many things which didn't work. Finally, I contacted Fitbit. They got back to me in under 24 hours, which was nice, and let me know that it was pretty cut and dry: "wifi err" on the device means a hardware malfunction; there is no ambiguity there. The nice support agent gave me two options - I could return the unit myself and get a new one at the Best Buy I purchased it at, or I could keep my current scale and they'd mail me a new one, free of charge. I thought that showed great integrity and customer service, although it should not have happened in the first place. I asked whether this happens a lot with these scales and he said "much more than you'd think".

Why not just use the scale for my weight and body composition, you ask? Without saving your user profile to the scale - which requires communicating to the Aria servers - it only gives you your weight and says you're a Guest user. A $20 scale can show my weight just the same.

CONCLUSION: First impression was great, except I got a lemon. I can't draw a fair conclusion as I don't know how many units are broken out of the box. I'm looking forward to getting a new one and amending my rating. For now, it's 0 stars for not working, 2 stars for great style and design and great customer service.

title: Very useful addition to the Drive DV8
text: This was a very useful addition to my Drive DV8 knee walker, even though it's supposed to be for a different brand of knee walker.  It came with one proper mounting bracket.  I did have to use a flat-blade screwdriver and pry the bracket "hands" open a bit.  I also used pliers to straighten the basket where it was curved at the points it needed to go into the straight mounting bracket.  Once I did this, the basket goes on with a little push and it is NOT loose.  It requires a little tug to get it off.  I also added a velcro cable tie at the lower mounting point.  That is also easy to remove if desired.  This basket sticks out front of the Drive DV8's front wheels by about 6 inches.  So if you want to drive up flush to a cabinet or something in front of you, you may want to remove the basket first.

title: Great scale, needs better instructions
text:
I've owned a Withings scale for years, but I lost it in a move, and bought this one as a replacement because it cost significantly less. I had a little trouble setting the scale up, but once set up it's working well and I'm very happy with it.

I'd give it five stars if it had better setup instructions/process. The main point of confusion is setting it up for multiple family members, which it supports, but the process is not a part of the initial setup and the option to add users is well hidden in the UI. It's a bit complex as well - you have to email an invitation to the person, then they read their email, accept the invitation, and set up a fitbit account and link the scale to it. Which is a lot to go through to see my family's weights tracked. With the Withings I see all of the measurements in a single graph, and I can simply set the names of the people in the software.

Still, now that it's set up, it works great.

title: NO SCENT,NO COLOR,NO FIZZ - JUST BORING!
text:
No doubt that this seems like a bargain. And I read the descriptions, all of the reviews etc. & I was just expecting a lot more color & some scent..at least 10 of my bath bombs were solid white (a baking soda bomb??). The others were mostly yellow except for the 3 that were lavender with like 2 purple sprinkles on top.. So obviously I did not receive a wide variety of colors. But I knew it was a gamble. As far as the "scents"..not even sure exactly how to explain it - perhaps if there was a perfume that smelled of soap..? It just smells like baking soda with a perfume like cheap soap scent. Not a single 1 smells any different from the others. Even my 12 year old daughter wanted to order from Lush, Fortune Cookie Soap or BathHouse immediately. I gave the remaining 44 to my Mother in law. She is not really a soak in the bath type of lady, she does not order products like this & she said that they "seemed okay enough".. "just fine, nothing special" to her.
Oh well, now I know right. These are perfect for little girls. My daughter would've loved these when she was about 6-7 years old.
There are FAR to many lovely products on the market to waste money on products like this. I can use 1/2 of a Fortune Cookie Soap "Bath Melt" or "Bath Bomb" & not only do I smell wonderful all day & into the next morning but my entire bathroom, bedroom & hallway smell so good. I wasn't expecting that..really I wasn't. But I was expecting something..
To the people whom gave 5 Star reviews..order from FCS, BathHouse Soapery or LUSH just 1 time & see how it's done. Or go on Pinterest, look up a recipe & make them yourself at home bc it's truly not difficult, time consuming or expensive. My friend made some on a whim & they were smaller than these but they were better as far as scent, color, fizz & softening your skin as well. But Mr. Bubble makes bath bombs that give more color, scent & fizz than these..really they do, you can buy them at Walmart.com
Honestly..I should have returned these. Where's the scent?

I used to work at a cell phone company in corporate, and that was my first introduction to wipes of these types. Prior to that job, I had no idea about these type of things, I just used alcohol and tissue. These types are just moist enough, clean thoroughly, does not leave streaks and looks new after use. That is what they advertised.

Some complain that they are too small, but I had prior use with these types for eye glasses and cell phones - never for camera lenses or larger things. However, I did use ONE on my 10 inch table and one was enough to get the job done. I have a feeling that outside of my phone, the tablet may use these the most. I am sure that someone makes larger ones some place. I don't know how anyone can complain since these leave no streaks and no fibers!

My only complaint would be that the box is too fancy and even heavy for the product type. If they made a cheaper, more simple box, they could cut down on the cost. I mention this because I was expecting one of those medical type boxes that you see alcohol wipes come in. Ah well.

But once I started using this noise hair trimmer, I could not believe how easy and best of all, faster it was to remove unwanted nose hairs. I must say that during the time I have been using it, it did run a little hot but not enough to burn me at all. The small flashlight is a plus but I did not find myself using it too much.

The cleaning is super easy, you just have to twist counter clockwise to the top part of the trimmer and it will come right off. Then you just pull out the small blades from within the top of the trimmer (see pictures) and just clean it. It is not hard at all and I did not need instructions to figure it out. Overall, I'm quite satisfied with this product. It would definitely make a great gift or even for personal use.

text: I won't say it cures dry eye, because if I stopped using it the condition might recur. That's a risk I'm not willing to take.  I have a corneal dystrophy that causes scarring when my eyes get dried out. It is permanent damage to my eye that is excruciatingly painful when it happens, and it used to happen a lot. I used Udo's oil (liquid), fish oil capsules and brand name specialty eye relief capsules for years without relief. My ophthalmologist measured my tear retention when the condition was first diagnosed as left eye-4, right eye-7. 12 is normal. I finally switched to the Carlson's liquid fish oil because of the high quality. I like the lemon flavor, and put it on my cereal every morning. My tear retention rate is now 13 in both eyes, I haven't had a scarring episode for a long time, and have not renewed the prescription for the exorbitantly expensive eye drops I had to use for the pain. This stuff is wonderful, and worth every penny--and I was paying almost twice as much for it locally. The price online is great!

title: Another Electronic Piece Of Crap
text:
Having had a number of electronic scales over the last decade, I had sworn that my next purchase would be a real balance-beam doctor's-type scale. Trouble is, the only place with both the space AND a bare floor for such a scale, is my kitchen, and I really don't want a doctor's scale in my kitchen, so based on the reviews here on Amazon, I figured I'd take one more crap shoot and try this scale.

Well, I crapped out!

It's another piece of electronic junk. This scale will show me weighing the exact same weight EVERY day for a week to 10 days! I mean, it doesn't vary by so much as a tenth of a pound! Sorry, pardner, but the human body doesn't work like that!

There is simply no such thing as an accurate electronic scale- unless of course, you get something like a commercial freight scale. Trouble with ALL of these little built-in-sensor bathroom scales is: They are by nature very touchy. In order to compensate for that touchiness, the manufacturers build an Al-Gore-rhythm (Algorithm) into the circuitry to moderate the variations between readings. Some scales use a more unobtrusive Al-Gore-rhythm, which results in wild variations every time you step on the scale- while some use an aggressive Al-Gore-rhythm, such as this manufacturer does) which results in an unnatural consistency. Either way, you can't win, and you never know when any of these scales are telling you the truth.

If you're only interested in a rough estimation of your weight- say + or - 3 or 4 lbs, then this scale, or just about any other electronic scale will work for you. If you weigh yourself every day, and like to keep on top of your weight, then do yourself a favor, and get a doctor's scale (You can get a nice name-brand one on here for c. $150).

I will NEVER buy another electronic scale!!!!!!!!!

EDIT: Most of the reviews on here give this scale a positive rating for it being "consistent"; -but as I note above, it is an artificial consistency. If you doubt this, and have this scale, here is a little test to easily prove the accuracy of what I say. Use the scale for a few days, until it starts giving you the same reading every day. Then, remove the batteries for a few seconds, and then re-install them (to clear the scale's memory)- weigh yourself again now, and voila! - you will get a different reading- which will then become the constant.

I don't know about anyone else, but i want a scale that actually measures my weight; not one which uses an Al-Gore-rhythm to fool me with false consistency.

title: Well Worth the Extra Setup Needed for a PBX System
text:
Took a bit of extra work to get it working but that was expected. Our office phone system is an NEC DSX digital PBX and we apparently run all of the phones on digital lines. This device will only work over analog lines or digital lines that provide the right amount of power on the correct line to the phone. To get it working we had our telecom equipment servicer TelWest (shout out to Zack and Kayla for excellent service!) and they were able to change one of our existing unused lines from digital to analog and add it to the ring group for the main reception phone. Now when the front receptionist takes a break or leaves for the day our back office receptionist who has hearing problems can answer the phone on the first or second ring without any problems.

The device itself is easy to set up and the flasher is super bright. You simply plug the included line into the wall outlet, place the flasher where you can easily see it and then plug your phone into the port on the other end of the device. It is worth noting that you don't need to have a phone plugged into the device in order for it to work properly. That means you can plug it into any existing outlet that would normally ring when a phone call comes through and see the unit flash without the need for a spare phone plugged into it. This is very helpful since we did not want or need another phone ringing in the back when the reception phone went off.

All in all we are very pleased and our callers will be much happier not having to wait 4 or 5 rings until their calls are answered.

title: Similar - but different - Products
text: This product, "Nupercanial Hemorrhoid & Topical Analgesic Ointment", is manufactured by Novartis Consumer Health, (at 800-452-0051). However, (and apparently), this company no longer exists and/or is no longer manufacturing this product in its original formulation. Novartis Consumer Health - the manufacturer of the 'older' version of this product - was either bought up/merged/or partnered with GSK, (i.e., GlaxoSmithKline at 888-825-5249). They in turn, either sold this product line, or transferred this product line, and the rights to this product line or it's brand name, to another company called Ducere Pharma, (according to GSK's consumer customer service). GSK then graciously transferred my call to Ducere Phama customer service, (at 800-790-6417) to answer my questions about this product. Once there, I was told by them that the 'older' version of this product, "Nupercanial Hemorrhoid & Topical Analgesic Ointment", is no longer 'available' through them, but that they are marketing "Nuper-Canial Hemorrhoidal Ointment" as it's replacement. Please NOTE that there is NOT only a similarity in the name here, (between these two products), but their boxes look very similar, as they use most of the same colors and/or lettering on their respective boxes. Also of note, is that the 'older' product box is designed to be marketed laying down horizontally, while the 'newer' product box is designed to be displayed standing vertically. (Please see my attached photos). However, the ingredients INSIDE of these product is - while similar in it's intent - does, in fact, differ from each other. The 'older' product was more of a yellowish-white 'cream' and the 'newer' product is more of a clear-ish 'ointment'. While the newer product may contain some of the older product ingredients, it definitely - in this consumer's opinion - does NOT work the same OR as good. (I found this out from personal use and also by researching other Internet reviews of this 'newer' product). The attached photos, (of the two different product's boxes), should enlighten you as to which of these two products you will be getting with your order.

title: Great product for Lyme Disease patients at a great price!
text: I suffer from Chronic Lyme Disease which is not an acceptable term according to the CDC or the Infectious Diseases Society of America but I can assure you it does exist.  Lyme Disease isn't easily diagnosed as it is also known as "The Great Imitator".  If you don't have the bullseye rash or fit into the very narrow testing done by your local hospital or Infectious Disease MD at this point the best Chronic Lyme patients can hope for is remission, not a cure.  Only when Lyme is caught I believe within the 1st year & treated correctly is it curable which is a huge problem in America & other parts of the world.  I will never know when I was infected so I don't know how long it will be before I'm in remission.  I just started with a new LLMD, Lyme Literate MD, so I hope to be doing much better than I have been very soon but there is no way to know how long it will take to be in remission.  I take 10 drops of the Parsley Detox 5X a day in 4oz of water.  I also do the same with their BURBUR Detox at the same dose.  I highly recommend this product because you need to get all the dead Lyme spirochetes, the form of the bacterial infection, out of your body once they start dying off.  It doesn't matter which route you have chosen to treat the disease with you still need to get the die off out of your body.  It also helps with the symptoms that I experience with treatment because the treatment definitely makes you feel worse.  The price is MUCH CHEAPER than if you were to buy it at a doctor's office so you can't go wrong buying from Amazon.  I choose to buy from smile.amazon.com so my purchases that apply will go to a charity researching Lyme Disease which is definitely a added bonus & desperately needed.

title: Perfect for therapy and can be modified for sleeping.
text:
I suffer from a herniated disk in the lower back and was looking for a device to elevate my legs while sleeping. As I unboxed the Therapist's Choice® bolster, my initial impression was it was designed for physical therapy and not well suited for sleep. Nevertheless, I gave it a go that night. After about one hour my legs were uncomfortable, so I returned to a pillow for elevation.

I liked the firm support but the sharp peak was pressing into the back of my knees. I decided to modify the bolster to better suit my application.

The vinyl cover was unzipped and with careful pressure, the foam interior was removed. An electric carving knife proved to be the perfect tool for the modification. Initially I tried one inch off the peak and and gave it a test nap on the bed. It was much better so went one complete night with it elevating my knees.

This time, I went four hours before waking up with discomfort.

The following evening, I carved an additional inch off the peak and this seems to be ideal. Firm but gentle support, suitable elevation, and a complete night's rest. I woke up with no back pain so reinstalled the vinyl cover and zipped it up. The small plastic zipper balked at first, but finally slid into position. The cover slides over sheets but my bent legs locked it into position as I slept on my back.

In summary, this bolster is clearly a Therapist's Choice® with easy to clean cover and sharp corners, perfect for brief sessions. It is as advertised.
It took a few minutes with a kitchen tool to transform it into an ideal solution for sciatica pain relief at home. I think it is great and recommend to others with the noted reservations.

title: Good product. Appears to be 11 Calories per scoop but label is silent as to calorie count.
text:
I have been using Thick-It for my wife's drinks. Large container has 3,600 calories per the Thick-it label. That container lasts her abour 6 days, meaning she consumes 600 calories per day JUST from Thick-it alone. I ordered Altrix Rapid Thickener in hopes of reducing that calorie consumption, but the label offers no clue other than 'low calorie'. We did
purchase a Portable Mini Drink Mixer. It is a small, battery handheld mixer to aid in mixing Altrix with Coffee or Water. I start the Mini Mixer in the liquid THEN add the Altrix powder into the little vortex the spinning mixer creates. Works perfectly to mix the contents. I am ordering more Altrix but I still seek Calorie information. The label does show it has 55kJ (kilojoules), a unit of energy of which few people understand. Research show 1kJ=0.2 Calories so 55kJ = 11 calories per scoop. I keep a 60 oz bottle (repurposed Simply Orange Juice bottle) in the fridge which required 10 scoops or 110 calories per my 60 oz bottle. That is much more acceptable in regards to Calorie consumption for my wife and I am re-ordering Altrix Rapid Thickener. GET THE DRINK MIXER for $5.00 USD.

title: Be careful with it if you have nervous system disorders
text:
This is a very good and high quality product however...bone broth can affect the nervous system and it may be a good idea to do some research before adding it to your diet. I was very irritable during the time I was taking the product and now I know why - I have found out that the result of the long cook times for the bone broth supplements is a tremendous amount of glutamic acid. Glutamic acid and glutamate are highly regulated by the human brain. High amounts of glutamic acid can trigger seizures if you’re prone to them. It can also trigger other neurological symptoms you may already be sensitive to, including brain fog, migraine headaches, dramatic mood swings, stimming, and nervous tics.
I personally feel that there should be a warning on this type of products about possible side effects. People with MS should definitely not take it.
On the positive side - my skin improved a lot while I was taking the supplement.

title: Look and feel identical to the originals, but has different screw holes threads
text:
I got these for my wife's wheelchair mainly because hers were warn down from years of use such that there was very little padding left, but also because the plastic had broke around one of the brass insert nuts. The screws go into these to hold the arms in place so when the plastic around the nut broke the whole arm became loose. When this new set of arms arrived they looked nearly identical to the originals which I was happy about. Only two screws were included instead of four but at the time I didn't care since I was just going to reuse the existing screws anyway.

Then I went to install the arms and found that these the brass insert nuts in these new arms had different thread thicknesses so my original screws couldn't go in very far. I contacted the seller and they said two more screws would be shipped out to me. I took the two screws that had been included and used them to install one of the arms. These screws didn't look like the black flat-head screws in the picture, though. Instead they were silver-colored pan-head screws. They screwed in just fine and my wife says the armrest feels just like the original, only new.

I'm disappointed that I couldn't use my original screws and that only two screws were included instead of four, but I can't really blame the product for either of these. They look nearly identical to the originals with only a slight difference in the pattern and glossiness of the material. If you look closely at my comparison pictures you should be able to see the difference. My wife finds them comfortable and they look good but I would have preferred the flat-head style screws and to have received all four of them at the same time.

If you found my review helpful please let me know by hitting that YES button below otherwise please leave me a comment letting me know what I can do to improve. Thanks a bunch!

5/14/2018 Update
One of the screws fell out a couple weeks ago so I had to pick up a pack at the hardware store. In doing so I learned that these are 10-24 x 1-1/4" in machine screws.

title: My wife and her friend both really love this, but the heat feature is barely noticeable
text:
[[VIDEOID:45170dc89951dd53767e810619a74654]] The last time we were visiting over at my parents' house my wife tried out a massage pillow like this that my dad got my mom and she really liked it, so we looked into getting one. We were kind of surprised to find how much they cost, I mean I was thinking maybe around fifty bucks or so, not eighty! So instead of buying it we put it in our wishlist... and not long after that it showed up in the mail. My wife couldn't be happier with it, because even though it's not as strong as her heavy-duty handheld massager it is way quieter so she can actually use it while we watch TV, unlike her strong handheld massager which is so loud that we have to pause the TV until she's done. My wife suffers from chronic lower back pain so she uses this quite a bit and says it's definitely worth $80. Yesterday a friend of hers was over, saw it on the couch, tried it out, and fell in love with it as well.

One of the neat things about this is that it has a built-in battery so it can be charged up then used without being plugged in. My wife has used this feature a couple times when she was sitting at dinning room table so that she didn't have to move the power cord from near the couch over to where she was at, but mostly she uses it while plugged in. It comes with a wall power cord and a car power cord, but she hasn't used it in the car yet.

There is a heat feature as well, which is indicated by red LEDs lighting up on the massage rollers, but the heat is VERY mild. We were both feeling it with our hands and saying things like "I think it might be a little warm", and when we would then move our hands elsewhere on the pillow we'd be like "yeah, it's a little warmer than over here". So unless ours is just defective or something, don't expect a lot from the heat feature, or I should say the mildly warm feature. There is no temperature control as far as we can tell, one press of the power button turns on the massagers, a second press reverses the rotation and activates the heat, and a third press turns it off.

Personally, I don't really care for massages or any massage devices, but my wife loves them and she loves this pillow (as does her friend) and they both think it should be rated 5 stars. She doesn't care that the heat feature can barely be felt but I think if something has a heat feature then we should be able to clearly feel when it's on and when it's not. I also still think $80 is a bit much, but the main reason I'm giving this 4 stars is because of the heat feature.

title: Buy this! You won't be sorry!
text:
I researched this on here before buying it. I've never had a Sonic toothbrush before, but have used the spin-type ones before that you can buy at the pharmacy or grocery store. They're loud and are ok, but for the most part, at least the ones I've previously bought, you can't just change the brush. You have to throw the entire unit away and replace it when it wears out.

First of all... Make sure you charge it before you use it the first time. It comes with 2 brush heads. Replacements can be purchased here for around 10 bucks, or so. Not bad.

Secondly... It's quiet! It doesn't sound like a jackhammer in your mouth. Such a nice and welcome change. I wasn't expecting it to be so quiet, so this was an added bonus.

Thirdly... There are 5 different settings to play around with and choose from. Try each of them out, and decide for yourself which one works best for you.

There's a pre-set 2 minute timer in it that briefly stops the brush every 30 seconds to indicate moving to a different part of your mouth. Divide the areas in your mouth into 4 and each time the brush stops, move to the next area. I really enjoy this feature. It ensures that you're brushing for 2 minutes. In the past, I thought I'd been brushing long enough, but now that it's being timed? I know I wasn't.

I've never had a Sonicare, or the fancy Oral B ones before, so I can't compare this brush to those, but this one FAR out-performs the spin-type brushes. My teeth have never felt cleaner. I really does feel like I've had my teeth professionally cleaned at the dentists.

This is a great investment. I'll be giving these out as gifts to my loved ones this Christmas as little stocking stuffers.

I have extremely cold feet, and have tried most products to keep my feet warm. Including three different and expensive ones from Sharper Image. By far this products is awesome. They are well made, very comfortable, and easy to use! I didn't know how it would feel with the battery on the top of the foot, no problem at all! (The ones with the battery on the side are uncomfortable and bother my ankle bone.)

For my chronic cold feet condition, I'm so desparate paying the money is a non-issue.

I bought the battery operated insoles for shoes for when I leave the house. What a pain in the butt, they never worked right.

For years I've been buying World-Bio heated insole foot warmers, 40 at a time, several times a year. It's expensive, but I cannot live without these. I have one in my purse and in my car. Talk about addiction!
Without them I cannot think straight or sleep. Doctors cannot find a cause for my cold feet, in an otherwise healthy woman, but I believe it has something to do with the thryroid medication I must take.

I would not hesitate to buy these again.

Cold in Southern California!

title: Love the grinder, hate the abrasive rating system
text:
I really like the 125v grinder, but the replacement roller description for abrasiveness is stupid, and that's why I knocked off three stars. Holy tuna on a pogo stick, why not use an industrial abrasive rating? Terms like extra coarse, extreme coarse and Super coarse are meaningless, (quick - tell me which is most and least abrasive) and more so since Amazon sells aftermarket rollers that use different naming and color schemes. They also imply there are medium and smooth or polish, but it isn't mentioned on Amazon that I can find. So I went to the Micro-Pedi web site: emjoi dot com/Refills. Some usefulness there, but why not make a comparison chart so one can just scan a table and make an informed decision rather than have to open up each item listing, read the description and build my own table, one for the factory stuff and again for the aftermarket?

I know, it's my engineer's left-brain at work. Sorry - If my rant can get the vendors to fix this it would be worth it.

By the way, holding a new no-name aftermarket green 'extreme' roller @$2 each and a blue roller that sells for $10 each with 'MicroPedi' embossed on the end, they felt identical. In use, the blue roller with the factory name went bald in about ten minutes: I mean there was no abrasive remaining for the majority of it's length. I put about 20 minutes on the no-name green roller and it still has some abrasive. Not a good sign for the name-brand stuff and a total rip-off considering their greedy pricing.

text:
I actually got this machine because I get distracted by noises around me when I am trying to focus on an assignment (be it work or school). text: Do you need a walker for either short or long term use? Would an additional, temporary bedside table be helpful?  Do you need ice at night or during sleep periods? Would you like to get a meal or cup of coffee (covered is best) from one room to another without spilling it everywhere? Then this is the tray you need for your walker. It is very easy to put together and attach (or detach and reattach) to your walker.  It holds a full size plate and has an indentation for a coffee cup with a handle.  And if you DO spill something on it, the top tray (more of a liner than a tray) comes off for easy washing.  I had a total knee replacement a month ago and one of the biggest issues I had was the heat in my knee - it was really, really hot. So I was using ice constantly, day and night and that was fine until the ice melted (even in doubled, locking plastic bags), then it would frequently leak everywhere.  With this tray I could wrap the ice bags in heavy towels and keep them on the walker tray, and when I needed them, they were safely ensconced in plastic protecting my furniture.  They also make great platforms for a tablet to stand on for watching, etc., and give you extra bedside or couch-side space. They are NOT to be used for leaning on AT ALL, and will collapse if you do try to use it for that.  But they hold everything else (other than a human) very well.

I love using them with my Penguin Classic Hardcover books. Those are beautiful and with these personal library cards, I am taken back to those sweet days when you would go to the library and find that perfect book to take home with you and the librarian would open the book and stamp that card and you would be forever engrained in the history of this book. Nostalgic, anyone?

There are 15 pockets and cards per pack and it is listed for two packs. So you get 30 refills for 10 bucks. Not bad in my opinion. Well worth it.

Conclusion: Well worth the buy; these colorful "refills" are the perfect replacement if you have run out of your beloved library cards to fill the books of your library with. I will definitely purchase again once I run out. As the product feature states, "Channel your inner librarian".

title: Make your own supplement blends.
text:
I like the idea of putting together my own blend of supplements rather than buying the "all in one" types. I try and limit my caffeine intake, especially if I am going to the gym late and have to work in the morning. I have had no issues with this product. It is good to go. I received this item at a discount price in exchange for an honest review.

Product details below:
L-Ornithine is a nonprotein amino acid and plays a intermediate role in the urea cycle in which the ornithine to a cell is the rate limit of the cycle. Ornithine is not used in the creation of proteins as many other amino acids, however, it's function is characterised by reducing the ammonia concentrations in the blood and increasing urea. Ornithine's function begins with binding to a molecule called carbamoyl phosphate which uses ammonia to be produced and then is converted into L-Citrulline, which gives off urea as a byproduct. The creation of Citrulline is said to put the urea cycle in overdrive, allowing it to suck up more ammonia (composed of nitrogen molecules) which are produced by working muscles. This in combination reduces the fatigue caused by muscles at the source. This trigers the effect of arginine conversion into nitric oxide (NO).† The increase in arginine in the blood leads to increased NO production, the increase of NO increases blood flow during exercise and allows for muscles to perform for longer while under duress, which gives weightlifters the ability to produce bigger muscle pumps. Thus, giving Ornithine the ability to help with increasing muscle endurance and reducing muscle fatigue. The added bonus of Alpha-Ketoglutarate (AKG) gives Ornithine increased absorption and performance in the body for usage. Ornithine is believed to stay in the body for longer durations and helps greatly in reducing ammonia levels in the blood, making it a excellent choice for workouts exceeding 45 minutes as this will allow for improved muscle fatgiue reduction long after completion of muscle activity.

I bought this specific scooter knowing it had shocks to help absorb movement, but was disappointed when the actual wheel seemed to be the problem not how it performed on different surfaces. title: Nice size little broom/dust pan - not so effective
text:
This mini broom/dustpan was just the size I was looking for to clean up small bits of food my cat leaves on the ground around his bowl.
The only issue I have is with the dust pan design. Due to the pan/broom design having a hole to hang it up, if you don't GENTLY whisk the bits up into the pan, the bits go right into the hole and into your hand or back on the floor. The pan handle area does not have a raised area with a lower area for the dirt/bits (like most dust pan designs) to go into. If this had better pan design to help stop bits from going into the hole, I'd give this 5 stars for being small & effective.
However, I will return this and get a slightly larger boom/pan option that has a better dust pan on it so I don't have to double sweep my bits off the floor.

title: Difference between old and new.
text: I ordered the first package (an 8 oz bag) in June of 2017, and it sat around for quite awhile, because I had no idea what to do with it. Fast forward to the beginning of 2019 and I drastically changed my diet. I began using the cricket flour to make “bread” as I’m avoiding other flour substitutes. The flour was very finely ground and had an amazing sort of nutty flavor and a slightly chewy texture after being baked. I loved it! I went through the 8 oz bag quickly, and ordered a 16 oz bag. I was very disappointed that the texture was more of a meal rather than a flour, and the flavor was still a little nutty, there was a distinct “earthy” taste, maybe even a little like dirt. The texture after the bake was crumbly instead of chewy, and I was just disappointed. Three stars are because I have no idea what the first bag was like when I first bought it, because it sat around for so long. Maybe it’s like this when it’s fresh? Unfortunately at this time, I’m unable to purchase another bag to see if maybe each batch is different, because it is a little cost prohibitive.

title: MILAGE OF 35 MILES ON A CHARGE!
text:
So far I love it. Haven't actually gone "on the road" yet, just around my parking lot. It is still too cold. BUT one thing you NEED to know: It has a hand brake, it works fine, it does NOT have electromagnetic brake that engages like other mobility scooters. When you stop the throttle, it doesn't stop unless you use the hand brake. Disconcerting the first time and it is something I'll have to learn. All my other scooters stopped. Learning curve at 68 lol. I LOVE that it folds up and stands on end for storing it in the house. This can not be beat! All the others I had were just a big THUMB in my living room. Not this one! You can not beat the mileage on this scooter compared to ANY other scooter that isn't the size of a small car. I will update this review when I start my travels. IF the darn weather will get on my side!
EDIT AFTER SCOOTING: Pros: it does go and fast when needed for crossing streets or getting up hills. Very responsive. Cons: Be aware that there is springs on the front wheel (why is beyond me) but there is nothing on the rear. The seat is ultra flat and ultra hard. No dip at all to keep your but centered if you go over areas like uneven sidewalk or the dreaded dips for rain drainage. VERY jolting. I was thrilled that this scooter I could use on sidewalks and not have to worry about no curb cut outs for handicapped people since I could get off, grab the front bar, turn it around and roll it off and cross the street and pop it back up. I'm fairly sure I will have to go back to driving alleys. Really bummed at this. Some kind of spring or even a seat that gives would have made this scooter so much better. I'm 133lbs so not really a light weight at 4'9" and when I go over things that make the scooter jolt I'm bouncing all over the seat and have to constantly reposition. Other than those cons, I love it more than any of the other 8 scooters I've had over the years. I'll update if I come up with more to say :D

Was concerned the 24” would clog between uses but haven’t had that happen sitting as long as week between uses. Flows well, I did 2 applications a week  apart on a Resto project wanted the first coat to set up and the second to fill any little pin holes there might be, really didn’t think it was necessary after seeing first coat but I’m anal. I usually hit areas with rust converter then an anti-rust coating like Eastwood’s hd anti-rust coating, then this stuff. It’s made in Sweden figure they must know how to deal with snow and rust...only “con” the 24” nozzle sprays mostly out in a 360 degree circle not much out the front. Which makes it difficult to get into tight corners like frt and rear of doors w/o flooding them with wax.  I’ll definitely buy more and cut nozzle off of next 24” ext. for pin point application w/o wasting product. I live in northeast so plenty of experience dealing with rust repair and prevention. Short of sandblasting, media blasting, and epoxy primering. I think this is the best approach to rust treatment for inside panels. Granted rust will always come back, but have plenty of past experience with rubberized undercoating ( drys out and cracks trapping moisture underneath increasing rust) fluid film ( need to reapply regularly) Never get more than maybe 2 yrs out of these type products, then you have to scrap an pressure wash and dry before re-applying. Jury’s still out on what to put on frames, underbody etc. Right now leaning towards spraying hd anti-rust coating in them, messy but doesn’t harden and crack or hold road film etc so the-coating is easier.

title: Different modes is a lifesaver!!!
text:
[[VIDEOID:2503f28f7245c4a1fa841214322eeb3c]] My friend recommended this pump. I really like the ability to change settings depending on my flow. Sometimes I can just stay on the massage or switch to the deep express mode. You may know the "massage" mode as the let down phase in other pumps. The cool thing about this pump is that it has a setting where its both of these!!! The massage (or let down) with the deep express mode. I saw from another reviewer you can use Lansinoh bottles too ❤

In the video I show L1 vs L5 vs L9. If you're like me, I can't go straight to express mode, nothing will come out or it will but then my flow stops. Leading me to think my breast are empty. If you change to the massage mode then viola milk is flowing again. However, staying on the massage mode will take forever to empty my breast so the combo has been amazing. You can also adjust how long its in massage mode to when it does deep suction. L1 is the longest time for massage with an expression/ pull at the end. L9 is the shortest time for massage then express.

You can play with the settings to see what works for you. I like to keep a mirror handy so I can see when my flow stops then I can change different modes to get the milk out. Sometime one 30 min session is not enough (for me personally, everyone is different) and I need to go back for round two on the same breast.

What I dislike about this pump is there is no where on the sellers store to purchase spare parts. They give you an extra duckbill valve but thats it. Also I noticed milk sometimes gets trapped on the top cup thing (where I'm pointing my finger in the picture). I just have to carefully pull the pump off while I'm aiming it over the bottle to save those few milliliters of milk. Lastly, the battery life kind of sucks. I noticed I get two 30 min sessions when its green/full. Then two 30 min sessions for orange and the same for red. Using it on both breast translates to just 3 pumping sessions. However, you could still pump when it's plugged in charging.

title: Not such a good shaver for the money!
text:
This is not a very good shaver for the money (costs less at $29 than most replacement heads). You have to give it at least 2 weeks for your face to become used to it. It is hard to shave close under your nose and sideburns (attachment good for sideburns but small pop-up trimmer on back doesn't work great), but on the straightaway like the sides of your face, it shaves great. Opening the four heads for cleaning is a bit tricky and you have to make certain when locking them back in place that both sides are clicked tight or you'll have a rough shave. The fifth one in the middle doesn't seem to open for cleaning purposes so you must be that running water hard to clean it. Watch that you don't unscrew the nose trimmer when taking it off or you may think you broke it. Also watch the stand as it's not real stable and you want to turn off the bathroom lights to make certain the charge light is on (you can't see it otherwise). One final caveat, the front third of the front of the shaver is the on-off switch, so you'll find yourself turning off the shaver as you're using it unless you turn the shaver sideways so your thumb is not on the switch.

UPDATE: After using this shaver for a longer length of time, I came to realize that my initial more positive reaction to this new design (I had given it a 4 star rating) simply did not play out. It simply doesn't shave close except on the "straightaways". Part of the problem may be that the motor is powering 5 cutting heads, so it cannot provide the RPMs of most other designs. I actually returned the unit and purchased Aoohe's 3 cutting head IPX7 which can now, I see, be purchased under the Aooeou4D Rotary IPX7 designation on Amazon (this may be an updated design--hard to tell as everything looks the same). It is much smoother shaving, the ear trimmer works much better, and the on-off button is smaller so you're not turning the unit on and off by accident while shaving. I was lucky and got the IPX7 on a one day sale on Amazon at $20 (perhaps they were closing them out with a new model on the way). I understand the replacement head can be purchased for around $6. While the IPX7 cannot realistically compete with the Panasonic's or Brauns which cost at least 3-4 times more, which I've used in the past, the price is irresistible making the IPX7 a very good buy.

Each pair was separated by protective cloth bags, which are perfect to transport them from place to place.
