title: I wish I had this before!
text:
This product is simply amazing. Having heard about it in 2006, I was intrigued to purchase it at that time. However, people complained that the volume was too low and that the buttons would be pressed during your sleep. I decided at the time that I wasn't going to pay $150 for something that had these problems.

In December of 2007, I came upon the new and improved Sleeptracker Pro. It was supposed to improve all the problems that were present in the original Sleeptracker and adds even more needed features. The best improvement by far is the vibration feature.

I have been using this Sleeptracker for 3 weeks straight. Out of the 21 days I have tested it, there has not yet been any day where it did not find an "almost-awake" moment (using a 30 minute window). However, of those 21 days, 2 days I slept through the alarm. This is not the fault of the product, but rather my fault because I only average 4-5 hours of sleep a night. Make sure you setup a backup alarm just incase you happen to sleep through this alarm.

But yes, considering I get on average only 4-5 hours of sleep a night, I can confidently say that 19/21 days I have woken up FANTASTICALLY. Every day I wake up feeling refreshed and ready to go.

I highly recommend you give this product a try. I can almost guarantee that you WILL be addicted to it and wonder how you ever lived without it. This is one of those products which can truly change the way you live, and one day you will look back at the "old days" where people woke up to a fixed alarm.

As a person who likes to keep their head shaved, let me tell you that I've used a handful of these types of units, and this one by far has been the best. I've had it for over 2 weeks now, shaving every other day and I

But this shaver is already holding up better than the others I've tried, and I actually look forward to shaving. If you're overwhelmed by the number of shavers on the market, give this one a go!

title: I'm relatively immune to sunburn (olive skin) but my better half is very fair skinned and burns very quickly ...
text:
Honestly, I didn't expect this stuff to work. I'm relatively immune to sunburn (olive skin) but my better half is very fair skinned and burns very quickly even in New England, when the offer came up for it for free in return for an honest review, I figured we would give it a shot. She tried this stuff out and was able to stay out in the sun about an average of 30 minutes longer than normal (or about 33 minutes, lol) without significant burning. After that, I had to check out the science and sure enough, there's enough studies out there that back this up.

A study in persons with Phototype II or III skin (non-pale white persons) exposed to UV rays who did not otherwise have skin conditions noted that 7.5mg/kg Polypodium Leucotomos taken the night previous to testing was able to delay the rate of which the skin reddens (erythema) alongside a reduction in mast cell infiltration. Although a preservation of Langerhans cells (related to the immune system) has been noted previously associated with Polypodium Leucotomos in animals and humans, this study merely noted a trend
One of the few controlled trials on the matter note reduced DNA damage secondary to UV(A) radiation, where in measuring levels of the common deletion (CD) of a 4977 base-pair mitochondiral DNA (used as a biomarker for UV(A)-induced damage) where the amount of CD induction at twice the level of UVA required to induce reddening (217% in control relative to baseline) was reduced by 86%, and the induction at thrice the level (760% of baseline) was reduced 61%. Unfortunately, these results were not statistically significant (P values of 0.06 and 0.07; respectively), and beyond this controlled trial mostly case studies exist.

Appears to be somewhat effective in protecting the skin against the damage induced by ultraviolet radiation, although larger and more well controlled trials are needed. The trends suggest that it can reduce reddening and reduce the rate of which skin burns in the sunlight.

I do NOT give positive reviews for products that I don't think deserve them, no matter what the cost is. If you are fair skinned, this just might be the solution to let you stay outside in the sun longer without discomfort.

title: Trust me - Microwave this one!
text:
Trust me on this one....Generally protein bars are a nutritional quick meal or snack, and for many of Julian Bakery's other products that is the case, but this particular flavor is not too tasty right out of the package and the texture can be really hard (not to mention, sometimes the product is really oily).

I've heard people microwaving their protein bars and had never tried it, but it completely changed the texture and flavor of this bar to something I actually really enjoy and look forward to each day. I use a paper towel to remove excess oil from the bar when it first comes out of the package, place it on a microwave-safe plate, microwave it for about 20 seconds on high (you'll see it balloon similar to a marshmallow would) and when you remove it the bar is gooey and you can pull it apart with your fingers and it's quite yummy (albeit, a bit of a mess, but nothing major). One note, don't let it cool for too long or it will get hard again, although you can bring it back to life in the microwave.

Honestly, I've microwaved a few bars now and it's a real game-changer!

title: Germ Guardian creating formaldehyde?!
text:
I'm afraid this product is breaking down mold spores into aldehydes, like formaldehyde.

We purchased two and they arrived yesterday. We plugged one in underneath our sink where it smelled like mildew. This morning, the mildew smell is gone, which is great, but there is an unusually strong sweet smell in its place and my face started to tingle and feel weird when I looked underneath the sink.

I read two studies this morning that report that the combination of UV-C and titanium dioxide (or PCO (Photocatalytic Oxidiation) which is what powers this GermGuardian) does indeed break down mold spores and VOCs...but it breaks them down into simple molecules like formaldehyde and other aldehydes:

2008
Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory
"The researchers found that because of incomplete decomposition of the VOC's in the inlet air stream there was a net production of formaldehyde, acetaldehyde, formic acid and acetic acid. Of particular concern was that the outlet concentrations of formaldehyde and acetaldehyde were 3.4 and 4.6 times the inlet concentrations, respectively. Both formaldehyde and acetaldehyde are recognized as important indoor toxicants. Formaldehyde is classified as a human carcinogen."

2015
Science Daily source Concordia University
"Imagine if, in an effort to clean the air more efficiently, you were involuntarily introducing chemicals more dangerous than the ones you were trying to scrub. Concordia University researchers have found that this exact situation is happening with a type of air filter called photocatalytic oxidation (PCO), a product already on the market. The chemical by-product? Formaldehyde, a known human carcinogen."

I'd like to hear from the GermGuardian people about this. It looks like a very serious health hazard that is created by these devices.

I want to start by saying that 1.) I was not paid for this review, and 2.) I love protein bars.

I love them.

title: Dentist says my child has "plaque-key" teeth.
text:
My child is not brushing well enough. First of all she has a small jaw and lots of teeth. Her first tooth did not fall out until she was 7. So we have lots of crowded teeth to clean. We took her to the Dentist and after 6 teeth being removed he told us that she has "plaque-key" teeth (too much plaque still on her teeth). I bought these tablets because I remember when I was a kid and I had to chew them at the dentist to show me where I was not brushing well. It worked well for me when I was a kid because I remember looking at my purple teeth and thinking "yuk". It did motivate me to brush better.
What I like best about these little tablets is that I can watch her chewing the tablet and after I get to see all the spots she is not brushing well. I'm a teacher and I know that research show that children think in pictures so I believe this is a brilliant way to show kids about where bacteria and plaques hide. My child had not yet grasped the concept of plaque before we started doing the tablets but now she can "see" the plaque because its purple. These are small purple tablets so once the child chews the tablet (do not swallow), then they rinse their mouth out and the plaque turns purple. Now the good part: they have to go back and brush all the purple stuff off.

title: My butt no longer hurts!
text:
I was very skeptical about this product, and it does have a hefty price tag on it. After debating for a long time I finally ordered one for my office chair. I sit for up to 8 hours a day and as a person with no natural butt cushion, I typically felt like my tailbone was falling off. After the first DAY of sitting on this wonderful 2" deep Purple seat cushion I no longer had pains in my tailbone. I felt like I was sitting on a fantasy cloud cushion. I never thought I would get this type of relief, and if I could go back in time I would demand myself to buy one sooner. 5 years of pain gone in 1 day, so happy with it.

It is made from a silicone/ gel type material on the inside, but it does come with a very stretch cloth cover to keep stuff out of its honey combed structure. The cover is machine washable and the inside is washed by hand with soap. It has a "new material" smell to it that isn't the best, but you're sitting on it anyway so why does it need to smell good, you can't smell it when you are sitting on it as the smell isn't that strong. With the heft and the type of material it can be a little bit of a struggle to get the cover on, but it wasn't as difficult as I worried it might be. The bottom of the cover has a hexagon shaped non-slip surface on it that is the best non-slip material I have ever had (they should make shoes from it). The cover also has handles on both sides and half rolls very well so you can carry it around a bit like a grocery bag which I was not expecting. I do sometimes carry it home to use in college as well, but this one is a bit heavy for that (it is 2" deep, I'd guess its at 8-12lbs) so I would considered getting a thin one for travel needs.

I would highly recommend this product to anyone who sits for long periods of time, it will make you behind so happy.

title: The banana flavor is on point and mixes well with various fruits and oat mixtures.
text:
I have only recently started using whey protein in my smoothies and in my overnight oats. I have tried a few other cheap proteins from my local grocer and I could not get over the odd tastes.
This whey protein from Athletic Greens is very good. It does not have that bitter after taste that I have noticed with cheaper varieties. The banana flavor is on point and mixes well with various fruits and oat mixtures. I think it would also be great in some whole wheat cookies or pancakes. I find that the protein helps me to feel fuller and I can go longer between meals with fewer snacks when I am consuming it.
I love love love that this protein is made from 100% grass fed cows. It is all natural and that means NO GMO's, no herbicides, no pesticides, no synthetic chemicals, no artificial colors or flavors, and no preservatives or sweeteners. I am saying YES to all of those no's.
If you are someone with one or multiple food allergies then this protein is great because it has no dairy, gluten, corn, sucrose, dextrose, eggs, or peanuts. I think they pretty much covered the gamut of food allergies there.
My oldest daughter refuses to eat most meats. I have tried supplementing her diet with Pediasure to fill in the nutritional gaps but she does not like the taste and she says the drinks are, "for babies". I am able to get her to drink some of my smoothie without much persuasion and she has no idea that she is getting protein along with all of the other nutrient packed fruits and veggies. She just knows that it tastes good.
I can whole heartedly recommend this protein. This stuff is amazing.
I purchased this item at a discount in exchange for this honest and unbiased review. These thoughts and opinions are entirely my own and were not influenced by my purchase price or any discount received to buy and review this product. I only recommend or endorse an item after I have tried it, after I have thoroughly inspected it and its ingredients, AND I must genuinely like the item.

title: The watch came in a basic but nice black window top box
text:
The watch came in a basic but nice black window top box. Inside the box, the watch sat on top of a small pillow with a cleaning cloth underneath. The watch is easy to set both time and date, just pull the pin and twist. I really like the look of the two toned wood and the face is really easy to read. There are numbers along the outer edge of the face, the numbers are low profile and almost not noticeable unless you look for them. This gives the watch a classy look while making it simple to tell the time. This is the lightest weight watch my husband has ever worn, but it was also way too big for his wrist. He has medium to large sized wrists for a 300lb man and he had to remove 2 links to get the fit he liked (He prefers his watches not to move at all when being worn). The links themselves were simple enough to remove with a couple screwdrivers, a small hammer, and a pair of needle nose pliers. So far it feels well built and he absolutely loves how light it is. An excellent value for the price!!!

I received a discount for my honest and true review and honestly, I would most certainly purchase this watch again as a gift for any man. The only downside was the links were a little hard to remove but I still like that it had the extra links for adjustability.

EDIT to ADD: My husband's watch had the glass pop out after a few days of use but the company was kind enough to replace the watch for me and my husband still loves it!! Top Notch company! Thank you again for helping us out.

text:
“This item was sponsored to me by Bundle Monster in exchange for my honest review.”

This is my first sponsored product for me to review, Thank You Bundle Monster for choosing me to sponsor your products!

These stamping polishes are great, they stamp very good, polish is opaque and don't need to use a lot for stamping and I love that. The smell is not overbearing. I have to say if you are one looking for polish that will stamp over black then I can tell you only 2 out of the colors that shows really good over black is Iced Silver (17) & Liquid Gold (26) and of coarse Angelic White (1). The Royal Blue (24) & Crimson Red (5) are great over lighter to medium base colors. The Noir Black (13) is a must have if you are only looking for black stamping polish or the Angelic White. The price of the Set 1 is a great price and I highly recommend this set to anyone that is looking for stamping polish at a reasonable price. They also sell individually if you are not wanting to buy the set. visit their website [...] and check out their products. I have bought from them many times and have been happy how their products work.

The only cons with this set is the Royal Blue & Crimson Red didn't show as good over black.
also they put numbers on the bottles instead of the names.

The pros is the price, great for anyone looking for stamping polish that is within their budget.
and quality of the polish for the price.

Thanks Bundle Monster for letting me be a sponsor for your products. Can't wait to do more for you. I really enjoyed doing it.

HAPPY STAMPING!! :)

title: This thing is STRONG
text: First-time water flosser here, and I do have to say, it is taking a while to get used to. I have it set to the sensitive setting and it still stings my gums! Granted, I am pregnant and haven't had the best dental hygiene during my pregnancy (I throw up constantly and sometimes, gagging while brushing my teeth just isn't worth it) but I have been pretty surprised by how painful this feels. Does it have enough strength to blast away gunk stuck in my teeth? YES. As others have mentioned, the water basin is kinda small and doesn't last but more than a full cleaning, but I also would be the type to change out the water anyways, so it doesn't bother me. Because I am new to water flossing, I didn't expect the setting to shoot out water in sporadic episodes, ie, it's not like a constant outflow of water hitting your teeth. I'm guessing this is so you can move from tooth to tooth without a flow but I haven't mastered doing it quick enough yet. The first time I did it, I sprayed water all over my mirror, sink and face. I'm still getting used to it and not totally sure this method is for me, but I think it's a very powerful, well-made option for those looking to water floss.

This is a sTurdy and nifty little item. Similar to those mount phone holders for the car, but this is great for anywhere bc it has a strong clamp which has a felt lining so it won't dig into whatever it is clamped on. I will say that it is pretty strong and therefore difficult to open without applying a good amount of pressure. May be difficult for ppl with carpal tunnel, arthritic, weak wrists/fingers, etc.
once you get it clamped on, the neck of the item is very adjustable to twist into whichever position you need it. This also is very durable and strong, but likewise is tough to twist without applying a good Amount of pressure. Once you twist it to your liking though, it won't budge.
I currently have it clamped to the wooden frame of my bed and it twists along the side of the bed. I don't have a side table within reach, and this allows me to keep the phone out from under my pillow and still within arms reach, I can use it to turn on YouTube or any other listening app to help fall asleep.
I really like this gadget. I don't ever foresee it going into the bathroom, but then again I don't spend ages using the toilet and don't take long baths (2 scenarios which would seem plausible to have this in the loo with you, ). Very sturdy and holds very well. I bought this while it was on sale, but I think a good price point for it would be $10-$12 . I may need another on in the future to use in another bedroom . title: Keeps mouth shut but can't get comfortable
text:
I haven't made up my mind about this product. It does a great job of keeping my mouth shut, but I struggle to get it adjusted just right.

The first night or two, the front slipped down over my eye brows. I could pull it back, but this would wake me up, etc. Also, the side edge of the cap rubbed along my ears, which was irritating. I folded the front and side edge up inside the cap and fastened it with masking tape. Worked fine for a week until I noticed that the glue on the tape had melted and slimed the cap and my head. I finally got the glue off, but I frankly don't recommend this method. No. Not at all.

In the midst of all this, I used four safety pins along the top of the cap from front to back to take up some of the fabric so that the sides wouldn't rub my ears. It worked, but it felt like I had lost some stability and that the cap was getting to be more like a piece of fabric strapped to the top of my head than a cap. I removed them when I de-slimed the cap just so I could start over with a "clean" cap.

And then there are the side straps. Like the bottom cap edge, the back edge of the straps rubbed my ears. If I repositioned them forward, they would pull the cap down in front (see above). Still, the loop patch on the straps barely overlapped the hook patch on the cap. It held, but perhaps the patch on the cap should extend further back.

The hook patches being so far forward might indicate that I need a larger size (is there one?) so that they would be further back and match up with the loop patch on the straps; however, the cap sides being so low indicates that maybe I need a smaller cap. I'll probably try wearing it again, but I my home-made chin strap, although not perfect, works better.

title: Easy to install, looks very nice
text:
UPDATE: The unit has been working for two weeks, and not only performs as advertised, it performs better than we expected. We are sensitive to mold spores and other allergens, to the point that we can begin choking & coughing within 1 minute of walking into any environment with these in the air. We both stopped coughing and choking within 1 day of installation, and now it only happens when we actually LEAVE the house! Our inside air is no longer causing us breathing problems. I'm raising my rating to 5 stars because of this observation. GREAT PRODUCT!
Original rating - 4 stars:
Bought this to combat COVID. Order fulfillment,, shipping,, delivery, and packaging are outstanding. Installed today on the output duct just above the plenum so it can kill any fungus and bacteria that forms on the exchanger - especially in air conditioning season.
1st thing I noticed is that the template included in the package is the incorrect size for the unit. If used, the unit will NOT assemble to the furnace. I made another template, adding only 10 minutes to the installation time. 2nd thing I noticed is that the Phillips head screws included in the package are poor thread quality, and the wrong size. The heads don't fit into the keyhole because they're too big. The difference between the thread size and the shank diameter is too small, so once they've gone into the hole, they just spin and won't tighten. I used heavier threaded HVAC hex-head screws I had on hand, and they held just fine. Third thing I noticed is the electrical plug on the power cord sticks straight out into the walkway. Just a minor irritant for now, but I'll have to cut it off and replace it with a right-angle plug before the wife catches it with the laundry basket and pulls it out of the receptacle! 4th thing I noticed is the two green LEDs are labeled Right and Left, but the lamps are Upper and Lower, not right and left. Also, there's no way to identify which bulb belongs to which LED - I certainly won't look to see, because it'll burn out my eyeballs! 5th thing I noted is that the lower lamp socket appears to have been assembled upside down. If the locking mechanism ever fails, the bulb will easily fall into the duct because there is no support for it other than the pin lock. If the upper one fails, the socket walls look like they'll still hold the bulb in place.
Overall, this unit is SUPER easy to install. Total time from unboxing to installation completed was less than 45 minutes, including the making of a new template and getting replacement screws. I'll update this review based on its performance at a later date, probably about 3 - 6 months from now.

title: Quality fish oil at a quality price
text: Been using this stuff for about 3 years now. Taken it between 3-5 times a week. No particular health issues I was trying to address simply attempting to get more omega 3's in my diet. When I set out on my search to find a quality fish oil I, like many others, scoured the internet sites that run lab tests on every fish oil under the sun. I wanted to find something that was really high quality and didn't break the bank... well this is the one I landed on. If you've seen the documentary about wild fish populations sponsored by Patagonia you'll well know that due to the escape/release of farmed fish into the wild it is nearly impossible to obtain truly "wild" fish that haven't had their genetics "watered down" so take that for what you will. But I will say that this stuff boasts some pretty great numbers in terms of omega-3 to omega-6 ratio and heavy metal quantity. It tastes great and is easy to drink on it's own if that's your prerogative, just make sure to gently slosh it a bit before every pour or you'll have some merky concentrated stuff towards the end of the bottle. As for the effects, I can't say I notice a difference between the days I take it and the days I don't but I have no doubt it is contributing to my overall long-term health... which is the ultimate goal, right? I've enjoyed this fish oil and I'll keep buying it until I find something better, and if I do I'll be back to update this review.

We have mini sewing kits that we give to guests when they ask for them but I didn't have one on me. I remembered that a guest had thrown out a sewing kit in a little red box. I had thought they just needed it for a one time fix and kept it on my cart. Now I know why they really threw it out. First thing I noticed when I opened it up was that the needles were thick. For a second I thought they might be spares for a sewing machine. I picked the thinnest one (which still was just as thick as a push pin) and tried to thread it. I couldn't get the thread through like a normal needle so I looked closer and realized it was a One Second Needle. I checked the box it came in and saw that one of the plastic inserts had the name there. I decided I would try it out. I tried threading it like they did on tv. You have to yank on the thread in order to get it through the eye. I broke the thread twice before doing it right. When I tried sewing the button back on it confirmed what I had originally thought. It snagged the fabric and not only that but it also left holes it went through because of how thick it was. Needless to say I threw out the needles and kept the rest of the kit. And after a while, I don't know if the formula improved or what but they now feel even better then the curad for sensitive skin ones ever did!! And so much cheaper, thank God! It's so expensive needing to use a bandage 24-7.  my only complaint about these would be, I do wish they would restick more, so I wouldn't have to go through so many a day, having to change it every time or every other time I catheterize,  which is a lot having IC. title: Very comfortable, even while sleeping.
text: I use these to tame my wild tresses by washing my hair the night before and then quickly damp setting it in this funny but effective curling system. I frequently don't even use additional styling products on my hair, except for leave-in conditioning sometimes and it gives me great results each time. I just set it and sleep. It is that simple. The resultant curls are soft and springy ringlets that last all day long that I can simply run my fingers through and go the next morning. It is all padded and has a slick surface, so my hair does not get tangled in it, except occasionally when the tips of my hair are dry and stick in the hair band portion, as is common and expected with long hair anyway. The hairband portions on the tips of each segment are about the size of a medium cloth-covered hair band, and they are more than sufficient to firmly but gently hold the ends of even the thickest locks through the night. And, yes, I sleep in these quite easily. The adjustable band goes around your head as gently or tightly as you desire and is secured in place with velcro. I prefer mine to have a more gentle hold, so oftentimes it comes off my forehead during the night, but my wrapped hair keeps it from coming off completely. So far, it doesn't seem to affect my results when the band slips upwards off of my forehead. It does make it a bit more challenging when removing it, but even that is far easier than dealing with other forms of curling systems that I've tried. If you prefer to have fewer or looser ringlets, you can remove individual cushioned curling bases and use thicker hair segments for the remaining ones. It is that easy. I'd be hard-pressed to find a simpler or more effective way to get lovely ringlets without using harmful curling and styling products. These are silly looking on me at night, but make me look and feel great the next day.

title: Best Sleep Mask I've Ever Had
text: I wanted to wait until I'd had a chance to use this for several nights before reviewing, and be able to try with and without earplugs, as I'd noticed someone mention that it blocked sound. I do really like this sleep mask. I like the fact that I can adjust the Velcro to a fit without it having elastic. I've tried other sleep masks and the elastic weakened easily and I had to wind up tying it to keep it from slipping off my head. This doesn't have elastic so it's not going to lose any thing, it will stay where you put it. Depending on how you secure it on there may or may not be light coming through from under the bottom curve of the nose area, but you can adjust and "squench" it till most, if not all, light is blocked. I does muffle sound but I wouldn't say it blocks it, I still require most nights with ear plugs(loud bunnies that scratch and dig at night), but I have gone without earplugs a couple of times just fine. I love the fact it encompasses your whole head and because of that and that it's that silky type material, it's less likely to cause random severe hair bumps when you wake up. I've got shorter hair right now and elastic bad eye masks crimped and kinked my hair into weird shapes. With this mask, the most hair issue I've had is around the crown of my head where it poofs out of the top but that is easily tamed back down with a splash of water. The only con is a personal thing. In other masks I've had there's been like a bubble for your eyes to move without feeling squished. This mask doesn't squish, it's just flat fabric on your eyes, but it's not bubbled out. This mask is comfortable all around and has more benefits than cons, hands down. I'd definitely recommend this mask out of all the one's I've tried.

title: Not Antibacterial or anti-viral, scam?
text:
Agreed with most recent review. Not as pictured and have no idea if antibacterial. Contains no ingredients as listed. Seems to be a scam.

“Old stock - not as pictured. No idea if this is indeed antibacterial or antiviral.
The seller used a photo of newer packaging in the listing which is misleading. The product I received appears to be unused old stock. See photos attached - very similar packaging, EXCEPT the yellow arrow that states 'kills 99% of bacteria and viruses' only states CLEANS & FRESHENS! Always in Reach.

According to the label, the product I received does contain Alkyl Dimethylbenzyl Ammonium Chloride (which will kill a few germs according to Wikipedia), however it does not call it an 'active ingredient' nor list the percentage of this chemical in relation to the overall volume of liquid. Who knows - maybe this stuff is better than the new version?

Pump operation works fine, cardboard shipping boxes are heavy duty and product arrived in good condition. One caveat - this stuff is so heavily scented that there's probably enough perfume in the bottle to kill the germs if indeed the 'active ingredient' isn't so active. So if you're sensitive to perfumes, look for something else.

Normally due to the listing error, I'd give a one star review and send the product back to Amazon for a refund. However given the craziness that is our world this week, I'm going to keep the product and use it hoping it works.”

title: Make sure it's sealed!
text:
I bought two because I have two breasts and not enough time to pump one at a time, and they have been awesome! I bought them in anticipation of my new job and getting back into the office, away from the baby, and with zero interest in bringing the full size pump with all the tubes and bottles and - no thank you! Tried them out a few times at home first and liked them already - just watch out for the suction level! The suction on these is HIGH. The levels do not match levels on your other pumps! On my full size pump, I'm usually at an 8 out of 12 of the suction levels but on these pumps, I use a 3 SOMETIMES a 4 and that's sparingly. Trust me, I tried level 5 one day and ended up with tears on my nipples, which took a few days to heal. Start low, work your way up, use some sort of lubricant if you want.

That said, I pumped at work the first time and leaked out about two ounces all over myself. On my first day. Make absolutely sure, beyond a doubt, that the parts are sealed together very well. It's not hard to put it together, but it's also a little too easy for the seal to become broken at the bottom, allowing your liquid gold to leak all over your clothing. These pumps allow me to pump on my drive to drop the baby off at my mom's, providing him with a fresh bottle when we get there. They are not discreet in profile (the pumps stick up and it's obvious there's something in your shirt) or in noise level - they are appropriately loud, not like jet engine level but also can be heard in a phone call. The batteries last a decent amount of time - almost two hours of pump time. They do take a decent amount of time to charge, but not unreasonable.

Now for the real question - does it compare to a full size pump in how much milk is collected? Almost. This is going to be different for all of us due to many different aspects, but for me, it pumps maybe an ounce or two less per session than my full size pump.

One small thing - if you get two, the pump cycles will never line up. No matter how precise you are at starting them at exactly the same time, they will never sync up. Or they will sync up for a few moments and eventually fall out of sync. This is a tiny thing but if the sound of these pumps can potentially bother you, that's something to keep in mind.

Overall, these are a wonderful option for portable pumps. Get yourself a lunch bag, some ziplock bags; or better yet some wet dry bags, and some good ice packs and you're ready to pump on the go.

title: Almost Perfect Dairy Free Protein Powder
text:
(this is for the Chocolate Fudge Brownie flavour - I have not tried others)

The people on here complaining about the flavour have clearly not experimented too much with non-dairy protein powders. I have tried SO many different protein powders. I have followed a vegan diet in the past and used many different vegan powders, and I have also been a competitive bodybuilder and used many different kinds of whey and casein powders.

This is, hands down, the best *non-dairy* protein powder I have used - both texturally and flavour. Like a previous review said - if you are looking for this to essentially taste like a child's milkshake, then you wont be pleased (but bear in mind all the things that make it taste that great are probably not great for you). This protein powder tastes good. You're not going to write home about it, but it IS good. And it mixes beautifully, and has a smooth texture (unlike every horrible vegan protein powder out there).

But the best part is that it does not upset my stomach. I have a very sensitive stomach and currently have to follow a carnivore diet because of it, and this protein powder is seriously a miracle for me.

I have also heard great things about the customization options that this brand has through their website, but I have yet to check that out. Will definitely be ordering the 5lb bag!

I merely say it's not perfect only because I'm not a huge fan of stevia or sunflower lecithan, but I also understand that sometimes options are limited when you are creating specialty items, and based on my stomach's reactions I would say those ingredients are minimal.

text:
This review is my own and was not requested or solicited in anyway from any source below. It is a long review in order to help those that might be suffering on a more severe level. I go into some details in hopes of helping even just one person.

I suffer from PTSD, anxiety, ADHD and a lifetime of Nightmares/tares. I was getting LENS Treatment but it was costing me over $100 a session. The lens treatment takes around 5 to 7 min. for the therapist to set it up, and the treatment last around 30 seconds or less. The results however were profound. I was skeptical to try this treatment but at the same time desperate for help that might actually do something for me, and after just one session I noticed a significant change, and after several more treatments the changes just kept getting better. I had no idea just how much I was suffering until I experienced relief.

People often tell people that are suffering from depression to get up and start doing things and it will solve itself, or they are depressed because they lay in bed all day, thereby creating the problem themselves. I would have not even considered myself depressed as I was taught mental illness is made up, and no one suffers from it. I was taught people make it up. I was taught this at a young age and therefore believed it for the better part of my life. All I can say is I made myself do all the things I was supposed to do daily. No one would have considered me depressed including myself. I never lay in bed, but I will admit I wanted to. It is exhausting forcing a smile, pretending to laugh when others laugh but I will admit I have spent a lifetime doing this. When I was out all I could think about was wishing I were back home. I confided in one of my friends years back, saying: “I don’t know what it means to have fun.” and they didn't understand that statement so I just dropped it. I had no idea that others didn't feel the same as myself. This was my normal, and all I ever knew. After several LENS sessions I realized I enjoyed cooking, something I had detested before. So many things became enjoyable. Naturally I found myself having fun or enjoying myself, a very foreign concept to me before the LENS treatments. The LENS treatments for me personally feel like they remove some heavy film or static like feeling from over my brain. A peace washes over me.

However after a few months I was very much in debt and my credit cards maxed out. I could no longer afford more treatments and as the horror of the feelings began to settle back over me I began a search for some other form of treatment. Something that might help me so I wouldn’t have to suffer again. I didn't want to slip back into the hell I had been living all my life. Having experienced the changes I was now more desperate then ever to not slip back into that lifestyle. I wake up each morning with severe anxiety attacks. I toss and turn and can’t sleep. One of my searches led me to this unit: The David Delight Pro. It was expensive but the reviews seemed promising. It would cost me about 5 weeks worth of treatments but perhaps be longer lasting. So I ordered the unit, as well as the extra nice glasses. My glasses don’t work but I can’t make myself call in and complain so I just use the unit minus the glasses. I found one setting that works for me best and I use it each and every morning for a full hour.

I wake to severe anxiety attacks each morning and now I place my David Delight headset on and play games on my iPad for an hour while I listen. By the end of the hour, really the first 20 to 30 min on most days my anxiety is gone. But I enjoy the full hour so I listen until it shuts itself off. After the session ends I feel serene, calm, and at peace. I can start my morning projects with a real smile, and the best part is I get to enjoy my day.

I also suffer from nightmares or night terrors. About a week into using this unit, I awoke around 2am in the mornings with one of my nightmares, I knew if I fell back asleep the nightmare would simply start up right where it left off. I’ve tried staying up for 20 min. drinking cold water, eating something, and nothing helps. Once the nightmares start they stay with me for that night. But, I had a thought this night, so I reached for my David Delight Pro and slid it on, and allowed myself to simply go back to sleep. I awoke the next morning and to my great surprise the nightmares had not continued. Now, each time I awake to nightmares I slip on my David Delight Pro and they simply stop. Unless you suffer from night terrors or nightmares the relief of being able to escape this won’t make sense. But being able to fall back asleep and no longer have these awful nightmares is life changing. It is not noted on their site that it helps for this but for me it is a wonderful relief and I’m thrilled I stumbled on it. I hope it will help others. The setting I use for this: (Happy Face - #4) incase anyone who suffers from nightmares would like to try it too, or if you have kids that suffer from nightmares it might be worth a try. As a child I was tormented by the thought of going to sleep out of my fear of these night terrors. If this can help even one child that suffers from nightmares then this review will have been worth it. To me there is no describing how much these children suffer.

I also use the unit to help me with ADHD and focusing and it’s a huge help.

The David Delight Pro also helps me fall asleep and stay asleep for the night, unless I had a nightmare of course, but those seem to be getting less frequent now. I also use the unit to mediate which is wonderful and very relaxing. The David Delight Pro replaced LENS treatments for me and I feel it is every bit as affective and while it might be a large fee upfront it has more then paid itself off after a few months of use. I have been using this unit daily for several months now. This machine is worth every dime. I wish I had found it while I was still young, but I will be forever grateful I found it at all. I now get to enjoy a portion of my life in thanks to its inventors.
If you don’t have an hour each day I would like to point out that there are many days that I am rushed and can only listen for 20 Min. on such days. I still receive wonderful results, but I still prefer my hour-long sessions.

Recommended Reading:
The Book: Back In Control by Dr. David Hanscom
This book explains your brain, and your fight or flight system, how PTSD Works, something I had been diagnosed with but didn’t really understand until I read this book. It also explains the how and why we develop it. It’s a truly amazing read. While I don’t normally read these types of books I honestly think this should be required reading in school simply because it is so insightful and explains the human brain in an amazing straightforward fashion, and it’s empowering to understanding your own brain and your own diagnosis.

With the help of this book, and using my David Delight Pro to bring relief I can see and feel the difference in my daily life. For instance if something startled me before I was already being bathed in Cortisol from my long term PTSD, but now with the David Delight Pro to bring me relief each day I can now isolate the events that set off these attacks within me, understanding these events and what sets them off helps me in my recovery. I have found my anxiety is actually from my PTSD and what I have come to call “Cortisol Attacks” at this point. I can now feel the release when something scares me or sets off an attack. It’s my own thing and probably doesn’t make sense but it’s still what I like to call it.

This unit also works for me during these attacks as well:
Mental Shock if googled comes up with this definition:
Acute stress reaction (also called acute stress disorder, psychological shock, mental shock, or simply shock) is a psychological condition arising in response to a terrifying or traumatic event, or witnessing a traumatic event that induces a strong emotional response within the individual.

In conclusion:
While everyone is going to respond differently to different treatments or methods I feel that my experiences over several months was so profound it was worth writing a review in hopes of helping someone that might also be suffering to any degree. While I can’t guarantee it will work for everyone I do think it is worth a try if you are suffering. This device to me personally has given me a life to live instead of just surviving.

title: A Berry Bursting with Nutrients!
text:
This Peruvian Camu Camu powder by Maju Superfoods comes in a 4 oz container with a wide lid for easy access to the powdered contents. Included with it is a scoop for measuring. I've provided a few photos to show you the container once it arrived here, the next with the lid off showing the sealed top. Then, the last photo reveals the contents. I think the product has a nice rich color. I placed a dry teaspoon into the container to stir it a bit as I wanted to see how many clumps I could find and was happy to note there were no clumps! The ingredients state to be: 100% Certified Organic Camu Camu. Underneath the ingredients, it states - Allergen: Product may be packaged in facility that processes nuts. The label also states this is non-GMO!

Next, you have to use it to see what it's like, right? I normally go through a process with whole food powders: open, smell, and see if I think it's going to have to be chugged down quick! So, I smelled this Camu Camu powder and I really had to sniff it to get any noticeable odor and I can't describe it except to say, it isn't unpleasant. But then, I got to thinking with all that Vitamin C in it, this stuff is going to be really sour, as I'm thinking what plain Vitamin C powder is like (usually quite sour)! I placed one teaspoon of Camu Camu powder in a glass, added pure water and stirred. No clumping! This is great! No residue on the spoon from the powder (even better)! No noticeable odor! I took a sip...no bad taste! A very slight tartness, but I honestly couldn't taste much flavor either, but I might have had more water in there per teaspoon that made it watered down quite a bit for taste. It didn't leave residue in the glass so I knew I'd gotten the product in me instead of it stuck to a glass and washing it down the drain. There was no grittiness, so it mixed well. I have no negatives to report, only positives. If you happen to be a regular smoothie drinker or yogurt eater, I think you
could put a teaspoon of this in those and probably wouldn't notice it except for the added color it might display.

I can't tell you this did something terrific for my body in the short time I've used it because these things take time to notice, but, you know that. I've done my homework on Camu Camu. It's a great product loaded with nutrients. If you'll do a bit of research, I expect you'll be happy with what you read. This is an amazing berry, full of nutrients. I've read ounce for ounce, it has 50 times more Vitamin C than an orange and of course most of us know Vitamin C helps our bodies as an antioxidant and this is so much better for us since it is from a whole food source as opposed to manufactured Vitamin C. Plus, Camu Camu is loaded with other vitamins, amino acids, bioflavonoids, minerals and even beta carotene. I've read it's good for the eyes, helps the immune system, supports the circulatory system, helps the mental and nervous systems, detoxifies the liver, fights colds, helps heal viruses. Now, think of all the illnesses that fit into those categories and you have a product that is worth taking daily in order to build up those systems. Just remember, it takes consistently using a product over a period of time to see and feel a difference. Yes, these are berries ground into powder, but it is like eating a bunch of good berries...you are gaining those nutrients as a whole food complex. If you'll look into it, you'll find it's helpful for the skin and has many other uses and benefits not mentioned. So my conclusion is, it's a great product worth consuming every day to see what it will do for me. I received this product at a discount in exchange for an honest review and I'm glad to have had the opportunity to try it and to know this is a good brand, easy to drink and good for me.

title: Best curler I’ve ever used. Long lash solution.
text:
The only downside to this curler is that it’s hard to clean the clamp part. Other than that it’s an amazing curler. I dont imagine needing more than 3 settings. I use it every single day. I have rather long lashes that do not stay curled and this is the only type of curler that works for them. I look like I have had them permed or extended with this curler. Big fan.

My routine:

Pre-curl lightly just at the lash line. I use very minimal mascara after I do my eyeshadow. I then do my eyebrows. By the time those are done, my lashes are ready to be curled. The curler works best after dry mascara. I don’t tend to use the clamp part because I don’t like cleaning it, but it’s helpful for removing clumps and tangles before they get set in place by the mascara. The best way to use it is (after it heats up and the little dot changes color) roll it heating element towards your eyelid so your lashes are going up at a 90 degree angle and then let the lash fall on the curler as you lift the curler up and away from the lash line.

Pro tip:
Waiting for dry mascara helps so much in avoiding mascara on your lids.

title: Exactly as ordered
text:
I ordered this product and five others from the same company, Toniiq. I received the following today: Tart Cherry, Ashwagandha, Maca, Olive Leaf, Resveratrol, and Triphala. I’ve never tried supplements besides a multivitamin and a fish oil pill. Since I’m getting older and trying to get healthier by actually hiring a trainer, reducing my caloric intake, and making better life choices, I thought I would try these since after some research, they fit the bill for what I’m looking for. Although I am a nurse and currently in grad school to become a nurse practitioner, I not going to review these based on the effects. Seriously, I’m taking those 6 pills a day, plus the vitamin and fish oil pill, plus a blood pressure medicine. It’s poly-pharmacy off the charts so anything I experience is going to be skewed because I can’t be sure of what is doing what for me.

Instead, I will review the packaging and the content of the “bottles”. All 6 bottles were sealed very nicely in plastic. Once opened there is another interior seal, and all were intact. I did not detect any broken capsules inside, nor did I experience and “chemical” smells. Overall the products look very professional. I expect to notice the effects in a week or two since it takes the body some time to grow accustomed to anything.
So based on what I’ve seen so far, I’ll rate it 5 stars. The only thing I would like to have changed is how they are shipped. 4 bottles were in one box and 2 in another and there was not “packaging” type material in either box to absorb any type of shipping abuse that may occur.

title: Gotta Blow Hard
text:
I usually smoke at home or in the office. My old setup for getting smoke out was to take a rectangular piece of plexiglass and have a cutout in it to fit my little 6 inch desk fan and use it as a window fan. I got one in my office, and one at home. This works, but still fills the room with the smell of burnt tobacco.

Just got the smokebuddy and decided to have a long 2hr smoke. What I had was a Gurkha 7x52 cigar. Here's the pros & cons:

PROS:
- lightweight
- small
- gets rid of most of the burnt tobacco odor.
- comes with caps. I'd imagine after using it many times, it'd start to smell, the caps will keep the smells contained.

CONS:
- you need to use your face to make a tight seal on the smokebuddy, or else smoke will leak.
- gotta blow hard, as if you are trying to inflate an air mattress with your lungs.
- I got really lightheaded after taking a few exhales through the smokebuddy, not even 1/3 of the way into my smoke, and I was quite nauseous from blowing so hard on the smokebuddy to get it to filter out all the smoke.
- filter can not be replaced. once it's clogged, you need to buy a new one.

Thing for the company to improve on:
- have an o-ring/gasket on the exhale end aka where you put you mouth in end
- have a looser pack of filter material, can be a thicker pack, just not as tight
- change the product so it'll take exchangeable cartridges, I'd rather small packs of filters than $20 smokebuddies one after another.
=======
Overall, for the price, it's worth the buy. I'll still be using my fan setup because the smokebuddy does not take care of all the smoke, and the occasional leak from not shoving my face against it. Blowing through this thing, is really annoying, and I stopped using it all together half-way into my 7" cigar. I wasn't getting lightheaded from the nicotine, but instead from the smoke filter. It works, but needs improvements.

title: not recommended from certain vendors
text:
I haven't used this starter, so my non-recommendation isn't really about the starter itself if purchased elsewhere. I'm not sure what the starter should smell like or be like, so this may or may not be a fair rating; this was my first time ordering anything like this. My review is mostly about the starter being offered by the current seller (aliga online).

First, the box was inserted in a very small offering of bubble wrap (the top of the box had no wrapping, though), inside of a non-padded shipping envelope. So no real protection there and the box was a bit smooshed, but it's not breakable so I guess that's okay. However, when I opened the envelope I was immediately overwhelmed by patchouli. I have no idea if culture starters are supposed to naturally smell like patchouli, but I wouldn't think so. It was so bad that it gagged me, though I'm sure that reflex won't happen to those who enjoy that scent (I really dislike it). I did take the box out of the envelope and slide off the bubble wrap to take some pictures, but I knew I wouldn't be able to keep it and use it with such a strong scent. No way. Lol.

The culture did ship quickly and the seller was congenial and emailed me a shipping label to print out for return. I had some issues with the download and they sent me a couple different files for me to try, so I appreciate their patience with that. However, it took 3 weeks for a refund after I sent back the package. After waiting almost 2 weeks with no word from them or Amazon, I emailed to ask how and when I should expect my refund. They replied that they mailed it out and should expect it the next week on a certain day.

That day came and went and I checked the tracking number they'd given me, only to find that it was not even sent out yet. The number they'd given me was something like a parking place for a package (not sure how to describe it). Essentially, they reserved the tracking number but it didn't mean the package had been sent. So I emailed them again and asked what was going on and they said that it should be there in 2 days, which was a Friday. They said something about this electronic notice thing, saying that's why I couldn't track it, but in my experience when I go to track something, I can always see where it is in the country at any given time. For this package, it wasn't showing it to be anywhere at all. So anyways, Friday came and went, too, and the refund didn't show up until the next Tuesday.

I wasn't happy about that and how the refund was given, either. They sent a check to me written out to "Cash". I wasn't sure why they didn't write it out to me, or for that matter, why they didn't do the refund through Amazon like other sellers have done (well, I've only had to do this one other time with a vendor through Amazon). I guess because it's cheaper to write out a check than do a credit transaction? I really don't know. It seemed strange to me. I had to deposit the check into my own account because there isn't a bank here that the check was written from; I hope that it clears okay. If not, I'll be sure to update my review.

So even though they were cordial and speedy with their replies throughout our transaction and I eventually received a refund, I'm afraid I can't recommend buying a culture starter through this vendor. I think if you really want this starter, you should look into buying it directly from the manufacturer's website or maybe find one comparable at the Cultures for Health site. There are just some things you shouldn't buy from Amazon; culture starters and batteries to name a couple. Lol. Normally, I have very good experiences here, but not with those things.

Something that I've realized in the past week or so is that you don't really need an expensive starter if you just use a capsule or two of a high-quality probiotic supplement (one with at least a billion cells). It's a lot cheaper to go that route, anyways, and I hear it's just as acceptable for a starter. I remember hearing about this a long time ago, but didn't know of anyone really using this method until recently (from a reviewer of a fermenting book), so I just hadn't experimented with it at all (well, I wasn't really ready to start fermenting back then). Now that I know that this method does work--and works well--I won't be ordering another starter; I already had a starter here in my fridge and didn't realize it--lol.

I can recommend both Renew Life and Garden of Life probiotics because neither of them contain fillers, btw. You don't even need those, technically, since the food usually has sufficient bacteria on it to make it ferment, but using a starter or probiotics speeds things up and makes it so there usually isn't any mold growth on top of the jar that you need to clean each day, and you don't have to use as much (if any) salt. Using organic foods is best since they have more biological activity on them due to not being sprayed with pesticides. From what I understand, the proper way to use the probiotic as starter is to mix it into a small amount of water and add to the jar, then top it off with purified water or brine, if needed. If you do a web search on "Vikraut and Vikimchi", you will find a site that has instructions for using probiotics in kimchi and sauerkraut; they don't use salt in the recipes. You could add salt, if you wish, but I'm not sure how much could be tolerated by the probiotic cells. I don't think it would hurt to add enough to taste.

title: A serious tool for an advanced tattooer. It's a DK machine at a great price!
text:
I was looking to get a Dan Kubin machine but they are not only rare but rather costly. Being that the "Rotary with springs" is trending in popularity, I decided to take a look at them because I had heard that they will put in crisp solid lines and can handle any needle size and configuration.

So I found this machine with the familiar coil machine frame and springs and here's what I found out so far.:

It hits like a hammer!
This is a serious machine and definitely not recommended for small needle groupings lining work. It just goes in hard and heavy so anything 9RL and above is definitely adequate.
I did try some stipple whip shading with a 5RL at about 5 volts and it worked like a charm. This machine is great if you have fast hand speed with smaller needles but at 14RL and above, it puts on crisp solid lines, SOLID. 8.5 volts was more than adequate for a 14 and then I turned it to 9.4 volts for an 18.

Unlike conventional coil machines, the top post screw regulates stroke length. I got this thing to go about 5 MM stroke and no matter how I messed with it, it still kept hitting like a hammer!

Now unlike most rotary machines, this one sounds like a coil machine. Buzz buzz buzz all night long but I found it possible to attach an O-ring, as pictured, to the spring and top binding post and it totally quieted down the machine and regulated the hit a little.

The magnet connector is kind of gimmicky but it sticks and it works, although I'm probably going to modify it to accept an RCA connector and if I feel motivated, I'll even do a clip cord mod for it since this motor can be used with reverse voltage and be able to adjust the machine feel for shoft shading and blending but this is definitely a Liner machine at it's core.

It's a very exciting tattoo machine and it's solid made. It came with additional springs too which was nice and if you are very well versed in tattoo machine theory, you can make this machine do anything. Literally tune it to do anything.

That's my 2 cents and I'm really happy I got this one, will probably turn into my traditional workhorse.

title: An ideal humistat for any humidor other than just travel-dor's!
text:
Suffice to say up until the past week over here on the eastern seaboard, it's been extremely humid and extremely dry outside, and since I'd been out of town the week prior I had one of thirteen humidors that needed a decent boost in humidification while I was away. So I placed the order via Neptune through Amazon the Saturday before the 30th of June, it arrived a few days later, well within sufficient time before I headed north. A little background on said humidor, it's a large glass-top rosewood Savoy that has never kept a decent humidity level even with a large Diamond Crown humidifier which was empty every other week for seven+ years, and I'd seasoned it well over a dozen times; approximately a year and a half ago I had pulled the DC from the humidor and plied it with crystal jars and humisticks. They've been fluctuating the humidity between 63-78%... title: My Favorite Cozy Mystery Series!
text:
In the 17th book in the Cat Who Mystery series, James Qwilleran aka "Qwill", is thrilled to be able to enjoy the latest economic development to hit Moose County (400 miles north of everywhere). It seems that a prominent local businessman, Floyd Trevelyan, has purchased and restored an old steam locomotive, and has plans to use it as a new attraction in town. Floyd has made money in both the building and banking industries, and when Floyd goes missing with the bank's funds right before a large audit, everyone assumes he has fled to avoid prosecution for fraud. Floyd has been seen around town with his beautiful secretary, leaving his ailing wife at home alone, and absconding with the money could give him a way to start a new life. But Qwill's suspicious mind does not immediately believe that this case is as simple as it sounds, and he is determined to poke around in the lives of the Trevelyan family. Hiring a friend from Down Below, Celia Robinson, to work with the sickly Mrs. Trevelyan, Qwill and his feisty felines put the pieces of this family puzzle back into place and solves yet another mystery in Moose County.

This is my favorite cozy mystery series! I had read all of the books in the past, and wanted to read them again for a second time. This time around, I have chosen to listen to them on CD, as I love the voice of George Guidall. Many fans enjoy the homey, familiar feel of the town and the characters themselves. I just love the character of Celia, and was glad to see a kindly elderly "replacement" for the dear Mrs. Cobb. I was shocked with the health issues of Qwill's love-interest, Polly Duncan, and touched to see his reactions to her health scare.

If you are looking for a hardcore thriller, this would not be the series for you. However, if you are a fan of small town cozies, give this series a try. You might just find that you have become an avid "Cat Who" fan before the book is even finished.

This is a great series by my favorite author!

The first book in the series is called "The Cat who Could Read Backwards". Enjoy!

title: Mrs. Pollifax Wears Many Hats!
text:
In the follow-up to the charming debut novel, The Unexpected Mrs. Pollifax, Dorothy Gilman writes another book filled with intrigue and heroism. Mrs. Pollifax, a widow who enjoys teas and garden clubs, sets out on her second courier job for the CIA, a mission which starts in Istanbul. Searching for a missing woman (an agent with international ties), Mrs. Pollifax poses as a tourist to track down the woman and smuggle her safely out of the country. Protected by only an agent, who has no idea what her real mission is to be, Mrs. Pollifax must use her newly acquired knowledge of karate and her unflappable nature to charm her way out of some sticky situations. Hair-raising as always, Mrs. Pollifax's second adventure will leave you wanting more!

I was thrilled to read the second adventure of Mrs. Pollifax, and enjoyed every moment spent with her on the case. Mrs. Pollifax is not a person that you would initially feel would make a good CIA agent. She is elderly, loves to wear outlandish hats, and finds a way to talk and get to know everyone around her. But it is just these qualities that make her so invisible in the world of spies, and even the most cynical of agents falls under her spell. I loved the fact that Mrs. Pollifax learned karate (since she hates guns I worried about how she could plausibly protect herself) and that she was just as lovable yet determined as she was in the previous book. If you have not tried this series, pick up a copy of this book and the previous book, The Unexpected Mrs. Pollifax, and join the millions of others who are charmed by this beloved character!

The first book in the series is called "The Unexpected Mrs. Pollifax". Enjoy!

title: Overwhelming O3 smell that permeated plastics and liquids in fridge
text: I never got to the point of determining if this really made the produce last longer in the refrigerator because our family could not get past the O3 smell emitted by this machine, so two stars for the fact that the product was easy to setup and functioned without any issues, but that's it.  These devices are the same technology as the Sharper Image Ionic Breeze machines that mainstreamed about 13 years ago.  The first thing we noticed was the strong O3 scent upon opening the refrigerator.  I immediately checked all of the plastic and liquids to verify the same smell and of course the O3 had permeated into those, which is quite common with these devices in small spaces.  Several days later we can still smell the O3 in the plastics that were in the fridge.  There is scientific debate as to whether devices like these actually create more harm than good in small spaces.  Although these are not O3 generators, the amount of O3 emitted within a confined space over time may be considered problematic.  I recommend reading up on O3 and how these devices are viewed when operated in small, contained areas.

title: Works as expected but not an easy job
text:
My Seiko solar watch is only 4 years old but started stopping every night. I tried charging the battery by placing it in the window but it would only work for 2 days without stopping. I installed the new battery this morning and have it in the window to make sure it’s fully charged before wearing. The installation of the battery was definitely challenging. I ordered a watch repair kit to remove the back and the tiny little screw that holds the battery in. When I say tiny screw I mean it’s a tiny screw. I removed the screw without much problem but screwing it back in was not easy to say the least. You really need one of the jewelers magnifying lenses that goes on your head to get the screw into the hole and screwed down. While holding the screw with the tweezers provided in the repair kit and trying to get it in the hole, the screw popped out and flew off the table. I can’t believe I was able to find it both times. So to make a long story short, this battery plus the repair kit will repair your watch but you need good light, good eyes, patience and a steady hand. I really had none of the above but somehow managed to complete the job. Good luck 😁

Update: the battery was not the problem as the watch still stops. 4 years of easy use and a 3 year warranty the watch is done. I had a Seiko before this one that I wore for 25 years. I have always swore by Seiko but have now ordered a Citizen.

I really like this pure frankincense oil. title: So much easier than other no-rub solutions.
text:
Love this stuff -- it's really easy to clean your contact lenses every day, even better than the no-rub solutions! I tend to wear my disposable soft lens contacts for more than what I'm supposed to, and just hate the way contacts feel after even a week of daily wear. They're always dry and sometimes get residue on them no matter how much you rinse them or rub them each night after taking them out.

But this is great. No rubbing, just follow the directions like they tell you. Put your lenses in the case. Rinse them for 5 seconds. Fill up the little case with a lot of solution. Then put the case back together and let the solution do its magic. My contacts feel basically like new every morning, and it's been weeks since I changed them out!

Only two negative points:
1) you have to use so much solution every single time! A normal bottle of normal solution will last me months on end. I ran out of my first bottle in just a single month!
2) it's necessary to wait 6 hours between putting your lenses in the solution and then putting them in your eyes. So you still need traditional contact solution for whenever you want to take out your contacts to take a short nap, or whenever you're travelling somewhere not too far on an airplane.

title: These are fantastic gloves for hunting or even skiing, but undersized
text: Huge thumbs up.  I had owned two pair of these prior to this pair, purchased from Academy - one "medium" and one "large". I lost one of the large ones while hunting, which had fit me but rather tightly, and the pair of mediums was too small - gave them away.  So I ordered these extra large, and they're perfect, and only slightly on the large size for my medium-sized hands.  So like most gloves, and most clothes for that matter, they're not correctly sized (for ya know, human beings - well, Asians maybe).  So if you have small hands, order medium or large, medium hands, order large or x-large, large hands, order x-large, and XL hands - you're screwed.  Postive:  These ARE waterproof, or just nearly so - very close to being waterproof, despite being of a soft & quiet material (for hunting).  You can put your keys or a chemical warmer or whatever in the back zippered pouch - BUT when a warmer goes in there, it's much closer to the surface than to your hands, with the main insulation being between it and your hands, so I don't think it will work well at all - but not to fear - do what I've done several times with these - just shove your chemical warmer up into the mitten part with your fingers, and they work in there, and won't fall out when you flop them open to shoot, etc.  Or I suppose you could put one warmer in the mitten top with your fingers, and one more in the back for good measure, if you're down under 0 F or some such. I've used these with a release/bow, and rifle both.  I will be skiing with them in April of these year, but as mentioned, already tested them for watertightness, so I'm confident. Coupled with a capacitive  stylus pen, I can read books, etc. on my iphone/ipad or android when hunting/fishing.  In fact, that's precisely the best use for that zippered pouch - your collapsible capacitive stylus.  You can cut the thin glove fingers off to use your fingers for a touch screen or to have more feel for a minute task, or you can leave the fingers as is.  I leave them.  This XL is *perfect* for medium hands like mine because there is still room in the fingers to put a thin glove underneath, like a winter golf glove.  If you have large hands and get an XL, or have medium hands and get an L, AND you want to wear a thin glove underneath, you're gonna need to cut the fingers off.  Good hunting.

title: Bioavailability based on biologically meaningless measures
text:
The clam that heme iron polypeptide has 10x the absorption of traditional iron tablets is based on studies where "The bioavailability of oral HIP in healthy subjects was assessed using serum iron concentrations, a measure that is not clinically relevant." A meta-analysis of studies in subjects with chronic kidney disease — a condition that impairs iron absorption and thus makes high bioavailability critical — instead found that "HIP was consistently associated with LOWER ferritin values [a measure of biological iron stores] when compared with traditional iron supplementation. With few exceptions, the effect of HIP on haemoglobin, haematocrit, transferrin saturation and recombinant human erythropoietin dose [measures of functional iron status], and adverse effects appeared similar to intravenous and oral non-heme iron supplementation."
"Heme iron polypeptide for the management of anaemia of chronic kidney disease", Journal of Clinical Pharmacy and Therapeutics 40(4):386-90. (Google the title).

A much better supplement is iron polysaccharide complex, comparable to Niferex, such as [[B004N13X24 Ferrex]].

However, the powder is a total pain in the neck to use. The label says that 2 scoops of the product contain 1 g, and I can tell you from using a gold scale that you can't pack 500 mg into a scoop — and then, it's impossible to get it to come out of the little scoop anyway, because it's so small and the stuff is so gummy! Even using a shallow, oval-shaped, stainless-steel measuring spoon, it can be trying to remove the stuff from the spoon. And if you do the math, the powder isn't really any cheaper than the capsules. Better to use their [[ASIN:B00SI96M48 ProHealth  Longvida capsules]] and be done with it.

title: Inexpensive, High-Quality CreaPure Creatine - Beware Commodity Creatine
text: This product uses CreaPure creatine as its raw material, a branded raw material manufactured by Degussa AG Trostberg (formerly SKW) in Germany and licensed as a pharmaceutical would be there. Optimum Nutrition is one of only a few brands in North America that use only CreaPure raw material, and like [[ASIN:B000GONXVI Universal Micronized Creatine Monohydrate, 1000-Gram Tub]] is an exceptionally good value for this expensive raw material in a supplement market dominated by cheap Chinese and other amateur manufacturers. I began looking into the question of creatine purity after having bought some creatine from a company that I generally consider to be quite reputable and from whom I often buy commodity-item supplements, and was disturbed by its very bitter and (surprisingly) soapy taste. The company insisted that the lot number was fine, but my subsequent research suggests it was not. The important issues are nicely laid out in two very good articles by Will Brink and readily available on the internet: "What's in your Creatine?" and "What's Really in Your Supplements? - An Update on Creatine". I proceeded to order some CreaPure-sourced creatine and was surprised that, for the very first time, the stuff had absolutely no bitter taste to it: the suspicious supplement had been the only one with the weird soapy taste, but *every* other creatine I had purchased had a mild bitterness to it, which I'd just assumed to be intrinsic to creatine itself, rather than a sign of impurity. Subsequently, I've bought several of the few products that use exclusively CreaPure, and found them to be similarly free of these widespread off-flavors. There is still no proof that the common creatine contaminants responsible for these flavors (dicyandiamide or dihydrotriazine) are harmful -- but why anyone (let alone a life extensionist!) would knowingly put high (relative to likely dietary intakes) levels of organoleptically-detectable impurities of unknown toxicity into hir body is beyond me, especially with a CreaPure product as inexpensive as this one available.

title: Fun oil to try
text:
New to purchasing Palm Oil on purpose, and glad for this product. I wanted red palm oil for its tocotrienol source and for being a traditional food, and I use this for both culinary and body care purposes. I wanted a product that wasn't contributing to the ecosystem challenges of exploitive agriculture in developing countries. Fingers crossed this product is grown and manufactured as the brand claims.
The oil is a deep orange/red color, and this transfers into the food- its pretty wild on top of oatmeal or for cooking scrambled eggs or stir fry. It has a pleasant flavor and I look forward to using it in my food. I don't mind cooking higher heat with it, and it does smoke, but so does pretty much all oils I've used, so that says more about my lead foot on the gas pedal than anything.

On the body, it turns my caucasian skin orange, and any light colored cloth it touches gets stained yellow. Such a beautiful yellow though! It feels great on skin and does not contribute to clogged pores, unlike I have read elsewhere (my skin breaks out very easily, and doesn't with this). The tocotrienol antioxdants are nourishing on the skin, and to make it softer in a cold house, I have found it blends well with other oils (MCT, grapeseed, rosehip). I tried it straight up on one arm and not the other for a few days, and noticed a difference in my skin dryness and tone. It doesn't absorb quickly, so its good for massaging to get it soaked in. It seems to be pretty soothing, dare I say healing, on sun-damage areas, too (using it on winter skin in the northern hemisphere at the moment). I like that its edible skin care, and more so that its a delicious food. Will be repurchasing this product.

title: Magical Drain Cleaner!
text:
Both my bathroom sink and shower drain have been clogging for a long time. The typical drain cleaners from the hardware store along with plunging help partially for a while, but this time my sink got so clogged that just washing my hands would fill the sink halfway and it would drain at a trickle, so I knew I needed to try something different. I researched and decided upon this product after watching their video. Last night, I poured one cup of the thick liquid into my sink drain and let it sit overnight (leaving the bathroom window open a crack to allow the smell out even though it is cold outside). After breakfast, I filled a large pitcher with hot tap water and poured it into the bathroom sink. I must say, I was completely blown away by the fact that the water drained instantly! My sink hasn't worked like that in years!

After the pitcher was empty, I turned the hot water on, which takes a bit to get upstairs into that tap, and continued to flush the pipe to try to get the smell of the product out. The smell is most definitely lighter than the smell of the other drain products I've tried, but I have a sensitive nose, so could still smell it every time I ran the water until it was flushed out enough. I cleaned my sink with unscented natural all-purpose cleaning spray in case the smell was in the sink itself, but it was in the pipes. It did disappear after flushing it for many minutes, but it is definitely worth it to have the water go down the drain immediately!

Tonight, I will unclog my shower drain with this product and I'm looking forward to my feet not being in a pool of water every time I shower. (I didn't want to do both drains at once in my small bathroom due to the smell.)

My best guess at the cause of my clogs is a buildup of Aquaphor (for healing tattoos), Advanced Silicone Gel (for diminishing scars), soap, hard water, and hair. This product cut through it very well! I highly recommend it.

I am using this on a septic system, so hopefully it is safe like the manufacturer says!

ETA: My tub now drains better than it has in years thanks to this product!
