This really shouldn’t be used as a “pump” until after baby is 8 weeks old and has established a milk supply. You don’t want to get an oversupply and become engorged. That can lead to clogged ducts and mastitis! So just make sure you’re just catching the letdown for the first couple months and then after that you can leave it on to “pump” a few ounces while baby is nursing on the other side!

title: Small, Compact, and Versitile
text:
This ladies' multi-function razor was a just because gift from my husband. It comes with a trimmer, three hair-length safety guards, a facial spa scrubber, soft facial brush, a small cleaning brush, and a charging cable.

The razor comes in a nice canvas hardshell case protected by foam. It is small enough to take along on any trip. All the accessories are neatly stored in a net above the razor. Out of the case, I charged the main razor which has a digital readout. It gives you indicators when it is fully charged. Since it came partially charged it only took about 15 minutes to become fully charged. The run time on the battery is about 90 minutes but I only ran it for about 30 minutes for all of my needs.

The razor has 5 heads that are smooth almost floating across your skin. As I have sensitive skin it did not irritate any area I used it on. I have used it almost daily on my legs and it keeps them hair free and smooth.

The blades are somewhat easy to clean. The outer 4 blades swing up from the center like trap doors. The center blade must be twisted a quarter of a turn to lift it off and brush it out. My only wish is I could access the blades and clean between them and the floating heads. It seems clean enough but I only hope it does not get clogged up over time.

The razor housing is easy to disconnect from the motor and all the attachments go on very easily. The mini clipper with 3 different size guards does the trick in private areas. The facial scrubber gets deep down dirt, dead skin, and oil out of your skin. Then the soft facial brush takes care of other facial areas that need a gentle touch.

The size of the hand grip is perfect for me to hold. But I can see some smaller hands becoming fatigued after a lot of use. The unit is quiet and has some vibration but not like so many other electric razors I have used before.

I'm so glad my husband purchased this kit for me and I know you will enjoy it as I have.

text:
I have used this supplement before with amazing results and this time...I really didn't notice anything that amazing. Now that could be because I am on a new prescription and I am not feeling the effects because the prescription is counteracting it. Which is what I believe to be the case.
Now I do have to manage acute pain every single day. I had forgot why I was taking the Hyaluronic Acid for until now it is begining to make sense. I had been using this every single day until about a two weeks ago and ever since then I have had so MUCH joint pain and muscle pain I almost made another appointment with the Orthopaedic Specialist that has been relieving my pain with injections. Now I know why I started to get these pains out of nowhere two weeks ago. I cannot go without this supplement. I HAVE BEEN IN SO MUCH PAIN FROM MY KNEES because I didn't take this. It really works. I do like larger doses than what this Pure Science Hyaluronic Acid With MSM has. At least 100 mg of H.A. and 500 mg min of MSM.
I have Osteoarthritis in my spine and in my knees and that is why a lot of people take H.A.
People take MSM by mouth or apply it to the skin, mostly using it to lessen inflammation.

They take MSM to try to relieve pain or swelling from:

Osteoarthritis or rheumatoid arthritis
Bursitis, tendinitis, or tenosynovitis
Osteoporosis
Muscle cramps
Scleroderma
Temporomandibular joint (TMJ) disorders
Headaches or hangover
Premenstrual syndrome
Inflammation in eyes or mucous membranes
People also apply MSM to the skin to try to treat problems such as:

Scar tissue or stretch marks
Wrinkles
Wind or sun burn
Wounds, cuts, or abrasions
Or they may take it to try to treat gastrointestinal problems such as:

Chronic constipation
Ulcers
Diverticulosis (a bowel disease)
There is a whole range of other reasons people take MSM. This includes obesity and liver problems, high blood pressure, high cholesterol, gum disease, snoring, infections, lung problems, Alzheimer's, HIV, and cancer.

Since I wasn't quite sure if it was working or not I did not submit my review in the 14 days I was asked. However, I cannot just spit out a review when I'm not finished with it yet. title: Love these type disposable eye masks.  Wish the ear piece wasn't quite so wide.
text:
CROUVM Pack of 30 Disposable Sleep Eye Mask
I really like this type of disposable eye masks. Mainly because they have pieces that fit around the ear, not the elastic thing that goes all around your head. If you watch the current video it shows you exactly how to tear on the dotted lines. When you take it out of the package & unfold it, you have to lift the back part from the front (just lightly tug on the 2 pieces & you will see it separating). After I do that, I then tear along the dotted line down the middle of the back portion (if you can see the line clearly enough, you could even cut this part with scissors). Then you tear out pieces on each side for the opening that will go around each ear. The ear openings have 3 sizes to choose from. Granted, it’s somewhat difficult to see exactly where to tear. It would be nice if they had colored stitching to show it better. That being said, after doing it a few times, you pretty much have it mastered. I prefer the ones I previously ordered as the part that goes over the ear wasn’t as wide as these are. That being said, they do block out almost all light… every now & then I can see light around the nose area & I just re-adjust the mask. Actually I tend to use them more than just one night. Once the ear piece becomes too loose, then I’ll grab a new one. Also, they come individually wrapped & you can toss a few in your purse, suitcase, etc. so they’re great for travel. For the current price ($6.99 for 30 masks) I feel this is a good deal.

Was difficult to get just the right amount of liquid makeup on silicon pad and tap, tap, tap the applicator over skin a section at a time. No matter how little or much I use, adjustments to tapping pressure, blending was not really as smooth as I would like. More time consuming that I am willing to spend when regular sponges and/or wedges are faster and for me are doing a better job.

I did not contact seller for refund...just threw the product away! Would not recommend unless you have natural small pores, blemish free skin and no discoloration, as this increases the challenge to blend in these areas. The plus is because the silicone does not absorb makeup, there is no waste. However with that being said, getting too much makeup on the sponge, or not enough and then overdoing it with more...the makeup ends up getting washed off the silicone for clean up.

title: Useful for vacations and hand-washing
text:
This came in SO handy during my 2-week vacation to Europe! I was making lots of different stops during the 2 weeks, to places with different types of weather. So packing was going to be difficult. Rather than overload, I brought layers, and with these laundry soap sheets was able to wash clothes in the sink so that I had just the right clothes for all the different places I went.

A couple of tips:
- Be careful to have dry fingers when you get the soap sheets out of the container, or they'll all start melting!
- I found it was best to apply the sheet directly to the clothing, rather than to the water. This got the clothes cleaner and smelling fresh faster and with a fewer number of soap sheets needed to get the job done.
- Keep the packet of unused soap sheets in a dry pocket or other place where they will be separate from 'wet' items. Steam, drips, or other perspiration could cause the unused sheets to start melting before you're ready.

title: BRILLIANT!
text:
Cannot recommend this light enough for any application. It is a brilliantly engineered light.
UP
1. Diffuser comes off by sliding ends apart (not the snap in type light GE makes which I don't like) BRILLIANT!
2. The mounting hardware is a SNAP to install. I was mounting this into 1/2" melamine, so couldn't use the screws provided. I looked at the clips that screw into the surface, and they are beveled for wood screw use (again, it's a small thing, but great that i could use either a beveled or flat, without worring abou cracking the clip when I screwed it in). BRILLIANT!
3. The light is adjustable once mounted. BRILLIANT!
4. The light is BRIGHT. For a 20" light, wow. BRILLIANT!
5. The light is THIN THIN THIN! BRILLIANT!
6. The input for the light cord is concealed, and ON BOTH ENDS! You can plug the power in on the left or right of the light, and it's a sliding trap door, so the "other" end is not exposed by default (it's a little spring loaded door). BRILLIANT!
Down
1. The link cord is only about six inches, so if you're planning on linking them, it has to be in close proximity. You can always cut it if you're handy with wire.
2. I'm not sure about replacement bulb availability. I did contact MegaBrite about this, and they said you could order direct from them for replacements if you can't find them. At the cost of this light, especially in comparison to GE's pro line, and what some of these bulbs go for, you could just buy a new unit. They said it's a new bulb, and may be stocked as replacements in chains soon.
Overall, this light is the answer to my prayers. I'm using them in reptile cages, and they are absolutely perfect. Now if I can get a dozen replacement bulbs somewhere cheap, I'm stylin'.
For under cabinet lighting purposes, I would say flawless as well. This seems to be a PC type bulb, so should last a LOOOONG time.

title: It works, BUY it.
text:
I have taken many supplements over the past 20+ years, some good and some not so much. This Citruline Malate Powder from Wholesale Health Connection I would rate at the top of the list, and would highly recommend it. It works just as it should, in the proper dosing. I suspect that if you are looking at the reviews of this product, you already know what it is supposed to do; but, I will give a quick overview.

Vasodilation: This product does this in a visible manner, your veins will literally pop out. This is also necessary to treat high blood pressure, something I've dealt with for 17 years. I attempt to manage it with diet and exercise, but it's never as good as it should. It's not uncommon for me to be in the 135/80 to 155/90 range. After starting a regimen of this product, my latest reading was 113/71. I haven't had good blood pressure like that for many many years. This to me is a direct indication that this product does in fact do what it says. Vasodilation also helps get blood out to your muscles, which helps with recovery and sports enhancement.

Sport performance: I have spent the past 10 or so years running and doing various physically demanding events, and am always looking for that supplement that will assist in pushing further than before. Although I've only been taking this product for about a week, I've seen a drastic uptick in my endurance and level of ability to exert myself. 3 years ago I had knee surgery, and it's only recently that I've been able to run longer than 3 miles at a time without pain. I've found another product that has corrected that, and this product does not address the pain. But, what this product does do is allow me to run longer without getting tired. The first run after starting this product, I ran 6 miles, followed by 7 miles a few days later, and this past weekend I ran 11 miles. Endurance wise, I felt as though I could have continued to run and likely could have done a half marathon run that day. I've never been one to run that distance, usually stopping after 7 miles, but I felt THAT GOOD.

Recovery: After that long 11 mile run, I should have felt terrible all day, and likely would have been in pain (body aches, etc..) and had cramping for a number of days afterward. This did not happen, infact I felt great about an hour after the run and for the rest of the day. I had some slight soreness, but nothing that I would have expected. I believe this product helped with my speedy recovery.

Full disclosure, I started this product at the same time that I started L-Arginine Alpha-Ketoclutarate (AAKG) (by the same company) but I have taken the AAKG before and never had this sort of experience. Adding the Citrulline Malate appears to have made all the difference, and I will likely continue to take both products together. Dosing per the package suggests 1tsp, and I've been taking this 1 to 3 times per day depending on the level of physical exertion that day. I will likely continue to take one dose in the morning, and one in the evening, along with one AAKG in the morning.

Pros: This product works. If you are considering getting it, GET IT. The price is great! The powder is clean and doesn't clump. When you mix it with your favorite liquid, it dissolves down as it should.

Cons: The only thing that I could come up with, is the flavor. There is nothing added to this, so it's just the flavor of the supplement. I add it to Advocare Spark or MiO Sport Water, and it's drinkable. I did attempt to drink it by itself in water, and although I didn't gag, I wouldn't want to do this all the time; It tastes much like Alkaseltzer.

title: We're VERY impressed! This dragon is awesome!
text:
I got this as a gift for my fiancé... Not only does she love it, it got knocked off my end table and broke so I got her a 2nd one. Now, my first one came with a broken wing. I used plastic epoxy from Walmart and it ended up looking even better than the original! THEN while cleaning the wax off the glass plate I dropped the glass wax tray and broke it... I used the glass tray off a different wax burner while I ordered a generic replacement off Amazon for $4.oo (they both worked amazingly for wax AND oil!)...
The 2nd one had no faults whatsoever, but either way, broken peices are incredibly easy to repair and really ANY glass plate for the wax and oil works just as good!
The dragon (with colored wax) glows with whatever colored wax you put in. It's a really neat effect!
The wax melts as expected, and disperses a nice "room filling" scent (depending of course on the wax "flavor"... some are stronger than others) I usually use 2 cubes.
The oil is another way to use the dragon! I actually prefer putting like 10-20 drops of oil on the tray over the wax... But I like strong scents!
Overall we both REALLY enjoy this dragon! It gets daily use and was worth buying a 2nd one when the first shattered beyond repair. Broken parts are really easy to fix! And the glass tray can be replaced by about anything - so all in all, fantastic value for money! If you love dragon's like my fiancé, or just want your place to smell really good this is PERFECT!

title: Lots of modes, but a bit stiff
text:
To make the two pack, they just taped two units of brushes together, so you get two brush bases, 2 USB chargers (no charger adapter), and 12 brush heads which should last a good while. There's not much to the brush in terms of frills. There's a single power button on the font that will run you through all 6 modes and then cycle back to off.

The brush heads feel like they're soft bristle but in use they felt a bit stiffer than what I would prefer. This could be just a result of high rpm of the brush and not being used to it. The RPM/cycle of the brush head is comparable to other common brands. The brush will time out 30 second intervals for when you should be finishing up a section of your teeth and moving on to the next one by hitting a short pause before resuming. Once the full cycle of intervals is finished the brush will just shut off.

While competitor toothbrushes are made of plastic, the plastic on these feels a bit cheap but you're getting what you pay for when it's roughly $19 a unit and more premium options are upwards of $60. It works well enough to not complain.

The one thing that I am gonna knock a star off for is that this is a product with consumable parts (brush heads) that need to be replaced periodically. The instruction manual says that you should replace the brush head every 2 months or when the bristles are deformed (whichever comes first). If you replace the brush head every 2 months, you should have about a year supply of brush heads out of the box - BUT - it doesn't appear to be that you can buy replacement brush heads. At the price of these brushes, that probably isn't a deal breaker, but it's something to be mindful of if you are consumption conscious and don't like throwing out perfectly good things.

title: Firm believer in this cold remedy!
text:
This is a product I believe in completely. If any of you are not aware, I am all about natural remedies before trying man made medicines. Sprouts cold remedy is a blend of all natural herbs to relieve cold symptoms.

This blend contains Echinacea, red root, green tea leaf, elderberry fruit, thyme, red clover, myrrh gum, orange peel, mullein leaf and ginger root. Some of these are pretty popular, others I have not heard much about. Echinacea, green tea, elderberry, and ginger are all fairly well known for their ability to boost the immune system and reduce cold and flu symptoms.

The recommendation is to take 1 ml (25 drops) 1-2 times a day at the onset of symptoms. I unfortunately forgot I had these when I first started getting a head cold. Once I remembered I had this cold remedy I started taking it in larger amounts for the first day. I tried the recommended amount of one dropper full, every 4 hours. I can say, the taste isn't great but it isn't a deal breaker. I added some with some juice and chugged it. I am happy to say the next day my symptoms, though not gone, were considerably better. I continued to take this cold remedy in conjunction with vitamin c and within 2 days I was feeling better.

I have a susceptibility to getting bronchitis or upper respiratory infections so when I started getting better and my cold didn't get any worse, I was a believer. I love this product and am so happy I have found something natural both my kids and I can take at the first sign of a cold.

title: Great start to the perfect kit
text:
Just got my kit today. It looks like a great little kit. I was pleasantly surprised by the hard cloth case. This is actually great for having cold packs in because if they get smashed or broken then they won't be useful when you want them. Now we won't have to worry about cold packs in our soccer bags already being "used" when a child actually needs one. I think this is my favorite feature of this item and probably the only thing to consider when thinking about how much you are willing to pay for this item as many of the other items are cheaply replaceable. For example, there is a big assortment of wipes and bandaids - this makes up the majority of the kit. Most of these things you can probably get fairly cheap with sales and coupons.

I didn't care for the tweezers as they are big, plastic awkward things. You will probably want to replace them.

Also, the inside plastic dividers were a little confusing. I am assuming you may be able to buy more of them as one of the plastic items has velcro on both sides, but only one spot to connect to in the case. Maybe you can add on plastic dividers and connect at the velcro spot? The cases do not have a solid closure but really just a flap that goes over. The big inside pockets can be handy for larger cold packs or other large items you might need in your kit.

Not sure I would pay $24 for the kit, but I do think the product is a great start to a perfect first aid kit. There seems to be lots of room in the case to add the things that are the most important to you along with a few simple things to get you started.

-time commitment (adds an extra 8-10minutes to your face routine)
-learning curve can be overwhelming (there are a few options so you have to find whats best for your skin by trial and error)
-not wireless
-steep price

If you're okay with all of the above then you'll enjoy it! Much of the early usage is trial and error with your skin, soon you'll figure out which settings are best and the order of your beauty regimen with this added tool. I love both the hot and cold feature so i'm glad i went for the newest model! the hot helps the products absorb and the cold will tighten your pores.

-better product absorption
-tighter cleaner pores

-more plump and firm

It really does feel like your own at home spa treatment, i figure a facial costs $60+ so really it will eventually pay for itself (i say this to make myself feel less guilty on the splurge! ;P haha) If you're into new gadgets then this is worth trying out.

title: Great for light back muscle massaging
text:
This device works fine for reaching those hard to access parts of your back. Using it is simple, and if you are looking to mildy massage some stiff back muscles it does a great job. But if you apply just a little too much pressure while you are trying loosen up with some deeper massaging or pressure, then this device is apparently not engineered to handle such use. It snaps, breaking in half. It comes in two segments to begin with, and has an ok connection joint. The problem appears to be that all of the pressure gets transferred into the plastic curve, which only has a marginal limit of elasticity. The hard plastic cannot flex under too much pressure, and so it snaps.
At first I thought perhaps I had a defective unit. So, I decided to put out another $30, and buy another. It works great if it doesn't break. But, soon after, it too snapped. Now I'm out $60. Maybe I should have bought two to begin with and duct taped them together as one heavy duty unit. That might help.

Manufacturer has made good on unit by replacing it with no questions asked. I've had no problems since and can highly recommend the product/company in particular, as they were very pleasant to deal with.

title: Worked well, gave us confidence there were no blockages, not expecting "clean" pipes
text:
We developed a blockage in our Beam Central Vacuum system after Christmas, attributed it to an abundance of pine needles and a few small pieces of branch. It impacted two of our six outlets. Tried clearing the blockage with a shop vac and we seemed to have success after a few tries and letting it run for a bit. Saw these as part of the search as to what we can do to clear a blockage. Seemed a bit pricy but ordered them; 21 year old central vac that is really great, the price was small in comparison to a call to someone to help.
Ran a towel through each of the six hose outlets and two "dustpan" outlets that we ran half of one through. This was not meant to clean the hose or pipes, was an attempt to be sure we had no blockages and if it cleared some dirt or debris, that's a bonus.
Well it worked great, ran one through, checked the central unit to be sure it was there then ran another. You can see from the pics the wipes that went through the system. Now that we have them will run through periodically, maybe every 4-6 months.

title: Large, light weight and sophisticated.
text:
I've had several diaper bags in the past 2 years and this is by far my favorite and I am going to tell you why:

The 1st bag I had was a brand name purchased at Target for well more than it was worth... roughly $65.00. The gray and white print quickly rubbed off the side and bottom and the waterproof pocket was far from what it claimed so after 1 upset with a bottle of breast milk it was it the trash.

The 2nd bag was a ThirtyOne bag which was a gift and came highly recommended and I am still trying figure out why. The zipper didn't actually connect so my baby was able to reach into the sides and pull everything out. That's just not practical when you keep you wallet, phone and other important or private items.

The 3rd bag was my push present for our 2nd child and I absolutely had to have it. I ordered it online from Guess and spent close to $200 on a designer bag. It is cute, and huge but ridiculously heavy. It is hard to carry and zips out to turn the entire bag into a changing station however the contents fall out.

I was offered this diaper bag during a promotional period in exchange for my honest unbiased evaluation. This diaper bag has a sophisticated look that I am happy with carrying for my daily bag. It is the right size to carry diapers, bottles, clothes, snacks, my over-sized wallet and phone, a small milk cooler and a few small toys... for 2 babies. The material is quality but also light weight. The zipper closes the bag and tucks down inside so that little fingers can't get into it. Inside are a couple of pockets for organization and a large changing pad! On the outside are 2 large pockets that have a velcro closure and to side pockets that I find ideal for a sippy and a bottle. This has all the great qualities of a designer bag without the price-tag.

text:
[[VIDEOID:7e32484d197632997ff651c2af1f9a1b]] I actually got this for my parents after trying it out for myself, and they love it! It's been awesome for them when it comes to tight/sore muscle relief. Even my dad has been enjoying it to ease some back pain from an accident a while back.

As for the device itself, it took us a minute to realize you need to press the on/off button for a few seconds for the belt to turn on or off (it was mentioned in the instructions that we should have probably read first), but once we figured that out, the device has worked perfectly.

This was my first time trying an at-home red light therapy device, so I was a little nervous. Those bright red lights look devilishly hot, but they are, in fact, pleasantly warm. The wrap itself is good quality, and can be situated and velcroed in place pretty easily around your back, shoulders, or any larger muscles that may need a bit of extra relief.

The belt turns off on its own after about 20 minutes. I wasn't really expecting much since it was just the first time, but I was pleasantly surprised to find that I did actually feel a difference. I'm sure the more that we use it, the greater that difference will be. So, I'm no longer nervous about these things but looking forward to seeing how it continues to work!

Honestly, I like it enough that I actually want to get a smaller band, too.

There are no instructions for the "remineralizing gel". As far as I can tell, you do the same thing as with the bleaching gel, except you don't use the light and keep it on for 5-10 minutes. Also, the shade chart seems pretty useless. It's more of a grayscale chart.

As of right now, I'm leaving it at 3 stars. I'll give it a week or two after I've used it multiple times and then I'll update with whether or not its effective at whitening. However, I suspect (because that's what the gel is made to do) that it's going to work fine. We'll see.

title: No. Just........NO
text:
Specialty men's trimmers have become big business lately as most men and women prefer hairless body parts. Entire brands have been created that focus on men's body hair removal, particularly the hair on and around the genitals.
This particular product makes the claim that it's able to safely trim/remove hair from your testicles. They even baked the claim into the product's extended name, claiming they are "ball trimmers".
Knowing that 99.9% of their sales will be to men, Kibiy wisely saved a few bucks by not including an instruction booklet of any kind. These are MEN's trimmers. Who needs instructions? The box says "body hair" and "balls", which is all the instruction a real man needs before he puts a powered hair trimmer against his sac.
The Ball Trimmer uses both a steel set of blades and a ceramic set of blades inside the trimmer's cutting head. This supposedly gives you a better, closer shave than other trimmers on the market.
My balls would beg to differ.
In the process of testing this trimmer, I immediately tried the one thing it says it can do right on the box.
Yeah.
It felt like it wasn't trimming the hairs on my sac but plucking them out, one by one. This resulted in a rash that is still irritating me. To be fair and make sure this wasn't just a bad cutting head, I switched the head to use the extra head included in the box.
And now I have a rash on both sides of my sac.
Aside from that......I just can't find a stronger word than "disappointing".....experience, I decided to try the trimmer on other parts of my body and had mixed results. It does a good job on a lot of the other body hair. I haven't tried it on underarm hair yet. The memory and rash, ESPECIALLY the rash, from trying to trim my testicles are still too fresh in my memory and I don't want round three to give me rashes under my arms.
So, it's a nice try and for the money, it might be worth doing your own testi testing. Just remember, you've been warned.

title: Good Morning Sunrise Wake-up Light Alarm Clock with Nature Sounds
text:
I had been looking at wake-up lights for a while and chose this product for a number of reasons. It is reasonably priced (for this type of item), not too large to fit on an average nightstand, and user serviceable (i.e., the user can change the light bulb when necessary). The clock was easy to set and delivers as promised. It also is pleasing to look at.

I had some concerns at first about whether the light would be sufficient to wake me up in the mornings. I found that it works very well for me. The wake-up light gradually increases in intensity and is hard to sleep through (which is the point). If that is not sufficient, the light is followed by the alarm sound chosen by the user which increases in volume. Being woken up this way is much less jarring than a traditional alarm or radio sounds (for some reason, commercials always seemed to be on rather than music when my clock radio went off). The motion detector snooze feature also works very well -- a wave of the hand turns off the alarm for the period of time set by the user. The user can choose the length of the snooze period, the intensity of the light, the volume of the alarm sound, and also the alarm sound itself (built-in radio, 6 nature sounds, or chimes). This item also offers a choice of 12- or 24-hour (military time) settings.

I rated it 4 stars instead of 5 because the built-in radio is disappointing. The quality of the radio is poor and not conducive to listening pleasure. My suggestion is to eliminate the built-in radio entirely. The manufacturer could then lower the price (making this item even more cost effective) and/or add more nature sound choices.

This hand massager is light weight so it is easy for someone like me who struggles with pain to take with me on the go.  It has a USB rechargeable battery so there are no cords to worry about when using it.  It makes a little noise which is to be expected when it is compressing/massaging, but it isn’t noisy and won’t bug those around you.  It has timers you can use to turn it off at different intervals or you can just hit the power button when you are done using it.  It has 3 modes so you can get varying levels of strength, but perhaps the thing that I like most is that it is very easy to understand and use.  I don’t need an in-depth user manual to figure out how to get it on the preferred mode and level settings for me. I feel like the comfort, compression, and heat of the massager work extremely well and offer quick relief for me. If you are looking for a hand massager that is easy to understand and operate this is the one for you. In my opinion you will not be sacrificing quality for simplicity.

title: Cuts close without irritation
text:
I know this is technically a men's razor, but I'm a woman and I use it on my legs. I've tried a few different electric razors and I've noticed that men's razors tend to work better and cost less.

I'm not going to try to claim that it works as well as using a regular straight razor, but this one might actually provide the closest shave out of any electric razor I have tried, including more well known name brand razors for both men or women. It also does not irritate my skin at all, which is a big deal because I have very sensitive skin that gets razor burn from everything.

Two bonuses that aren't necessary, but are very nice to have: 1) The meter that tells you how much battery life is left and 2) a cord that actually comes with an outlet adapter. Many of them only come with a USB cord, no adapter.

And I really appreciate that it came with a replacement blade.

I can't help you if you're looking for info on how it cuts beard hair, but it's had pretty solid results for me.

Heat helps lashes stay curled longer so i was really hoping for this to work but unfortunately i don't find it very convenient to use. Most times I'm just being too cautious because I'm not comfortable using something with heat close to my eyes. I think in this process I end up spending more time to curl my lashes using this curler compared to my regular eyelash curler.
The body of this curler is made of plastic which appears cheap and flimsy in my opinion. I won't be surprised if it breaks after few uses. I feel this could be built better.
Overall it is an innovative concept but doesn't work for me unfortunately. Maybe someone with longer and fuller lashes will have better luck.

title: Does Not Sync, No Help in "Support" Pages
text:
After two hours of attempted syncing via my home Wifi, I had to give up. I was able to eventually get the scale at least SEEING the network (via my mobile phone, since connecting via the Mac kept crashing the scale). When actually trying to weigh myself however, the scale would only repeat "Step On... Step Off... ERR", even after several resets.

The Help forums on Fitbit.com are worse than useless, in that their suggestions are (1) try again, (2) try turning it on and off and (3) try removing other devices/networks from the surrounding area (particularly in the 2.4 GHz range) or changing your WiFi frequency. That last troubleshooting option in particular is hilarious when living in a downtown area surrounded by 30+ other WiFi networks, but you've ALREADY moved your network to a relatively unoccupied corner of the spectrum. Should I just go door to door and ask my neighbors if they'd kindly turn off their WiFi for a few HOURS while I try to get this scale to sync? The fact that their suggested troubleshooting options amount to little more than the Aria-equivalent of "Have you tried checking if it's plugged in?" or "What about hitting CTRL-ALT-DEL?" is frustrating, to say the least.

I wish I'd spent more time looking through Amazon reviews of this product before purchasing, but I'd heard from a friend (who has one and likes it) that it was pretty great and just kind of jumped in. Maybe it IS great, if you can get it to sync -- but that never happened for me, so hopefully (if you actually still want to purchase this product) it magically happens for YOU.

title: Better Than Coffee - Feels Similar to Adderall
text:
I am 32 women who a couple of years ago looked into medicine for ADD which I feel I have struggled with all my life. I was put on Adderall which was wonderful. However I felt it made me angrier and was absolutely horrible to come off of when I stopped taking it. I also found out that it could over work your heart and cause other problems. So far to me this feels very similar to Adderall but my emotions are more in check. I have been incredibly productive while I have been taking this pill. I have a lot more energy, and it is focused energy. I dont feel like my heart is racing to fast at all. By the way there is no caffeine in this but it is an herbal stimulant. As far as it helping with mood swings and hormones I have been on it for about a week and yesterday was a very bad PMS day for me. Maybe I need to be on it longer I am not sure. So this is what I am worried about. I feel this stuff is way more awesome then coffee. My concern is that my body will get used to it and it may no longer be as effective. I also worry that I may suffer from extreme exhaustion if I stop taking it like I did with Adderall. Only time will tell and I will try to update my review. It does make me feel better to know that holy basil has been used in India for thousands of years in Ayurveda medicine. I have been taking one pill at breakfast and one at lunch or around 3:00 p.m. This is not something you want to take at night. It is harder to go to sleep if taken to close to bed time, and I ended up dreaming all night long, so it was not a restful sleep at all. I have not had any weight loss or apatite suppression, but I have been a lot more active. My weight has not changed while on this pill at all. I feel like a happier, more productive, and a more focused person while on this pill. I would highly recommend this herbal supplement and brand. I have been very happy with my purchase.

The following link was very helpful to me in researching the benefits of this supplement: [...] There is a list of 44 benefits this supplement has.

WebMD also warns that holy basil should not be taken with medicines that thin the blood. Also this supplement should be stopped 2 weeks before any surgery since it can slow blood clotting. Pentobarbital interacts with Holy Basil and may cause drowsiness.

As with anything you decide to take I highly recommend you research it first to make sure that it is right for you. For me I plan to continue taking this daily. I will be buying another bottle after I am done with the one I am using.

[[VIDEOID:79c34d01c3656d3df53657b37495bf8e]] Since surgery a few years ago, I've been suffering from cold feet like never before.
I tried various ways to keep my feet warm but nothing seemed to work.
Unlike an electric blanket for feet, I can move around in this warmer which allows my feet to get warmed up quickly.
For the shoe size of 6, it is a little big for me but doable.
With the battery pack inserted, the foot warmer weighs almost 11oz but I did not feel uncomfortable when I walked around the house in it.
The split charger that comes with it can charge both battery packs at the same time, which is very convenient
The inside is soft and the bottom is non-slip.
Within 5 minutes of walking around in the warmer, my feet were warmed up and I was able to carry on with my daily chores in my regular slippers afterward.
A couple of minor drawbacks that I found were: the zipper pull was a little too tiny and I could feel the electric cords on the sole of my foot.
But these downsides are minor, can be manageable, and did not negatively affect my review.

title: Demogorgons unite! Close shave but not much else.
text:
I’ve been using a rotary razor for about a year now. The one I currently have is a name brand with three rotary heads. This one is quite the monster. As you could see from the pictures it’s a nice kit. However holding it in my hand I can tell immediately that it’s cheaply made and it feels more like a toy razor.

The hinges on the rotary heads feel like they’re going to break if I push them slightly too hard. The most redeeming quality of this razor is that it gave me an incredibly close shave. I was shocked how close and clean it turned out. It was even better than my namebrand razor. That was probably the only redeeming value. However, it was quite difficult to clean. Each razor head has to be opened individually and then the center needs to be twisted and popped off. This is a bit more than I want to do each morning and I’m sure that blade in the center He’s going to end up in the upside down with the other Demogorgons as it gets lost in my drain. I found it difficult to keep all of the blades open at the same time While trying to rinse it it clean. It did come charged at 98% which was a nice benefit.

I don’t have any expectation that is a last any length of time before I break it but while it’s working and in one piece I’ll continue to use it. It also looks like you have to replace the entire head at once when the blades get dull. I would think that is expensive as you should replace these every six months at least depending on the thickness of your hair and beard.

title: Cadillac of white noise machines
text: This is the Cadillac of white noise machines. I was looking for one to use while traveling, and chose this one because of the portable size. I have tried several that didn’t sound close enough to the box fan that we use use. We cannot sleep without our box fan, but it’s not practical to always bring while traveling. This noise machine has several different fan sounds, and one of them is nearly identical to our box fan. It came fully charged, along with the cable to recharge it, and it lasted the whole time that we were sleeping(so about 9 hours). We are home from vacation, but we liked it so much that we have retired our energy inefficient box fan, and just use this at night. It also has a hook on it so it can be hung in the car to help baby sleep. It has a nice nightlight option where the lights can change colors and brightness as well. No matter the white noise sounds that you prefer, this probably has it. There are fetal sounds, birds singing, water drop and stream sounds, clock ticking, several different fan sounds, and two different songs.

title: It's working!
text: Originally, I ordered this in the weaker potency because I heard it was used to treat tinea versicolor. I've had the condition for a few years and it has grown throughout them, spreading from the top of my chest to below my belly button, in my inner elbows, and on my back. When it came in, the pellets seemed to be a little melty or something after travelling and being in the summer heat as there was a bit of film at the bottom, but the pellets were just fine. I wish it came with instructions to use them and maybe a little something personable about the company itself, but my homeopath recommended I take 3 pellets 3 times a day, and I noticed a difference in my spots (and possibly a change in my period, but I can't be sure. I did read an interesting thing online about the possibility of that, though)! Taking them myself and giving them to my fiance as well, the bottle lasted me a few weeks and at the end of it I decided to switch to the higher potency. Our dosage dropped to 3 pellets 2 times a day, so it's a little more cost-effective. I've ordered this potency twice now and I'm hoping my spots just keep disappearing!

title: 1st) and the dry eye was expected to got worse I found the fish oil had prepared me well
text:
I was taking 1,000mg at doctor's suggestion for dry eye. Couple months later I was only using eye drops in the morning. Then when I had my first lazik (yes, 1st) and the dry eye was expected to got worse I found the fish oil had prepared me well. Dry eye only significantly bother me at night and in the morning so I had to religiously take my gel drops. When it was determined I would have a 2nd surgery a few months later I bumped the fish oil up to 2,150mg (the ultimate omega x2 bottle). My doctor didn't suggest it but said she believes it's why the post surgery dry eye was pretty minimal and now, 3 mos later, I rarely need to use eye drops at all. She said she doesn't see that very often with lazik patients and suggested I continue to take 2,150.

No fishy taste. No burping.

One review noted the difficulty of mounting the wheels on this stand: I found it took a good deal of pressure. Mounting the pageholders is a bit of a pain: you'll need a wrench and a screw driver and it's all a little awkward.

Once together, though, the stand is a pleasure to use. I've been having back and neck problems. Once I strap the book in the holder, I can lean back in a recliner, rest my back and neck, and easily read for a long period. The stand allows you to postion the book pretty much any way you want to, tilting in any direction; the book remains stable. You have to decide how many pages to strap in, and how many to leave free; the more you leave free the less flat the pages you're reading will be.
But I can't say this was a major problem.

I've only had the stand for a few days, but it seems plenty sturdy.

title: Acceptable bathsalt with an interesting scent (to some people)
text:
I love the scent of grapefruit (for some reason this scent is not as popular so I don't see it very often) so I decided to try this product--the price was acceptable when I bought it (~$8).

Pros:
1) It doesn't leave any mark on the bathtub after the bath;
2) Scent is refreshing. If you just open the container and the scent seems strong--don't worry, it'll get diluted when you add it to a big bathtub of water.

Cons:
1) The scent is not very strong (I guess this can be considered as a pro for some people, but because I do care about the scent of the bath salts I consider it a con). I used two capfuls and I could barely smell what scent it is. I'll try three capfuls next time.
2) Takes a little time to completely dissolve.

Overall I'm satisfied with the purchase and I would try other scented bath salt from the same brand again.

title: MY SENSITIVE SKIN LOVES THIS SERUM
text:
This Vitamin C serum comes in a thick, milky gel formula that's odorless. It glides over my skin effortlessly and absorbs instantly. It's comprised of a premium formula that's so powerful, potent, clean and effective that you normally only find it in high-end spas. This serum reduces the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles. The penetrating formula not only cleans and moisturizes your skin, it tightens ans smooths areas around your eyes, chin, neck and cheeks. It works as a deep cleanser to clean out the oil, makeup and impurities from your pores so your skin reaches a healthier, more radiant look. The hydrating formula allows your pores to 'breathe' by allowing refreshing oxygen to penetrate your skin. It's a refreshing change from heavier creams and serums.

If you read my reviews regularly, you know I've reviewed many serums, especially Vitamin C serums. For this reason, I have chosen to use this review entry to share parts of an article that was published by My Awesome Beauty that's titled The Complete Guide to Vitamin C Serums.

HOW TO CHOOSE THE BEST VITAMIN C SERUM : 10 FACTORS

FACTOR 1 - VITAMIN C FORM

There really isn’t a “best” form for Vitamin C because there hasn’t been that much research that shows which one is the most stable and still effective.

When you are looking for Vitamin C, you should stick to the derivatives or actives that are tested and proven to work, like:

ASCORBIC ACID

Ascorbic acid has the most supporting research but it is also the most unstable and can be quite irritating at higher concentrations. However, if your skin can handle it, it is the go to active. Just make sure that the serum isn’t oxidized.

Still, most companies prefer to use the derivatives because they definitely have longer shelf life, which is critical for a cosmetics company.

MAGNESIUM ASCORBYL PHOSPHATE/SODIUM ASCORBYL PHOSPHATE

Magnesium ascorbyl and Sodium (pretty much the same) are water-soluble derivatives of Vitamin C that many believe to be the best form of Vitamin C for use in skin care products.

They believe this because it is less irritating and is more stable than Vitamin C. Even better, sodium ascorbyl (or magnesium) phosphate has the same potential as Vitamin C in helping with collagen synthesis while keeping the concentrations lower.

In the end, for those who have sensitive skin or don’t want redness, sodium ascorbyl phosphate is probably a better choice than ascorbic acid.

Still, sodium ascorbyl phosphate can still degrade when it isn’t stored properly or exposed to light and air. Following the “use by” dates on the packaging is a must to ensure your get a product that still “works”.

ASCORBYL PALMITATE

This form is the most frequently used fat-soluble (soluble in oils) derivative of Vitamin C in skin products.

It isn’t irritating to the skin and is far more stable than Vitamin C. Still, even if it has good antioxidant properties; it doesn’t boost collagen synthesis as much as other derivatives and Vitamin C does.

So, if you are going to choose an oil-based product that contains Vitamin C, you want to make sure that it has ascorbyl palmitate.

However, it won’t be nearly as effective as ascorbic acid, magnesium ascorbyl phosphate, or sodium ascorbyl phosphate.

NEW DERIVATIVES

These derivatives are to be avoided because there hasn’t been enough study into their benefits.

You might also find other derivatives such as tetrahexyldecyl ascorbate, which belong to the new derivatives that are slowly hitting the market.

If you remember what we said about derivatives, (check the paragraphs above), most vitamin C derivatives on the market, including ascorbyl palmitate and sodium ascorbyl phosphate, consist of the ascorbic acid fragment (ascorbyl) and a fragment of another acid (e.g. palmitate or phosphate).

These new derivatives have multiple chemical fragments that are bound to a single ascorbic acid fragment that protect against the core Vitamin C.

So, as you can guess, it is like having more bodyguards protecting the core vitamin C.

They are said to be more stable compared to the other derivatives and Vitamin C itself. Some of these newer derivatives (particularly the tetrasubstituted lipophilic ascorbates) are also said to be more powerful in boosting collagen synthesis. However, you will need to put out a little more cash, which might not be worth it just yet as we still haven’t found enough evidence or studies backing up those new derivatives.

TO SIMPLIFY IT, IF YOU HAVE:
Normal or Oily Skin: use L-ascorbic acid
Dry or Sensitive Skin: Use sodium or magnesium ascorbyl phosphate to help avoid irritation and redness.

We will keep a close eye on the new derivatives and will update our article in 2016, so you can benefit from the most up to date information.

NOTE: There are of course other derivatives such as a Ascorbyl Glucosamine, Ascorbyl Glucoside etc… but they really lack studies to warrant use so stay away from those forms for the time being.

FACTOR 2 - WATER BASED SERUM OR OIL BASED SERUM

If your read carefully our previous paragraph, you should be able to answer this question.

As you obviously want the most potent vitamin C serum, you will choose the most effective vitamin C forms : the oil soluble vitamin C derivative is not as effective as the water soluble ones, so you should stick with a water based vitamin C serum.

You can also notice that all our top 3 vitC serums are water based because they definitely gave us better results. That is also why most vitaminC serums in the market are water based.

The other advantage?

These serums are much lighter and will be much easier to add in your skincare routine.

As a reminder, apply the serum right after washing your face so to let the serum sink in and give you optimum results.

FACTOR 3 - PERCENTAGE OF VITAMIN C IN THE PRODUCT

The percentage of vitamin C is a tricky factor for formulators (as was confirmed by our cosmetologist and formulator friend).

You do need a high amount of Vitamin C to boost collagen production and help with hyperpigmentation but too much can actually cause irritation and redness – and you don’t want to make people have the catch-22 or being wrinkly or red.

The goal is to find that just right spot – which can be harder than you think.

The amount that you should look for depends on whether you have the Vitamin C form or the L-ascorbic acid or the derivatives:
Ascorbic Acid: Look for 5-15% in the product
Magnesium Ascorbyl Phosphate or Sodium Ascorbyl Phosphate: Percentages between 1%-20% (remember that these derivatives are as effective in lower concentrations as ascorbic acid ).

WORD TO THE WISE

When you are using Vitamin C serums, and if your skin is pretty sensitive, you should consider starting at the lower end and work your way up to a higher concentration so that your skin isn’t put into shock. You could irritate your skin and make it red and inflamed. Your skin may dry out and peel, which is pretty much the opposite of what you want – dry skin can make you look wrinklier, as was the case for several of our readers and 2 of our testers with sensitive skins.

Try to avoid pure Vitamin C form, like L-ascorbic acid, and work with a derivative around 1.5 or 3% for the first month. That was more than enough for their skin, which showed impressive results. Example here of vitamin c serum for sensitive skins.

So the most important criteria is not the percentage but how much % of vitamin C your skin needs to get results and how much you skin can stand.

This is a really personalized product and you need to find the right one for you – there is no “one size fits all” option.

FACTOR 4 - PH LEVELS

When trying to make a decision on what serum to buy, PH levels should be one of the most important things you consider. PH levels tell you how acidic the product is – the lower the pH, the more acidic the product is.

Now, many people will believe that stronger concentrations of L-Ascorbic means that the product is superior to something with a lesser amount, but that isn’t necessarily the case. The serum should have a pH level of 3.5 max (preferably lower), or it won’t be able to penetrate the skin – which is why it needs to be acidic in order to be effective, but also why it can be an irritant for some people.

Skinceuticals is the one that holds the patent for the lowest CE Ferulic serum available on the market, it has a pH between 2.5 and 3.0. Some of the more affordable brands aren’t that far above them though, with pH levels ranging from 3.0 to 3.5.

They can’t make it the same because it will violate the patent – but it is still low enough to be effective.

As for the derivatives, the pH problem doesn’t hurt as much because they can go for a more neutral pH.

For example, magnesium ascorbyl phosphate has an ideal pH around 5 or 6, which is the pH of our skin. This is why some serums that use Vitamin C derivatives will come with a sensitive skin label.
Serums that have ascorbic acid: ideal pH of around 2.0 to 3.0, which can be irritating for those with sensitive skin.
Serums that have sodium ascorbyl phosphate: ideal pH of around 5.0 to 7.0, which should not affect sensitive skin.

Many brands have a problem with pH, it would seem in our testing. The products weren’t well formulated and the pH was not within the ideal range for the best penetration of ascorbic acid. That’s why some people find vitamin C serums ineffective; they probably came accross a bad formulated serum to start with. Obvioulsy, we did not keep those useless serums in our top 3.

FACTOR 5 - BETTER INGREDIENTS FOR EFFECTIVE TEAM WORK

Vitamin C by itself can help your skin, but there is a reason that many of the best products have more than one thing in it.

You can’t use one thing and expect miracles, just like you can’t eat a diet of only kale and expect to be healthy…or happy.

You need a little more help, which is why it is good to go for a product that has other benefits or beneficial ingredients.

Look for products that offer tons of antioxidants, especially if you are trying to avoid aging.

In some combinations, antioxidants can strengthen each other and go above and beyond what they can do alone.

One of those additions could be hyaluronic acid, which helps to deliver moisture, which can reduce wrinkles.

You could also look for aloe vera, green tea, rosehip, and/or ferulic acid.

Having more won’t hurt your skin; at worst it just won’t help it, so look for a product that will be able to deliver on more than one front.

Update: You can find serum with 20% of L-ascorbic acid,( the most irritant form) but the percentage of vitamin C is not the only criteria to check, I definitely prefer less vitamin C, like 15% of vitamin C if it means getting several other potent actives in the same serum that will boost the vitamin C action.

Remember also as we mentionned it previously, the higher percentage of vitamin C ( L- ascorbic form), the more irritant it can be…. So I know we all want the most effective serum but if you burn your skin… it is not really what you want. So be moderate and build up from there.

Keep in mind that usually,
The more vitamin C in the serum, the less other actives manufacturers will add. (to keep the production cost moderate)
The less vitamin C, the more other actives manufacturers will add. ( as they have more margin to add other pricey actives)

Of course, the choice will depend on whether you use other serums or not in your skincare routine. If you only use one serum, it is usually a good move to use a serum with a blend of super actives (vitamin C, acid ferulic etc..). If you use other serums, you can pick the serum with 20% L-ascorbic acid as you will bring other actives in the battle against wrinkles with your other serums

FACTOR 6 - SKIN TYPES

Everyone has different skin types, from oily to natural to dry – and many of us have all three types at once.

Some people will have better results with Vitamin C derivatives while others will prefer to use the L ascorbic form – it is really a testing game until you find the one that works best for you.

If you have sensitive skin, a product with a high level of ascorbic acid might harm your skin and you should aim to work with a milder option.

Some people will be able to use only a little at a time and work up to the stronger levels, while others will be able to use the stronger products from the start. If you are having problems, a useful tip would be to start by applying the product every other day and work up from there.

Go by this rule of thumb when you are just starting out:
Normal or Oily Skin: use L-ascorbic acid
Dry or Sensitive Skin: Use sodium or magnesium ascorbyl phosphate to help avoid irritation and redness.

FACTOR 7 - AVOID COLORED PRODUCTS

When you search for products that have Vitamin C or any derivatives, try to find a product that is white or colourless.

Any colouring in the product could hide the signs of oxidation that render the product less effective.

You want to be able to see a yellowish or brownish tint.

Of course, a lack of tint does not guarantee that your product is free from oxidation as the early oxidation stages are colorless….

Some unethical manufacturers (they do exist..) will even add colour to their products so that you can’t spot the oxidation status – so they can even sell oxidised products without you knowing it. ( and they can hide the ugly truth )

However, some only do this for marketing reasons – people equate orange or yellow with Vitamin C, so they tint it that so it looks better.

Still, we recommend you avoiding vitamin C products that aren’t colorless or white.

That way, you will be able to check the degradation status and as a result the effectiveness of your antiaging – product.

FACTOR 8 - PACKAGING & STORAGE

Products that contain Vitamin C and its derivatives have sensitivity to air and/or light that makes their quality degrade at a faster rate if they are stored incorrectly.

Companies do their best in trying to create packaging that helps keep the products fresher for a longer time, they use opaque tubes, pumps, or air restrictive bottles.

You will usually find amber dropper bottle or blue colored dropper bottle, which enables to protect the serum from light. (For your information, amber colored glass is said to protect a little more from light than blue colored glass, but the difference is not that important).

What you must remember is to avoid transparent bottles (they cost way less for the manufacturer but it means for your Vit C serum a shorter shelf life….)

Yet, to get the best results out of your product, make sure that you close them tightly to reduce the amount of air that can get in and place them away from light.

Try to avoid exposing them to humidity – which means you shouldn’t store it in your bathroom. Many people like to store anti-aging products with Vitamin C in the refrigerator! If that doesn’t sound appealing, wrapping them in aluminium foil can help.

Once again, make sure that you note the “use by” date on the packaging – they will be your best indicator of whether or not the product still has a change of being effective.

FACTOR 9 - BRAND REPUTATION

Yep, would you buy a product from an unethical brand that does not take customer service seriously?

Would you even think of spending your money on a company that don’t respect you as a customer?

You should also definitely check the brand reputation, check whether the brand is known for selling scams or fake serums.

There are unfortunately thousands of crappy brands in the Internet selling you bottles of water with a simple gelling agent to make a serum that they would market as vit C serum.

When customers start to complain, they simply take the money and shut down everything. Then, They can create another brand and rinse and repeat….

I know it sucks but that is the bad aspect of Internet. As we told you, you will find thousands of vit C serums brands on amazon or other big e commerce websites, they all claim to be the best serum on earth

We bought many serums to test, and were really shocked by some brands selling crap so the big lesson to remember is to be critical….

Keep also in mind our reviews don’t necessarily mean, your will get the exact same results as our reviewers. We all have different skin. That’s why we usually like to give you the criteria and elements to know so you can better choose the most suited serum for your specific case.

FACTOR 10 - PRICING

Pricing of Vitamin C products can vary greatly.

Some of the best products from Skinceuticals are a luxury item while other brands are far more affordable. Of course there are a ton of products that fall right in the middle.

Skinceuticals products are great, but they might not be worth the money (30 ml bottles for $100-120) unless you have tons to spend and use $1 bills in the bathroom. You can definitely find cheaper serums that are as effective. )

On the other side, you also have the serums that cost $5 and swear to be the end of all your skin problems. Those brands are created everyday, which proposes serums for $ 5 with 20% of vitamin C + 10% of hyaluronic acid, + many other actives that are pricey

You look at the ingredients and see all of the buzzwords, so you think it has to be a miracle.

Well, just like fake designer bags on Canal Street, these products tend to fall apart at the seams and not offer the results you’ve been dreaming of. Some of those products might claim that they are 20% Vitamin C, when you open them up and get a ton of water, you will realize pretty quickly that it isn’t.

To sum it up, you can definitely find a good serum that will deliver somewhere in the $20-$70 range. Take advantage of sales and seasonal deals, as they pop up quite frequently.

title: Good sauce for those that are not vegetarian
text:
Mexican is one of my favorite foods and smothering a bean burrito with red sauce and onions is one of my quick, stand-by dinner options. With such a simple meal, it is imperative to have fresh and tasty ingredients. I've tried many red sauces and some were quite good. According to my husband this has been the best sauce. He says it beats the enchilada sauces he has had in most Mexican restaurants.

Unfortunately, I cannot offer my own taste appraisal because this product is not vegetarian. Frontera makes two red sauces -- one that is in a pouch [[ASIN:B0048IFVCM Frontera Pouch, Enchilada Skillet Red Chile, 8-Ounce (Pack of 6)]]and this product that comes in a jar. The product in the pouch is vegetarian. The product in the jar is not. After examining the ingredients on the pouch, I had made the assumption both products were equal and purchased the jar (because it was a better price) without rechecking the ingredients. The sauce in the jar has chicken in it. If you are vegetarian, don't purchase the jar option unless it is for family/friends.

My husband's rave reviews of this sauce have led me to order [[ASIN:B0048IFVCM Frontera Pouch, Enchilada Skillet Red Chile, 8-Ounce (Pack of 6)]]. My husband says that the product has a rich tomato taste and the roasted garlic inside the sauce complements the sauce well. The sauce spreads easily and is not thin or tomato paste thick. The 16 oz. jar was perfect for covering eight burritos (using six inch tortillas).

I purchased my Frontera enchilada sauce in the 16 ounce jar from my local co-op for about four and a half dollars. The price on the vegetarian/pouch version on Amazon is cheaper than my co-ops (which was charging about three dollars for the eight oz. pouch).

Ingredients: Water, Tomato (fresh tomato, tomato juice, calcium chloride, citric acid), roasted tomato, New Mexico Chile Pepper, Apple Cider Vinegar, Salt, roasted onion, roasted red bell pepper, roasted garlic, sugar, chicken base (cooked chicken and chicken juices, salt, sugar, maltodextrin, chicken fat, dehydrated onions, citric acid, turmeric, natural flavors), vegetable oil, xanthan gum, and spices.

Another good place to buy this item is iherb.com. The company offers free shipping over certain thresholds. If interested in iherb, you can use code LEK375 for a discount.

Made in the United States.

title: Very breathable and comfortable open patella knee support - no hot spots!
text:
I live in sunny southwest Florida where the days are humid and hot. If I need to wear a knee support, it needs to be able to tolerate the humidity in combination with perspiration.

This knee support provides a nice amount of soft tissue support for a knee that might benefit from it. The material is 95% nylon and 5% spandex. This does not feel like a pure neoprene brace as so many others are - the material is softer and I can find no hotspots on it from seams or velcro. This is a real plus!

I have worn heavy knee braces in my life for an ACL/PCL tear. This is not THAT kind of brace and is not meant to support a knee that has more orthopedic issues like torn ligaments. This does provide nice support for an aching knee due to some arthritis or muscle strains ... or just for a bit of extra support for a knee that has a bit of lateral shift.

I like the simplicity and feel of this brace. The feel is soft and does not have a stiff neoprene feel. It uses 3 straps with easy instructions: line up the brace with the kneecap, secure the middle strap first, and then the top and bottom straps.

Goes on easily, supports without a lot of slippage (although this may depend on actual fit and actual strap placement - practice makes perfect). For me, the brace stayed in place for several hours while doing some walking and sitting without much slipping. There are no metal side braces, this is a straight up knee support.

For what it is - a support - it's 5 stars.

I received a free sample of this product to test and review.

title: A good economical distiller with a very minor  drawback
text:
We bought this water distiller at a local big box store as a replacement for the previous model that gave up the ghost last year. We have well water with a very high mineral content and it produces an immense amount of mineral scale in the humidifiers we need in the wintertime. Distilled water is our only option. This particular unit works well and produces a full four liters of distilled water in about four hours. It will take less time if you use hot or boiling water instead of cold water.

A couple of minor points:

- The discharge cap that fits over the jugs opening and under the filter spout to direct the newly distilled water into the jug must be carefully positioned, or the water coming from the spout will drip or splash down the side of the jug and you'll have a pool of water on the countertop or floor. The discharge cap sits loosely on top of the opening, so even if you carefully position it, it can still be moved out of place if you jar the water jug or accidentally bang against it. We use a small plastic funnel instead and it's more efficient and much safer.

- The plastic jug that comes with it is of lesser quality than the jug that came with the previous model. It is thinner and less sturdy and has a very flimsy screw top. We have two older, better quality jugs that we purchased a few years ago with the earlier model and use those. We also have found appropriate, similar containers at a dollar store and use them as well with a funnel.

Cleaning is easy, but instead of buying more of the de-scaler, I follow the suggestion of another reviewer who suggested using vinegar with a little salt. The salt turns the vinegars acetic acid into a weak hydrochloric acid solution and is more efficient.

Aside from the points about the jug and the discharge cap the verdict is that it's a good distiller and with regular cleaning and maintenance is just as good as the much more expensive distillers with the same capacity.

2022 The latest perfect blackout sleep mask： Has a unique design that solves many customer feedback problems. Soft and comfortable, large space, no deformation after repeated use. The perfect eye mask for side sleepers: Does not contain any metal, full surround face-hugging contour to prevent any type of light. concave silk sleep mask

Suitable for students & adults: 3d sleep mask for eyelash extensions, concave silk sleep mask, Total darkness silk blinders for sleep. perfect for home, For traveling Softness Sleep quality Comfort, highly recommend, machine washable.

I work third shifts. I have a dark colored bedroom and even darker window blinds. Yet still too much light gets into the room for me to sleep without a "blackout" mask.

I do not want any pressure on my eyeball. I just do not see how that would be good/healthy for anyone. I also like to open my eyes if I hear something strange. Masks that touch the eyelids keep me from easily opening my eyes. (I do not mind the dark as long as I can open my eyes.)

I tested it out by washing it 4 times in the washing machine and even tossed it into the dryer. There was no shrinking, the elastic was still like new, and the material was soft.

Review of Pearlicare Replacement Brush Heads (8 Pack) - Compatible With Phillips Sonicare Gum Health Electric Toothbrush

The brushes are obviously in a different pattern and possibly of different materials than OEM but I have no idea if this matters so I obviously cannot determine if the performance is the same, better or worse than OEM. My teeth feel the same with these as when using OEM.

In response to an answered question I am using one right now with a newer model that is not listed in terms of compatibility (the ExpertClean 7500 or HX9690). I did find that these brush heads fit a little too tight onto the shaft from the toothbrush handle. For cleaning and drying I like to remove the brush head each time and these take a bit more effort to remove. Since there is not any ribbing or roughing on the brush head I invariably end up using the brushes to help brace the hand when removing the brush head. I hope that the metal in the brush head is softer than that in the shaft of the handle to preclude wearing out the big ticket item.

I would note that accounting for time zone differences (and dateline) the seller responded very quickly to my question.

text:
I have been in an eye shade frenzy as of late trying to find one that met all my criteria! I purchased 3 different masks and I compared products. I like to keep eye masks handy in multiple places.
I'll be keeping them all (even the ones I don't like as much) just have some near the couch or in the car, by the bed and ready to travel as a couple. I started this quest looking for a two pack of masks, deep eye pockets with smooth/comfort velcro. I had found a pretty good mask at a local store that had stupid text on it and needed to find one that my man could wear while traveling and not be embarrassed.

1. HYFAM 2 Pack- I wouldn't buy this unless you want a large flat eyemask. Perhaps for side sleepers that don't mind the size, flatness and nose light leek.
Cons:
-Too large for my preference
-Seems cheeper in material/construction than the others
-Nose light leek
-Nearly flat, I won't wear this as I don't like my eye or lashes being touched by the eyemask.
Pros:
-Least expensive option
-Came with ear plugs

The velcro was the reason I started seeking other eyemasks for myself and ultimately this one will still be my favorite after trying others. -Deepest eye pockets (best mask for eyelash extensions/no mess with eye makeup!)

If you've ever lost an eyemask on the plane it was most likely a black one. I have found that choosing bright colors (while not as chic) really help in not losing accessories as they may drop when you get up from your seat.

3 Prettycare FIVE STARS: These are overall good quality mask I would recommend. It is a cheaper option because you get two in the pack!

title: Plaque Remover for Teeth Tools-NIYPS Electric Ultrasonic Tooth Cleaner
text:
I’m really impressed with this ultrasonic plaque remover by NIYPS.

I was leery of ultrasonic plaque removers and my first thought was “No, that looks like it could damage my teeth.” And then I thought “I should have a more open mind and willingness to try new things”. I’ve always been concerned about my teeth and maintaining them as best I can. So I gave this a try.

I have three ultrasonic cleaners for cleaning jewelry and small items and one ultrasonic toothbrush and like them so much I’ve given ultrasonic tooth brushes as gifts, as I value their performance over standard tooth brushes. This plaque remover uses the same technology.

After charging it up, (BTW this uses a USB to USB-C cable, which is included) when I first turned it on I couldn’t even tell it was running. Just knew that it was on, since the LED light was on.

Once placed against my tooth, (I started on the Gentle setting) I could feel the vibration and heard a high pitched sound, much like my tinittus! I knew that it was working.

You don’t use any pressure. You gently place the tip in areas that are hard to clean and prone to plaque build-up.
That’s it! So easy and very, very safe.

Be uber careful when working in the space between teeth and don’t twist the tip in that space. Just gently place it in there and the vibes will remove what it can. If unsure, avoid it altogether until you gain more skill with the tool.

You won’t need to use it on perfectly clean tooth surfaces and probably should avoid doing so. It just isn’t necessary.

The light really helps to see all the way into the back of the mouth.

I can see why there are two tips. Also, the little round mirror will help with seeing hard to view areas, like the inside of the front upper teeth. I use a bathroom mirror too.

The pointy hand tool scrapers are for removing heavily built-up plaque and tartar.

The manual didn’t describe the purpose of the large, wide stainless steel tool, but I imagine it may be to hold your cheek out to access the molars, or maybe to hold the tongue down, not sure. It “might” be for use in between teeth.

I just started using this fine tool. I’m really impressed with it and will use it to remove plaque from time to time. I’m going slow with it and will try the different heads and different speeds when I feel more confident with it.

When using this below the gum line, don’t be alarmed if a little bleeding occurs. That’s normal and to be expected. It usually stops quickly. I will continue to gently clean below the gum line and know that eventually the bleeding will not occur as the gums heal and become more healthy.

So glad I found this fabulous device and gave it a chance. I’ve been using battery powered water flossers for many months now and love what they do, but I’ll continue to use my ultrasonic tooth brush and regular dental floss as well as this tool for best results.

Although it doesn’t come with a carry pouch, the box it came with has a small plastic tray with indentations. It’s small and light and the charge, if it’s like my toothbrush, should last a long time before needing a recharge. This will make it easy to take with me for travel if on an extended trip.

This is really affordable and a good value for what you get, especially when considering what dental cleanings cost, although this should not replace your routine cleaning by a hygienist.

Recommended.

5 STARS!

title: Water Flosser IPX7 Cordless Rechargeable Teeth Cleaner
text:
I love, love, love rechargeable water flossers and have tested out several. This one ranks near the top in performance and value.

Some things to look for:
Tank size. This one is 300ml which is not uncommon, but some are smaller. For me, bigger is better as it means less refills.
Recharging. All are pretty much the same here. Some use USB-C and some are Micro USB. I prefer the USB-C, because its faster and easier to insert into the port. This flosser has a micro usb port.
Tips. These are about average and work as expected. Expect each tip to last about 6 months with regular use.
Modes. Several modes are offered with pulse and low and high pressure most common. I like the high pressure this offers to really get in the tight spots and loosen up food particles.

Some say it’s “messy” and it is I guess. You have to sort of bend over the sink and water and gunk will run out of your mouth, over the flosser and your hand into the sink. I actually like seeing what is being removed, so for me it’s OK and a whole lot easier than flossing with dental floss. I just keep going around and around until no more particles are coming out. Sometimes it’s two tanks, sometimes it’s three. I’ve learned to use warm water as my teeth are cold sensitive.

I have one larger space between to bottom molars that always bleeds a bit from this, but its still OK to use it in that situation. You could lower the power, if needed.

If you haven’t used one of these before, you’ll be pleasantly surprised at how good it works to remove bits of food. Also, it really refreshes your mouth too. I always do a quick run around the top and bottom of the jaw/cheek juncture where food can collect. You can hit your tongue if you want to, say if you use this first thing in the morning. It’ll tingle a bit and you could use a lower setting or pulse, just for fun! I also go around the gum line. It’s very effective for me and I’d say it takes about 95% out, which is terrific. I do notice that if I go back in with dental floss, I sometimes find some that this missed.

I like to brush every so often too and as mentioned, I also use an Oral B dental flosser from time to time, so I can best maintain my teeth and gums. I think this combination works well for preserving and maintaining my dental and oral health.

Recommended and would buy it again
