But, through inter-changeable heads, it can be a nose hair trimmer, a razor and a hair trimmer. This could help reduce the number of devices to bring with you when in travel. There are marks on the handle and heads that help to align and install a head. Removable heads are convenient for cleaning after usage. It has a USB-C charging port, which is everywhere nowadays.

title: Light Weight Shaver and Great for Travel
text: [[VIDEOID:20de40e2bcc0f17f53e3070df4dc800a]] I have several electric shavers and what this one surprised me a bit was its weight. It is just lighter than any one that I have or used to have. The shaver looks great and works great. The power level indicator is helpful. Even though it has a proprietary port for charging, it accepts USB-A for incoming power source, which is almost ubiquitously available nowadays. This is especially useful for travel. Thumbs up!

title: Fresh, Tasty Adaptogen
text: Of all the adaptogens I love, Maca is way up there!  It has a lovely flavor and I usually enjoy it mixed into a hot latte-style beverage with any number of other ingredients.  I’ve had very good success with this company’s products and I hope you do too!

title: Excellent price on a quality product
text:
These are well made, waterproof, and thick enough not to worry about tearing. The price is reasonable and the sizes are designed well. It's difficult to do a review for something like this as they are really just dish washing gloves, but these are excellent for what they are.

text:
What a great price on a great product. The flavor lasts a long time and the gum doesn't get "hard" if you know what I mean. The flavor is strong enough to get you through the rest of the day, if you had garlic for lunch, without offending your co-workers.
Overall, just a great price on a product I love. 5 stars.

title: Superior
text:
These are by far the best ear plugs I have ever used! They are comfortable and dont fall out constantly and they cancel out noise about 90%.. it's not 100, but honestly as a mom I dont like the idea of not being able to hear anything..especially if I needed to. So 90% is absolutely enough for me to sleep through my 14 year old dog and husband snoring on both sides of me at night, but still be able to hear enough to not worry. The bigger ones hurt my ears a little.. however, that's my fault for not realizing that the second set is smaller.. so they fit very well now and dont hurt.

Great pair of ear plugs. Bonus for coming with a travel case.
10/10 would recommend!

title: Five Stars
text: It's soft and doesn't compress your eyes as it rounds out over the eyes.

title: Great on reusable puppy pads
text: I am a foster parent for animal rescue. Since I've started I have only gotten one dog that was already potty trained. The rescue provided me with these reusable puppy pads. They work well but getting rid of the pee smell always took at least 3 wash cycles. I used this as a laundry additive and it worked amazingly. I took each pad out and smelled it and there was no trace of the smell of pee. I will definitely keep using this.

title: Minor Flaws, But Does The Job
text: Having three small long hair dogs that need groomed frequently gets expensive. While I am by no means a professional, these are easy to use with a small learning curve to getting used to it. The clippers are smaller and lightweight, so you aren't holding a heavy clipper while near a small dog. They don't pull or snag the hair and the noise level is really low. The dogs don't get scared by the noise thankfully. The fact they are cordless makes them easy to use on dogs. I can't speak to cats because I've only used these on small yorkies, but I'm sure they work for cats too. I'll be saving us money each month doing standard grooming at home.

title: Homesteading in the 21st Century
text: With all of the inflation and shortages across the country, this is actually the best way to ensure you have laundry soap for cheap. The two bags are 10 lbs and that provides you months upon months of washing soap if you want to save money and make it yourself. The bags reseal easily too, so you can make small batches when you need them. I use these as a deep cleaning as well as an ant killer for inside the house because the spring rain has brought ants. You can use these for so many purposes; bath bombs, detergent, cleaning agents, and so much more. It's cost effective too! There aren't any impurities in the bag and I've enjoyed using it to make laundry soap. Even the little ones like helping out because it's natural and it's like a science experiment for them. I definitely recommend these, especially if things keep going the way they are.

title: Add More Water Than Suggested
text:
We live in the south. You need all the help when you live in the south in the summer. The humidity and heat are brutal. If you don't beat the heat, you'll need these. The trick I found to these is to do a little more than 32oz of water. I do 4oz with warm water for the powder to dissolve and then I had 30 oz of cold water and ice cubes and shake again. These tastes much better cold, but the powder dissolves easier when it's mixed in warm water initially.

The orange tastes good. It is a bit sweeter than I would like, but sweet is better than salty and the sweetness gets better when you add those extra couple oz of water. It doesn't taste like the fake sugar thankfully. And it doesn't taste like salt which I half expected like other fluid replacement and electrolyte mixes.

They come in an easy to keep package. Grab what you need and stick it back in the closet. These are even good for school sports since you can hydrate a whole team for just over $1 a piece. Still cheaper than name brand.

title: Good Gauze, Okay Medical Tape
text: I've been putting together my jump bag which requires a lot of gauze and bandages. For $14 at the time of review, you get 30 rolls of gauze. These are literally the perfect size for any first aid kit or jump bag. The one thing I like most is that the gauze doesn't stick to wounds nor fall apart. They are multi-ply gauze that are well thread. You can pull this tot without worrying about it ripping. It could be a makeshift sling if needed it's that durable. I find the individual wrapped rolls better to use than a large roll where you have to keep cutting after each use. These are perfect "one time use" rolls. They fit snug in the box or you can stick them all in your kit depending on size. No complaints here!

title: Smells Intoxicating!
text: Oh man these smell so good! Lemongrass is my favorite scent when it comes to essential oils and I enjoy looking for bath bombs and shower steamers that smell like strong lemongrass. The only thing I didn't care for was how difficult it was to actually open. Once I did get the bag open, I was hit with the lemongrass. The smell is literally intoxicating. If you place directly under the shower, they will dissolve quickly. I like placing one on one of the built in shelves where the water just splashes occasionally. I get a longer lasting steamer and the scent is closer to my face. These are $17, which puts them at almost $2 a piece, but this is okay because I've paid far more for shower steamers from name brand companies that weren't as strong. This is really a win for me!

title: Don't Be Intimidated By The Size
text: These are large. That is no joke. However, don't let that intimidate you from good pelvic floor health. Even with the size of these being a little overwhelming to the eyes, they really are a good fit for helping to strengthen those muscles. If you've had children, are getting older in age, or simply want to work on any leaks or drips, they'll do you good. Each one weighs a different weight and you start with the lightest and work your way up to a higher weight. You can make a game of it and see just how long you can "hold" them for. They are cutely colored and very feminine looking for being an exercise related product. Overall, I've seen a great increase in a short time by just using these for a couple minutes a couple times a week. You'll have a tighter pelvic floor before you know it!

title: More Perfume Scent
text: $12 for 6 bombs is pretty average when it comes to the price of good bombs. I wouldn't say that these are over the top, but I do believe they are decent. The actual bombs are small, fitting in the palm of your hand. The scents are a bit strong, more perfume scented than fruit scented. The orange actually smells like orange, but the others smell like perfume. A little too strong. The bombs do float and fizz longer than the other brands I have tried out. The water is colored with pretty colors and not just a dirty looking bath. I would say these are better for kids than adults personally, but for the price, you can't go wrong. I don't care for the perfume scents, but some do.

title: Cute, but Pricey
text: While these are super cute, they are very price for just 8 people and no untensils. It is $15 for the cups, napkins, and plates. One would think they would put forks, spoons, and knives out to finish the ensemble. It is just interesting that they don't come with them for that price. The plates are fusrlt sturdy and because they are not round not square, it brings some flair. It's cute, but not overly functional. Not a lot of surface room. They are okay for the price, but not great.

title: Not very comfortable.
text:
This is difficult to give a good review because there are way more negatives than positives. I mean, it's great the packaging is easy to open, but it is not enough to make me convince you to purchase these. I am not flat footed, but I also don't have a high arch, yet I'm not neutral either. I wear other insoles of the same style comfortably. These are not comparable.

Pros
-Size 12 needs no cutting.
-Easy to remove from the packaging.

Cons
-Flat (It says its the natural arch height, but these feel incredibly flat)
-Weird bubble in the middle (It feels really awkward)
-Narrow (If you have a wide foot, these will not work for you)
-Expensive ($36 for one pair at the time of review, for a no name brand)

I would spend your money on a name brand insole of the same style for a better price and better results. These are just not comfortable.

title: The Soap Petals Are A Fun Addition
text: I'm using to purchasing bath bombs for nearly $6-10 a bomb at major bath and spa stores, so these bombs are $18 at the time of review are an amazing price. The scent, the size, the colors, and the extra soap petals are a steal! The bombs are a great size. They fizz, spin, and float for quite some time, longer than usual bombs. There is even a very large heart shaped bomb that lasts forever. The scents vary and are not too perfume like nor too fake smelling. They are relaxing and calming. I love that it includes the plastic piece to open the bombs easier too. The box itself has a bunch of flower petal soaps inside. These petals are fun for floating and using the soap to wash with after. You can't go wrong with this box of spa bath bombs.

title: The opener is the best part
text: So, not gonna lie. The green tab this comes with for opening bombs is the best part of the gift set. I use bath bombs all the time and it is a struggle to get some of the plastic wrappers off. This little green piece is a life changer. The bombs are good, but very perfume scented. If you have allergies to strong scents, you might not like these. The basket is adorable and this can easily be gifted to someone for a birthday or Valentines day. Comes with a variety of scents although I don't smell the scents as advertised. Just perfume. They moisturize well though, don't stain the tub, and fizz for a while. So these are good for kids and adults.

title: Its like walking on clouds!
text: My insoles for my Hey Dude Shoes wear out so fast so I found these insoles and thought, they are cheap so if I walk through them quickly its no big deal. I actually like these more than the insoles that came with the shoes. They make me feel like I'm walking on a cloud. I ordered 9.5-11.5 and hoping they would fit knowing most insoles run big. I wear a size 12 and sure enough, they fit perfectly. The gel in the heel is really comfortable. They have decent arch support for me since I have not a flat but but pretty close. I also sweat a lot and they are very breathable. I'll buy them again if I walk through them!

title: Fits 15 1/2" tall trash can.
text: This Feiupe 10 Gallon Drawstring Trash Bag Garbage Bag is not made to fit my tall kitchen trashcan that takes a 13 gallon bag.  The 10 gallon bag does fit the 15 1/2 inch tall rectangular trash cans we use in our home office and bedrooms.  The drawstring closing on these bags is very convenient.  I also like that I can use the sturdy cardboard box the bags arrive in as a dispenser so we only pull out one bag at a time and that the bags are unscented.  The plastic material of these bags is not going to be strong enough to hold anything exceptionally heavy in weight but they are doing fine with the standard discards in our office.  I am also putting some bags in bedrooms for collection of items to be taken to charity donation locations.  I see on the product description page that the manufacturer says these bags would be good for storage of some items like sweaters.  I'm thinking they could also hold some of the extra bed linens that have taken over the space in my linen closet.  The only problem will be having to label each bag since the plastic is white, not clear, and you will not be able to see at a glance what is in the bag.

title: Good reminder for me about decreasing range of knee motion.
text: This knee brace is working well for the arthritis in my knee.  The side stabilizers are especially important to me and this brace gives me the support I need without restricting to much of my mobility.  The brace is thicker than others I have tried but that doesn't mean it is hot or uncomfortable to wear.  There are three straps that are adjustable with a zip and lock type wrap around closure so I can easily adjust the tightness I want for a particular activity.  The middle strap goes right around the middle back of my knee so I was worried that strap would be uncomfortable to wear over time.  The middle strap does give me a reminder that I probably shouldn't repeat some specific activity.  I do find that I need to take the brace off or at least loosen the middle strap in order to be comfortable driving.

title: It’s ok…
text:
I have been using the long rod like ones of these types of overnight curl things and while I like it, I did wish I could achieve smaller curls and waves. So when I had the chance to try this Heatless Hair Curler that looks more like an octopus I was excited and hopeful.

Unfortunately I found this much more difficult and tedious to use than the ones I usually use. I used this about 8 times over the last few weeks and it takes 4x-5x longer to do than the other types do. It did give me slightly smaller waves, but honestly I don’t think the extra work is worth slightly smaller waves. Personally I think if you are using this to cut time out of your morning routine than I would pass since it takes just as long as just curling your hair would.

title: Works well but no replacement options as of yet
text:
This JAZZZNAP Electric Foot Callus Remover Kit works just as well as any of the others I have tried before. I used to use the name brand ones, but got tired of paying like 3x-4x the price for refills that worked just as well as the generic ones.

This one does only come with 3 roller heads, though they are all different courseness’s. That’s not a word but you get the idea! I did try all 3, and while there is a slight difference it’s not crazy noticeable. You could really use each of them until there finished.

title: Disappointed
text:
I’m a bit confused about what the brand was going for with this facial steamer. It’s really much to large and expensive for a home unit, but it’s also nowhere near professional quality, so I’m just not sure who the target consumer would be here.

A bit about me, I’m a total skincare aholic and will try anything at least once when it comes to skincare fads. Now I have over the years totally boiled a pot of water, poured in some essential oils and herb blends, and gave myself a steam facial. Not only for beauty but also if I am congested or have a stuffy nose, and it totally helps. So my hope for this product was that it would be something that was quicker and easier, and more comfortable while doing the steaming, than the whole boiling pot on the stove thing.

And it kind of delivers somewhat, but not what I expected for the price point. First the steam does get decently warm, but not hot. More like water that was boiling and you turned it off 15 minutes ago hot. It definitely could get hotter in my opinion.

The overall quality isn’t very great either for the price point. It’s wobbly and you can tell it’s made with cheap materials as well. Setup was fairly straight forward though. Overall I just can’t see how I can recommend this. It’s way over priced, it only gets mildly warm, and it’s huge for an at home unit, for now I think I will stick to my boiling water in a pot on the stove…

title: Decent little sleep mask…comfortable and functional.
text:
This is the first time I’ve ever tried out a sleep mask, so I don’t really have much to compare it to. However, I am relatively happy with this purchase, and I do believe it made a difference in the quality of my sleep.

The material of the mask is soft and comfortable. The band is adjustable to get a good fit…I just haven’t quite figured out where that is yet. It seems like the tighter the better, but then I noticed it slipping some when I put it as tight as I felt like it should be. When I loosened the fit a bit, it didn’t slip as much. Go figure.

The 3D design is a good idea, and works well for the most part. I think I have a larger than average sized nose, and it still fits fairly well. The material itself does accomplish a total blackout of any light. However, a little light does seep in around the nose area where it doesn’t fit completely flush to my skin. I was able to eliminate 95% of this by simply adjusting the mask around my face until I was convinced it was in the best position.

At one point during the night, my husband got up to go to the bathroom, and I took the opportunity to really test out the blackout feature. We keep the hall light on, so it gets pretty bright when we open the bedroom door. I lay there with my eyes open, ready for the light to come in, right up until he got back in the bed and I realized I wasn’t going to see any. So yes, it does eliminate all light coming in through the material. It’s just, like I said, a small bit around the nose area where you can see light if you open your eyes just the right way.

I also felt like I got a better night’s sleep than I usually do, and it was much easier for me to wake up in the morning than is typical for me. So my sleep quality must have been better since I didn’t struggle to wake up—and I cannot tell you how appreciative I am of that! I will continue using the mask at night to see if this was just a fluke or if it really makes that big of a difference long term. I did receive a discount on this product to test it out and give my honest opinion about it.

title: Idea is there, design is not
text:
Purchased this for my husband's boot (broken foot). His boot is open toe but work demands closed toe and this was the best/cheapest optionI could find.

The idea itself is ingenious, but the thought put into creating it is a bit lax.

The plastic is not at all bendable, my husband put it over an open stove to heat it up and bend it so it's not so large.

The openings on the side are just that,
large openings; your foot is not really protected from any elements, just possibly other people's sneakers, table legs, etc.

The picture shows a full length white got length paper behind it, and the description sneakily portrays that it sticks to the bottom of the boot (underneath the soft part). That is not the case, the toe guard does not have that white part to stick it in the entire length of the boot (which would have made more sense, honestly) it comes with just the toe guard attached to a short piece of plastic about the length of the toe guard itself. It does have the sticky part on it, but i have no clue wether its sticky enough or not (easily fixed with Velcro tape if its not sticky enough, i would assume) although I was a bit bummed about that, hubby said its fine.

To anyone needing a closed toe boot, i searched. I did not find any other product that I deemed comparable. This is what we did to make sure the boot was okayed by work:

A) put it under a hot stove/torch it to fit more flush with your boot. We did this on all 3 sides (2 sides and top)

B) either ghetto rig it like us, or come up with a fancier version; we simply pulled a black sock over the whole thing once it sat flush with the boot, slit an opening where the toes are supposed to sit, and slid the whole shebang under the soft part of the boot, tucking the rest of the sock all the way to the back of the boot. Unless someone is really REALLY concentrating on the boot, no one will notice. It won't hide your foot from the elements, but it being summer right now, that wasn't our main issue, so weather/ rain proofing wasn't a necessity. (Beeswax rubbed onto whatever fabric you use then melted on with a hair dryer might do the trick)

In conclusion...

Pros:
Great idea
Does guard your toes a bit
Sturdy plastic material

Cons:
Large (husband wears 12.5 and this thing before molded resembled a clown shoe on him)
Falsely advertised
Cumbersome
Does not protect your feet from much other than other peoples feet/toe stubbing; beware of clumsy chicks in high heels.

Is this the best product out there? Unfortunately, yes.

Will it get the job done? Kinda.

Although it's a bit cumbersome, it really is a great idea and after tinkering around with it a bit, will get the job done. It's a good base to start at, but you will likely have to put a little elbow grease into customizing it to your specs.

Hope that helps!

title: Regulate your cycle!
text:
So we had been trying for 3 months when I started taking Cassava. My cycles were all over the place and I was looking for a natural way to balance myself and regulate my cycle so we could conceive sooner. The 3 months we were trying my cycles were 37, 46, and 41 days long (all over the place). I had done research and discovered the cassava root is known to help naturally regulate a woman's cycle and increase the chances of having twins. I had little to no interest in having twins, but I just really really wanted to have "A" baby. The two months of taking cassava root my periods regulated! Could be coincidence, or could be Cassava, may never know. My cycles went back to being their normal 34 days long, and now two months later, pregnant! If we find out it's more than one in there, I will update!

TIP: Only take Cassava root in the weeks you're ovulating, waiting on ovulation, and on your period. If you suspect your pregnant, I recommend to stop taking them. So in other words, stop taking after ovulation and until you get your next period (if you do!). The more research I did, although the root is good for regulating your cycle and moving your eggs, it has also been suspected to be linked to some miscarriages. One week, I got a really bad migraine for a few days, I stopped taking them for the time being. This illness was most likely unrelated, but since this is not FDA approved and it could have been caused by them, it was best to just stop for a few days. Keep in mind bad/expired/molded cassava root can cause cyanide poisoning. Not sure if this is in large doses, or what, but just keep in mind if you start showing symptoms similar to cyanide poisoning. Stop taking them and go to the ER. I chose this specific supplier based off this fact, because they have a lot of good reviews, testimonials, multiple products, and seemed the most "legit" out of all of them. Over all it is a natural product so I don't see how much harm it could really do to you. It seemed to work for us, even if it was a placebo effect.

title: Excellent for the price - Not heavy duty
text:
I purchased this product for two ninty-nine with prime shipping. I don't even know how that's possible, but it is relevant to the 5 star review. This is not a twenty or even fifteen dollar product, but I'd keep five stars for up to eight dollars. Expect the brush head to be flattened during shipping, and don't expect it to do any heavy duty scrubbing; it's just a light brush to break up debris and hair that's accumulated over time.

I used this to clean out 3 sink drains and 3 shower/bath drains and I was able to get it into all 6 drains all the way to its 5 foot length. You need to understand that getting any product 5 feet into a drain is not easy and won't just slide in with out a little effort--so keep that in mind when reading other reviews of this product. Just pump the brush up and down until it skips and gets past the trap. You have to grip the spring-rod near the drain and keep at it. It took me 3-5 minutes per drain to work it all the way down.

Another tip in cleaning drains is to remove the drain stop or drain screen before cleaning. If you have a hair catcher, those are easier to get in a drain, so you could run that in first to clear it up a bit, then run this one through.

title: Well designed, sturdy, but they aren't completely stink free and yes, they actually do expire
text:
The reviews saying that the counts were off are unfortunate but I've not experienced being shorted. These kits hold a considerable amount of waste but it can be difficult to gauge how many uses you can get out of the, at least at first. You don't want to overfill them. Each kit consists of a small bundle of TP, a wet wipe, a larger bag and a smaller ziploc bag. The larger bag fits into the netting of the Cleanwaste toilet which eventually gets inserted into the ziploc bag. Setting up is easy -- drop the ziploc bag into the mesh liner, underneath the larger bag where it will wait patiently. When you go to gather up your waste in the larger bag, gently squeeze the air out, tie a loop to seal the contents, and your ziploc is handy for the next step of double bagging since you've stashed it in a place where you won't lose it.

I can verify that over time, likely many years and with improper storage, the bags disintegrate and the Poo Powder solidifies and the whole kit is rendered useless. This unfortunate outcome was discovered when I came across what I believe was an ancient 12 pack that had been improperly stored or was just incredibly old.

The issues about stink are a matter of opinion, but my expectations are calibrated appropriately. If you leave the waste in an enclosed space, the sun is shining or humidity is high, then yeah, there's a bad stench. Using extra Poo Powder doesn't seem to help all that much to "cover up" the stink, but it's reasonable.

With each use of a bag, I get a pang of guilt that this is the epitome of single-use-plastic waste and the perfect example of an environmental problem in miniature. There's no getting around it so I try to conserve the usage and use real facilities when possible.

title: How to Change Intensity of Stimulation Setting
text:
The Electronic Muscle Stimulator (EMS) comes with excellent directions on how to pair the device to the Sleeplus APP through bluetooth and start using the device. However, it does not clearly describe WHEN to pair and HOW to use the Sleeplus APP with the EMS device.

The APP is used 1) to set the Intensity of the Stimulation of the pulse to the muscle in your throat, 2) to collect the data from the sleep session, 3) to report the analysis of the data, and 4) to record the snoring session of the night for your review.

The EMS device is normally used without pairing to the APP. If you wish to record the sound of the sleep session, then you pair the device with the APP during the entire sleep session. When you wish to synchronize the data from EMS with the APP, or to look at the analysis then you pair the EMS to the APP.

Whenever you wish to change the Intensity of Stimulation setting, tap on the cog/gear Settings symbol at the upper right corner of the session report. From the Settings Interface, you can 1) tap on "max intervention intensity" or 2) you can UNPAIR the EMS from bluetooth, then immediately PAIR the device to bluetooth to get to the interface for the Intensity of Stimulation setting. The Intensity of Stimulation of the pulse from the device can be set from 1 (weak) - 8 (strong). The reported Snores Detected, Snores Stopped and Success Rate helped me find my right intensity level.

title: Couldn't get the fit right, not for all faces
text:
I tried and tried over three days to get the eye cups positioned in a way that fit in this mask and finally gave up.

I work the graveyard shift so I sleep in a mask every single day. I prefer the 3D design for comfort and was tired of replacing thin foam 3D masks. I thought I'd try a more premium model and hoped a modular one would get me a more comfortable fit.

While this mask is nice and well-made from good materials, there were some issues that made it a poor fit for me.

First, the eye cups are much smaller than I expected (and I have a very small head and face) and made from a foam that I found too firm. I had to try to position it under the ridge of my eyebrows to seal out the light, which put very uncomfortable pressure on my eyes.

Also, I'm African American and this mask is really designed for a Caucasian face and head with a prominent nose bridge, narrow nostrils and sort of an egg-shaped head. My nose bridge is shallower, my nostrils are broad, and I have a prominent suboccipital ridge on the the back of my head. Any mask I wear has to sit above that ridge, or the strap will just slide down into my neck.

After much fiddling and positioning the straps every which way, I couldn't find a way to wear it that would seal out the light (I kept getting a large gap at the top just over my nose) and stay put. The single strap is a straight line with velcro and no elastic, so placing it higher on the back of my head caused the front of the mask to gap.

On my final attempt to sleep in this mask, I positioned the strap lower, but tightened it more, and woke up with marks all over my ears and ear pain that didn't go away for two hours. None of my failed sleep sessions in the mask provided an acceptable level of light blocking.

It's too bad, because the product is nice and the seller is great to deal with, but it just doesn't fit me. I'll be returning the product.

title: Conserves foundation!
text:
This makeup sponge is very effective in saving foundation. I previously only used regular wedge sponges, and I used to fly through my foundation. This silicone sponge has cut my foundation use in half (at least).

Before purchasing this, I read some reviews that talked about poor coverage, but as I expected, you have to adjust to using this type of sponge. It doesn't function like a traditional sponge. You have to adjust to using much less makeup, otherwise you'll end up with way too much on your face. I also read one reviewer state it felt like she was jus wiping it around, but foundation shouldn't be wiped; it should be dabbed. I found that using the silicone sponge followed by a traditional makeup sponge works better in difficult areas (around the nose, under the eyes). I use the silicone sponge for blanket coverage and as much blending as possible, and then I finish with a regular makeup sponge to clean up the hard to reach spots.

I would recommend this sponge to anyone. I anticipate it will save me a lot of money in foundation. It is also very easy to clean. I just rinse it under the sink with hand soap.

title: Fragrance free, gentle and truly effective!!
text: I am in love with this French pharmacy gem! The shipping and price were very reasonable and the performance of this product is truly impressive. I am nearly 40 and have oily skin I take very good care of. Despite my best efforts, I have the inevitable few fine lines and gravity is slowly taking effect. I DO notice a marked difference in the morning after using this! It visibly plumps and hydrates the skin and I think it even helps soften some patches of eczema I've tried it on. I highly recommend applying this cream over a retinol or vitamin c serum. The results are smoother, brighter skin in the morning. Note: due to the nature of the active ingredient, hyaluronic acid, which attracts moisture from the environment, I would NOT recommend this to be used alone in dry climates without an accompanying humenctant.  If there is no moisture in the air or added to the skin, it will inevitably pull water from the skin itself.  I will continue to lean on Ialuset as my favorite night cream and recommend it to friends. It performs better than some I have tried and sold (as I used to work in HE cosmetics) at several times the price. Plus, there are no added fragrances or colorants to irritate sensitive skin and I have not had issues with it causing acne.

text: I received this yesterday and basically ran to try it out. It’s very simple to operate (instructions were poorly worded, but you really don’t need them). You let the product heat up until the black silicone strip on the curler turns white, then curl lashes for several seconds. It worked really well, but I will say on the low setting I felt a bit of heat coming off. Not painful or anything, just made me nervous. The curler is clunky, so it was difficult for me to get all my eyelashes into the curler on the first try - especially given that I was nervous to put anything warm up to my eyeball LOL. I got a good curl using it twice per eye. I curled the center lashes, then angled it to curl those outer corner lashes. I will say, once I must have squeezed too hard and the curler clamp slipped…so that didn’t make me feel good, which is why I took off one star. I wish the handle was more sturdy…the plastic feels a little cheap, which makes me nervous when you’re putting heat near your eye! I think with a little more practice, however, this will work out well. It really made a huge difference in my lashes…I didn’t even really need to use mascara for the length! The eyelash curler did that for me.

title: Poor execution of a good idea
text:
This is a good idea poorly executed.

1. The 2.5” height of the cushion changes your orientation with the seat and the floor. Because I’m so much higher up, the floor is further away so with my feet on the floor, the leading edge of the cushion digs into my thighs. It’s uncomfortable after just a few minutes. Purple should have tapered the leading edge. I’ll probably resort to cutting it myself with scissors. The change in height could also pose a problem as a cushion in a car—your head may graze the ceiling and the gas and brake pedals will be further away

2. The divot for your tailbone is far too wide to take pressure off your tailbone. The cushion is divided lengthwise into thirds with the middle third stepped down, ostensibly to relieve pressure on your tailbone. However unless you’re fairly wide in the caboose, both your tailbone AND your sit bones will both rest inside the middle section, providing no relief. The way it’s supposed to work is your sit bones should rest on the higher two outsides with just your tailbone in the middle. So this will only really provide tailbone relief for wider cabooses.

3. This is a surprisingly heavy seat cushion. My 10 lb cat feels lighter to carry so I’m not sure I’d consider this portable.

4. The zipper cover that comes with the cushion is thin and cheap looking.

5. Considering its flaws, it’s overpriced. There are very likely less expensive and better designed tailbone-relieving cushions out there.

title: It was packaged very nicely and looked higher end if you are considering this ...
text:
I've had the brush for just over two weeks now. I typically shave 5 or 6 days a week (get lazy on the weekends) and I usually do two passes when I shave. I had a cheap pure badger brush before this one that worked well, but shed a lot of hairs. I was impressed when I received the brush. It was packaged very nicely and looked higher end if you are considering this for a gift. When I actually took the brush out it had more weight than my previous brush, but not overly heavy. The handle is very nice visually and feels great too. Overall the brush looks and feels like a very high quality product.

When I used the brush for the first time the musk smell from the hair was very strong. After my two weeks of using it though, it has diminished greatly. I use Taylor of Old Bond Street Sandalwood soap, so not an overly fragrant soap. The company owner send you a welcome email with tips to get rid of the smell faster if this is an issue for you. It definitely lathers different than my previous brush, but I'm getting used to it now. The hairs feel smooth on my skin, but still provide a nice lather.

Things to mention, that I would not really consider negative, there were a couple of small hairs that came out the first day or two. These were much shorter than the main hairs of the brush, so I'm thinking they may have just been stuck in there with the other hairs and came out with the use of the brush. Since those first couple of hairs, nothing else has fallen out. None of the long hairs have fallen out. And the brush does not fit into my Escali stand. It will fit at the base of the hairs where it meets the handle, but I'm not sure that is really the best place to hang the brush. With how nice the brush is though, I am happy to look for a new stand.

Overall, I would highly recommend this brush. I have already spread the word to my wet shave friends.

I had another brush (Van Der Hagen's) that I liked well enough until the bristles started coming out after less than a year. However, I didn't realize how much better a brush could be until I got this one. Although it is smaller than my previous one, it creates a thick, luscious lather easy peasy. It barely fits in the Perfecto Deluxe Razor holder but it *does* fit so I'm fine with it. And, as a bald-by-choice guy, I shave a LOT of real estate ; )

I should also say that the customer service follow-up was outstanding. I got two emails giving me tips on using and storing the brush. They clearly take pride in their product.

I'll check back in a year to verify that the bristles are still holding tight.

UPDATE (1/20/2018): So, it's over two years later and this brush is still going strong. Loses a few hairs during use but that's normal. I'm pretty careful about fully rinsing it each time, drying it off thoroughly, and hanging it back on its stand. With this sort of care, this brush is still going strong.

title: High Quality, High Maintenance Shaving Brush that helps you get a great shave.
text: This shaving brush is nice and soft and feels good on the skin. The handle design fits nicely in my hand while using it. The first time i used it 4 hairs just fell out which surprised me. It turns out I was using it wrong. You have to learn how to properly use one of these if you want it to last a long time. My first mistake was using hot water. Hot water loosens the bond the hairs have to the handle and if you let the hot water get to the handle, the hairs will start falling out rather quickly. So now I use room temperature water or a little bit warmer during use. I haven't had any hairs come out since. My next mistake happened when soaping the brush and creating the lather. You have to wrap your hand around the hairs close to the base with your thumb and forefinger for support. If you dont then the hairs will fray outwards and possibly fall out or become damaged forever. Also you can't push too hard. You only need the tip of the brush to make contact with the soap when creating the lather, you dont need to use all the hairs by pushing harder. If you do your best to protect and support the bristles then you will extend the life of the brush. When you are finished with the brush and have rinsed it out you need to get some of the water out so you need to shake the water out. Supporting the bristles again is very important here. Another thing I learned is that no matter how careful you are using it, the bristles still want to fray out after you're done using it. I found that re-using the mesh that the brush comes wrapped in helps keep the brush from fraying. I will include a picture of it. It may be a high maintenance brush but it Gives you a high quality shave and if you take care of it it should work for a long time.

Bought this to replace my first brush, a cheap badger hair that did its job but was starting to show serious wear (the wood handle was starting to go at the point where it met the hairs). Definitely wanted to go with a non-wood handle after that happened!

I spent a lot of time with the brush before writing this, because I wanted to get a serious impression of the thing before writing a real review. I like it! the bristles are definitely softer than my previous brush, which feels pleasant when I use it. I decided to use the tip given to make the hairs softer, using the soapy water and the "soak" in my shaving lather. Not sure in retrospect I would do it again? Also, since I did this early on I can't say whether it was the cause, but there are some sorta scraggly hairs around the peripheral that make the brush look slightly less than perfect now. Part of me wants to yank them out, but the other part of me worries if I do that other outer hairs will take their place? Anyway. Not a dealbreaker by any means.

Going back to the handle, I definitely love the way it looks, and the slight heft of it in my hand. I would maaaaaaaybe prefer if it were slightly more hefty, but overall I like the feel. I also appreciate the it is slightly bigger than my last one.

One final point. I've found that with this brush I have to be much more mindful of shaking out water before I begin lathering, as compared to my old brush. I see it as a good thing, as water retention seems to be a positive brush quality. Still, food for thought.

Thanks to Latherwhip for making a sweet brush!

title: You could get a smelly one, but the good ones are great!
text:
This is my first shaving brush, which I selected because of all the great reviews on Amazon. I just started using it today, and I have to say I don't know if I can continue using it. The smell of this thing is right out of a barnyard, and a filthy one at that. The first time I washed it, the water was actually brown coming out of the brush. I washed and rinsed it about 4 times more before I used it and the smell remained. It's been drying all day and the smell still persists when it's dry. My partner has 2 shaving brushes from The Art of Shaving and neither one of them smells like an animal or its excrement the way this one does... I want to evaluate this for its functional merits, but I simply can't get past the smell!

UPDATE 4/13/2016
As many other reviewers have noted, this company has impeccable customer service. As soon as I posted my review above, I was contacted and had a new brush at my door a couple of days later. The new one wasn't as smelly as the first, and I again followed the directions on how to prep it. I use it every shave now. There's still a slight smell, which I can't tell is from the glue or the hair, but it's tolerable. I still have the original, smelly one, which I haven't spent much time working on, but I might see if I can get it to a point where it's smell is manageable as well. I can't give these guys 5 stars, even though the product is great and they have great customer service, because I can't help but believe a better QA process or cleaning process when producing these would reduce or even eliminate the need for prepping instructions and replacements.

title: Very Good Brush
text:
I shave at the gym 5 days a week and purchased a less expensive brush (not that this is an expensive brush) to use there. I did that because I over the years I have left many things in the locker room never to see them again and didn't want to spend too much on a brush I may lose. I use this brush at home on the weekends or days when I am working from home. I am very happy with the performance of this brush. If you are new to this type of shaving there are two types of brushes, fan loft and bulb loft. This is a very pronounced bulb loft. Some people prefer the fan loft as there is more brush to face contact, but I prefer the bulb loft. It's a personal choice. A fan loft is better at lathering your face if you use the same circular motion to apply the lather to your face as you do lathering the brush in your cup. A bulb loft is better at lathering in the cup (IMO) and you use a painting vice circular motion to apply the lather to your face. This brush performs very well and returns to its original shape (which is very well groomed) when dry. I dry it inverted on a Perfecto Deluxe Chrome Razor and Brush Stand. Great quality, a great price, performs great and looks good on the stand (my wife doesn't make me hide it in a drawer). If you are looking a for a good everyday brush, I highly recommend this one.

Update: Now that I have been using this brush for a few weeks, I have changed the number of stars from 4 to 5. The more I use this brush, the more I like it. It whips the soap in my cup very well, loads grate, is very soft on my face and applies a rich layer of lather if you use the proper (painting on) technique. Buy this brush. You won't be disappointed.

title: I wanted to love this brush...and with patience my expectations were met
text:
I was attracted by size and shape of this brush and was impressed by the multitude of reviews praising its attributes. The confirmation and physical performance of this brush met expectations. After using this brush regularly for the last few months I have to say I'm quite disappointed. A limited amount of shedding can be expected for any brush especially during a break in period, but this brush continues to lose hair with regularity unlike any other shave brush I own. Hardly a shave goes by where I'm not picking at least 2 or 3 loose hairs out of my soap container or lather bowl. This has become so frustrating I am retiring this brush from regular use. Needless to say I am sadly disappointed and had higher expectations for this product.

Update: I've been contacted by Adam, the distributor of this brush. He has assured my experience with this brush is the rare exception and is sending a replacement to prove this point. I will use the replacement for a reasonable period and update this posting if I experience an improvement. I must say that I am impressed by his attentiveness to correct the problem and his resolve to stand behind his product. I've bumped up my review by a star to reflect the level of customer service and the distributor's commitment to his product.

Update #2 - I quickly received the promised replacement and have been using it regularly for the last three weeks. I am happy to report that other than a few hairs coming loose the first few shaves - which is common as a brush is first broken in - the brush has been performing admirably. I can honestly say the loss of hair is not an issue with this second brush, and must attribute the problem with the first brush as an exception to the norm. I am happy to be among the many that can now issue a favorable report on this brush and in turn I have bumped up my rating with an additional star. Kudos to a distributor who cares enough about his product to contact his customers and go the extra mile to address a problem in a world where most are happy to take the money and run.

text: Don't waste your money. This is an inferior product - the tips of the hairs have been trimmed to shape, which means that this brush can never be as soft as a top quality badger brush. It sheds. Contrary to what other reviews here say, this is not normal for a quality brush, although it does seem to be normal for this brand. The knot is not very dense, and therefore this brush will have significant issues with tangling. The handle is nice, though. For the same money, you can get a true top-quality boar brush (Semogue Owner's Club), or 2 outstanding boar brushes (Omega Pro 48/49). Decent badger brushes (such as Vulfix Super Badger) start at $50, and good ones are usually $100+. You get what you pay for.

title: Belifu did it again. My second TENS machine and it is even better than the previous one
text:
As my subject reveal, this is my second TENS machine from Belifu. I was asked to review it as a past customer and I was very excited to do so as I can swear by the benefits of a TENS/EMS machine for those who have a back problem like me. I purchased my first device about a year ago with the recommendation of my acupuncturist and I have seen a great benefit using it since then. When Belifu asked me to review their new version, I was excited and I looked forward to a use an even more improved unit with the option of having 4 independent channels as opposed to the 2 I had with the older machine. So, my expectations proved to be correct that the new device is really good. It feels slightly different on your body, much less painful and more ticklish feeling in allmost all of the settings so it was much easier to keep using every day. My wife also started using it and she has benefited a lot too and we both keep using it. While the old one is smaller and feels more solid, the new one is not bad at all and has a better screen and easier user experience for selecting the type of session (out of 24) and more control of the levels and timer. Did I say, it has 4 independent channels, which can allow you to treat all your body at once? Pads that come with it are very easy to use and last a very long time without losing their adhesiveness and effectiveness.

I have recommended this machine to my friends with any muscle or back issues because I like it a lot. Overall I am extremely happy with it and highly recommend it to others who can benefit from a TENS/EMS device

title: Easy To Use And Accurate
text:
Everyone, no matter how healthy, needs a blood pressure monitor at home. Heart disease is the number one cause of death in the United States and so it makes good sense to monitor your heart health. Thankfully, this blood pressure monitor makes that easy to do. It comes complete with a detailed setup manual and on the reverse, how to check your blood pressure with this device. You should be taking your first reading within just a couple of minutes of opening the box.

The screen is nice because it is reversed from the usual dark on light LCD screens. It makes it easier to read I think and the green, orange, and red indicators that show where your blood pressure reading falls on a scale is a nice touch. You don't even have to know what normal or elevated blood pressure actually is. The LED's will tell you if you are in a normal, elevated, or high risk range with just a glance. With that being said, you should also see your physician for checkups. As nice and accurate as this monitor is, it is no replacement for professional medical care. By using this monitor you will know if you should make an appointment to discuss elevated blood pressure with your doctor.

The device is as user friendly as a blood pressure monitor can be I think. It is accurate, easy to read, and can track your blood pressure reading over time. I would recommend it for anyone wanting to keep track of their blood pressure the easy way.

title: Good quality, flavor of cinnamon
text:
This was my first time trying MATCHA Green Tea. I enjoyed it. The instructions say to stir it into hot water, which I'm assuming is necessary in order to best mix-in the product with the water. It's a very fine powder that mixes and dissolves easily. However, I liked it even better over ice and plan to try it with a little milk next time, in order to give it a creamier texture. It has a slightly sweet taste, but there are only 1.5 grams of sugar alcohols. It has a little bit of fruit taste, but mainly tastes like cinnamon. It's too soon to say if it will improve my sleep and some of the other health benefits that are advertised (in general) for MATCHA Green Tea. But the nice taste is off to a good start and I will buy again if I also see sleep/health improvements.

My only nitpick is the instructions could be better. It says to use one "scoop" into 6-8 oz. of water. A "scoop" is not included in the packaging. There is no such measurement as a "scoop", so that is just a really pointless instruction. Apparently a serving is 7.8 grams, so I assumed that is how much to use. I don't know about you all, but my kitchen measurements are in teaspoons and tablespoons. I don't think many residential kitchens use grams. So that was also annoying. I had to look it up online, in order to get an idea of the suggested amount to use. It's about 1.5 teaspoons or about .5 a tablespoon. I used half of a soup spoon and that seemed about right for my taste.

title: Awesome Product, $$$ but worth it
text:
Before I go on about Tangy Tangerine let me give some background for a greater feel of its effects. I'm 26 years old, 5'8" and 170lbs, athletic build. I eat organic foods, workout out intensely at least 3 times a week, and take protein shakes and supplements. I've lived a mostly healthy lifestyle for quite awhile and have experimented with different vitamins/minerals/supplements. I have developed a very good sense to my body's needs and supplement/eat accordingly. What turned me on to T.T. (Tangy Tangerine) was my research into the level of vitamin/mineral deficiencies that most people have and the all the effects that stem from such deficiencies. My main goal from taking this product was to just get all the essential/trace minerals and vitamins I would need and hopefully some more energy. Below are the list of things I PERSONALLY experienced.

The Good:
1. Much greater energy throughout the day.
- No more naps in the middle of the day or the evening, consistent stable energy all day long.
- No more coffee needed, I only drink green tea now.
2. Great bodily fulfillment when taking the product.
- I take 3 scoops in the morning. I feel full and don't have to eat my usual breakfast till 1.5 hours later.
- My meals are sets of 4-5 and I only eat when I feel hungry and stop eating as soon as I'm not hungry.
3. Cognitive clarity.
- I work on a laptop all day and the T.T. allows me to focus for longer stretches of time.
4. Slight Weight-loss.
- I dropped 4lbs in 2 weeks (not meaning to) and was still able to increase my strength while doing so.
5. Greater immunity.
- I was never sickly, but I never got sick while on the product (more info in notes below).
6. Eliminates nutrient-deficient headaches
- I've been susceptible to such headaches since childhood, I've never gotten such headaches while using T.T.

The Bad:
1. Expensive.
- I buy in bulk to ease the total cost, but still not cheap right off the bat.
2. Withdrawal effect.
- When you run out, your body gets angry....very angry. (more info in notes below)

NOTES:
My reference to the greater immunity and withdrawal effect are related in nature. I misjudged my timing before re-ordering and ran out of T.T. My energy level DROPPED...big time. I had to double dose on tea, B vitamins, and sprouts just to keep myself from passing out at work (trying hard to stay away from coffee). I also started getting my headaches, had to eat a bunch of sprouts to keep them at bay. My ability to sleep was greatly diminished. I also got sick with a headcold just 1 day before my shipment of T.T. arrived (I rarely get sick). Once I got the TT, it helped a lot with keeping the symptoms down and letting the illness run its course. T.T. has had the most dramatic effects of all the vitamins and supplements I have ever tried. Your body truly starts to crave it when it learns that it gets massive nutrients from it.

Aside from the T.T., I still supplement with calcium, magnesium, glucosamine, fish oil, Vitamin D/E, selenium, potassium, chlorella, and spirulina. T.T. is not an "is all, ends all" product... due to my lifestyle and my darker skin tone (need more Vitamin D), I need the additional vits/minerals for my bones/joints and to compensate for my family history of certain ailments. It's important to supplement with T.T. based on body weight and personal levels of deficiency, this is very important and a fundamental weakness with most health products. Different people = different needs. I'd also like to note that I have not complained about the taste. I may be in the minority, but I love the taste of this product. I hate sodas and sugary drinks, but I love the sweetness of this product. I'm also one of those guys that can down most protein shakes so as long as it's chocolate flavored. :-)

In regards to the cost, T.T. will save $$$ in the long-run...big time. This has to do with the fact that you will (based on my research, please do your own) DRAMATICALLY decrease your chances of getting debilitating diseases like diabetes, cancer, heart disease, etc. I'm a practical and skeptical guy and only use what makes sense and what works. If you're on a tight budget and can't afford organics or other healthy products, I would strongly suggest doing what you can to still take this product. Organic foods are still deficient in vitamins/minerals due to the nutrient depleted soils. You'll consume less crap (saves money now), you'll get sick less (saves money now/future), and it'll help you adjust your lifestyle to that of a healthy standard (save money future). Unless you have a personal organic, nutrient-dense garden with a variety of foods for all the bodies needs, you need a product like T.T.

For reference purposes, you can look up the the Supplemental Facts at the Youngevity website (sub-link under the product). Also, Google/Youtube Dr. Joel Wallach and/or Dr. Ben Fuchs for additional info in regards to the science behind proper nutrient supplementation and the effects of nutrient deficiencies.

I give this 4/5 stars strictly due to the fact that it's expensive and nothing to do with its effectiveness. I bought this from the its host site, Youngevity, but I wanted to throw my 2 cents out here.

title: Update
text:
Thus far I will give 4 stars for the timely and professional fashion my package was delivered, and will update another star depending on how things go. After doing extensive research on L. Sakei , reading it's benefits for the sinuses/overall health, I've finally decided to give it a go, and have begun my first round of treatment today. I have been an allergy/ moderate asthma sufferer most of my life, but have never really had major sinus problems, although for some reason (starting around December 2019) I've been having the WORST problems with periodic sinus infection & CONSTANT congestion! My problem seems to be, no matter what I do, I can usually only breath through one nostril, and (sorry to be graphic) but I always seem to wake up with a crusty nasty layer of booger on the bottom insides of my nose, usually light yellow, sometimes dark in color, I have been on antibiotics a couple times to no avail, but I figure something has to be wrong in there. I literally haven't been able to freely breath out of my nose for an entire year now! You can imagine the mental effects this has! I am currently in the depths of tortuous nasal rebound congestion from the overuse of Afrin, and will be stopping cold turkey for my experiment with L. Sakei, the only things I will be taking is Sudaphed 12 hr, and Nasacort (both of which DO NOT cause rebound nasal congestion) and I'm only using them because I need some kind of relief, and to jump start the healing process with Nasacort (a steroid). I prepared my L. Sakei today with just a little bottled water in a glass (a 2 second pour) and put two scoops in with the tiny red spoon that comes with the package. I proceeded to swish the water around in my mouth, proceed to dab a q tip into my nostrils a couple times, then swish the remainder of the drink again and swallow. This will be the last thing I try before going to a ear/nose/throat specialist, & will probably result in needing some kind of surgery, hoping for the best! Will give an update here in around 5 days.

Update: After 4 days I have discontinued usage, days 1- 3 seemed to be going well, I could actually feel the little bacteria doing something good, I carefully followed my routine each evening and was very committed & hopeful after reading all of these positive reviews. I planned to take a little break after day 5 as others have recommended online, but day 4 was a different story, after doing my regular dosage in the evening I started to feel a bit weird as the night went on, it sort of felt like the onset of a panic attack (for those who know that bad feeling) but I knew it was something different. I proceeded to take a nap and woke up around 9pm to play some PS4, and around 2-3 hrs into my video game (midnight), I was having trouble focusing on my game & noticed that panic feeling was back, but this time I had a weird sort of itchy pressure behind my eyes. I went to the bathroom to look in the mirror, and to my shock..the bottom halves of my eyes were completely blood shot & red as can be, the only feeling I can compare it to was when I would get pink eye as a kid, and this was affirmed when I woke up the next morning and I had that gross gooey discharge around my eyes. I felt extremely weak and drained, but pushed myself to go to Walgreens to pick up some Emergen-C packets, and some Pink Eye relief eye drops, which thankfully provided some almost immediate relief & made the redness nearly go away. The rest of the night was not so pleasant, luckily I had some time off from work, so I decided to stay in and rest for as long as possible, around 9 pm I noticed that feeling again, my body still felt weak & drained, and noticed I was kind of sweaty & hot, to my surprise I took my temperature and noticed I was near 100 degree fever, so I immediately took 2 Ibuprofen and a Xanax to try and calm myself down to some degree normalcy. At this point I was freaking out & starting to question whether or not I possibly was infected with Covid, luckily at this point my medicine was starting to relax me, and I told myself that if I didn't feel any better in the morning, I was going to call my doctor to set up a check up & inquire a Covid19 test. I woke up the next morning after a good 9-10 hour slumber feeling a lot better, my temperature was back to 97.1 and the eye pressure was gone (although still a bit itchy) I felt a lot more energized, and feel even better today. Sadly, I have no health insurance so every time I go to my doctor it cost an arm & a leg, I'm not sure what happened..perhaps this was just my body's way of pushing out any kind of infection I had going on in my sinuses? My stomach also has been kind of out of wack during this time, almost like it's telling my body "hey, everything was fine down here until you started using this bacteria". Anyway, not sure what happened, I'm glad this works well for so many people and hate to give bad reviews, but I've decided to discontinue the L. Sakei, it's just not for me.

title: Another broken experience
text:
Fitbit replaced my aria scale, which for no reason I am aware of suddenly stopped working after 3 months, of once a day use and I am only 65kg. Thank You.

Sadly my replacement fitbit band has also just come apart in the same way the original one did. They only lasted a couple of months. I am about to request they replace the replacement.

To be fair they have always, in the past, replaced without quibbling.

It appears to me there could be something seriously wrong with their quality control. I am a 65 year old retired office worker. I have never abused their products in any way. I invariably get excellent life out of all products I buy (for example one of my cars is 39 years old, I purchased it new and it is still works fine).

I find it unacceptable for a range of products to fail as consistently as fitbit products have for me. I have never had from any manufacturer as bad a quality control experience as I have had from fitbit.

if either of their products fails again I will take them back to the chain store I purchased them from (one of the largest ) in the knowledge that they are obliged under consumer law to refund the purchase price as the goods are clearly not of merchantable quality.

I will take it back to the store because although it is not their fault fitbit products fail, their profit margins are insufficient to enable them to stock such products, and their reputation is of value to them, and it would not take many such actions from me and others to have the product withdrawn from their, and other retailers shelves.

This would be a pity as the idea behind the products is a fine one - it is only its execution that appears to let them down. However I feel I ought to have some obligation to protect others from their apparent poor quality control.

I could never discuss their products, if asked, without mentioning my poor quality control experience with them. I could never recommend them, but only because of their apparent poor quality control relative to their selling price.

title: Brownie-ish protein bar; Nutrition facts; Freshness date
text:
"Tactical" supplies have become big business, and this product's name ("field bar") and story position it well for that. But like most consumer tactical supplies, they're for ordinary use, not only for when the commies come to get us.

These are more crumbly and drier than a brownie typically is. Not the kind of thing that would be considered a success for a brownie, but for a protein bar it's not bad.

The taste is sweet with mild but distinct flavors. The Chocolate PB Blondie has bits of coconut in it for a nice addition to the taste and texture. The Chocolate Cereal Crunch does have some added crunch from ground-up Rice Krispies-style cereal, though the effect is more subtle than I expected.

There's very little of the usual bitter protein concentrate taste, don't notice it unless I focus on it.

15-16g protein, from soy, is comparable to other protein bars.

The sugar content is also typical for a protein bar, 16-17g per 60g bar (26-28% by weight), about half what's in a candy bar.

Total carbs are 21-23g (35-38%), with 3g fiber (5%).

The blondie has 260 calories and 16g fat (26%). The crunch has 240 calories and 10g fat (17%).

The freshness date on mine is January 21, 2021.

Full ingredients and nutritional info are given in the photos at the upper left of the main product page. "Contains peanuts. Manufactured in a facility that processes peanuts, milk, and soy."

title: Ingredients
text:
These are firm, moist, chewy, lightly sweet with a little cherry taste. Not much like a candy bar, but pleasant enough.

The sugar content is 19%, compared to 50% or more for a typical candy bar.

A lot of the fat and 260 calories are from the almonds, which are high in what's generally regarded as a healthy oil.

The ingredients: organic whole-grain rolled oats, almonds, date paste, organic honey, pea protein crisps (pea protein, brown rice flour), hemp hearts, vegetable glycerin, cherries, salt.

Allergy info: contains almonds, may also contain traces of tree nuts and peanuts.

The freshness date for mine is October 23, 2020.

title: Goldilocks gloves, M true to size
text:
I like this thickness of glove, with more tactility than the heavy-duty cleaning gloves I've tried, and much more strength than even the strongest surgical-style ones.

These have a cotton lining (flocking) that starts at the wrist. It makes it easier to get the gloves on and off, absorbs a little sweat, and may strengthen the glove. It can be harder to clean, though, so some prefer unlined gloves for repeated use or for use with nasty substances that have to be completely washed out for reuse.

They grip fairly well, not quite as well as bare hands for some things. Some people are saying they're not so great for handling dishes in soapy water. That's not what I have in mind for them, they're fine for general cleaning.

I usually wear medium, and these mediums fit well, snugly in most places. At 8-1/2" my palm is a bit larger than specified for medium in the size photo (upper left of the main produce page), but my fingers are short, even for these. I have some other mediums from this brand without the lining too; these are a little snugger because of it.

I've noticed that this kind of glove, with the right and left fit, tends to be tight between the thumb and palm when the thumb is stretched out, but that hasn't interfered with their practical use. They may wear out faster there.

Cleanbear is a recent brand from China.

I got the +1.5 lenses, a little stronger than I need but they work fine for book-reading distance. They make my 15" laptop screen look like it's my old 17". I have to sit a little close with these to use them with the laptop. For me they work best for things between 12 and 21 inches from my eyes. (With some +2.0 lenses it's 13 to 17 inches, so these work better for me.)

The optical quality is OK, no distortion except for pronounced pincushion effect (straight lines get bowed inward at the middle) when looking through the edges. It's normal to have some pincushion distortion for reading glasses, and it the lenses are as large as these, you get more at the edges than with smaller glasses.

The current product description seems to be of some other offer. I got three pairs, as stated in the current product title, not four, and no storage bags or cleaning cloth.

The measurements are as shown in the product description. 5.5" or 140mm for the arms (temples) is a little long for me and most other people, but since these are so light and the arms pull inward a little, they fit securely. They should fit most people.

Made in China.

title: Smells great, BUT ...
text: As of 8/9/21, this product does not come with an inner protective seal, or an outer cellophane protective seal. I had ordered one bottle, noticed no tamper-proof protective seals, so assumed it had been opened, returned it and ordered a second, only to have it come without any protective seals. I contacted the company and they assured me of "authenticity," but stated they do not use inner, or outer, protective seals. There are too many points along the shipping, storing and return processes, where a bottle could be tampered with. Anything that we put on our skin, or in our body, I think should be sold with a tamper-proof seal, assuring it is as it was when it left the manufacturer. If you don't care about protective seals, then this product may be for you.

title: Very good sponges that clean your skin well without any irritation.
text:
First off I will reveal that I received this product for a discount in exchange for an honest review and evaluation. So if you don't trust these types of reviews you can move along. However, I will say that for a couple dollars off a product there isn't much incentive to lie and I always offer truthful evaluations.

That said.... Although I have a good deal of experience with skin care both professionally and personally, this is the first time I have tried these Konjac Sponges. I've wanted to try them since they came out but never decided to shell out the money. So when I saw these as a very modest price I went for it. I've used Clarisonic brushes and a very wide array of other products and devices to cleanse the face including sea sponges. You name it and I've tried it.

As others have noted these two sponges come dried looking kind of like cow patties (sorry but that was my first impression). They come in a cute little mesh bag to hold the spare one and there is a thread attached to each for hanging to dry between uses. I had to soak it for several minutes before it became soft enough to use. I hung it up to dry over night with the intent of using it in the morning. When I woke it was still soft and had not become hard and dry like it's original form. I live in the Pacific Northwest so it may never totally dry between uses up here. I am not sure it this will grow mold staying constantly moist in this environment and I know of no way to sanitize it with the possible exception of maybe putting in the microwave for 30 to 40 second. Have not tried that yet. Maybe the charcoal which is said to be infused into the sponge will prevent fungus and mold. Time will tell.

The sponge is slightly slippery to touch when wet. Much different than the touch and texture of a sea sponge. I placed my typically amount of cleanser on it and was pleasantly surprised that it was soft on the skin and it lathered up the cleanser so much that I will have to cut back by 50% next time. Although soft on the skin I felt that it would have a slight exfoliation effect. Not like a Clarisonic but enough for sensitive skin. I would say the exfoliation would be similar to a soft wash cloth. It would most definitely clean your skin better than hands alone which has been my typical practice. I'm too lazy to use a wash cloth and have to wash each one after every use. Thus, the reason I was attracted to trying these Konjac sponges. I won't say I'm in love with these sponges yet but I very much like them. I would need a month or more of use to determine if these sponges are significant better for my sensitive skin than a Clarisonic. In the past I have only been able to use the Clarisonic a few times a week. Otherwise it inflames my skin too much. These sponges should clean my skin better than hands alone while not causing any adverse effects to my redness prone skin. That is a huge plus for me.

They are really worth a try and the price of these are significant less than others I have seen on Amazon. I would definitely recommend trying them out especially if you have sensitive skin and the Clarisonic is just too abrasive. Just my opinion, but I think American's scrub their skin way too much and too hard. Your face isn't the bathroom floor! In my own case I think this over scrubbing mentality resulted in my now overly sensitive skin. Use caution and be gentle when cleaning your facial skin.

title: Delicious but some bars are packaged incorrectly
text:
These are the tastiest protein bars I have tasted so far. They are not dry and hard like other protein bars on the market. I've tried Alani Nu and Quest Bars (plus others brands) and these by far taste the best. I bought the variety pack to try out all the flavors and all of them tasted very delicious. Like a candy bar. The box that it came in was a bit damaged, maybe from transit? But the bars were fine.

For those who are interested to know about taste/flavor
My favorites were:
Dark Chocolate Raspberry: Tastes just like the flavor name. Dark chocolate and raspberries.
Peanut nutter: Tastes like chocolate and peanut butter. Kind of like a Little Debbie Nutty Bar.
Salted Peanut: White chocolate. This one tasted like a softer version of a PayDay bar.
Chocolate Chip Salted Caramel: I didn't notice any chocolate chip but it did have caramel in it. Tastes like salted caramel.

My least favorite:
Caramel chaos: had no caramel and it tasted like a chocolate protein bar just not as dry as the usual protein bars you get. Really confused on the name and flavor. If I had purchased this flavor alone instead of the variety pack, I would have been disappointed.
Chocolate chip cookie dough: tasted like cookie dough (you wouldn't be able to tell the flavor without reading the name) with some bits and pieces of chocolate chips. Not bad but I personally wouldn't go out of my way to purchase this flavor.

I would repurchase the variety pack again since I really enjoyed 4/6 of the flavors. Do read the instructions on the box regarding ingredients, allergies, and storage conditions.

EDIT:
So I'm finishing up the rest of the bars and I noticed that the last caramel chaos bar is completely different from the first bar I tried from the pack. The first bar was completely chocolate inside with no caramel and the last bar had a very thin layer of caramel on top with a peanut butter like filling with bits and pieces of chocolate chip. Did they mispackage some bars into the wrong wrapper?? Were any of these bars the actual caramel chaos because neither of them tasted anything like caramel.

Finished my second box and I have come to the conclusion that some of these bars are PACKAGED INCORRECTLY. Caramel Chaos and Salted Caramel have been different bars... Caramel Chaos has been packaged with a Salted Caramel bar, Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough bar, a plain chocolate bar, and an unknown one (which I'm guessing may be the real identity). The last Salted Caramel bar I had was a plain chocolate one, similar to the first Caramel Chaos bar I had. No caramel, just chocolate like a Tootsie Roll. The bars are delicious but I'm not really happy to find my bars being packaged incorrectly.

title: Great price for a useless robot you have to manually make vacuum
text:
I bought this on Black Friday due to the discounted price and (at the time) good reviews. Now that I'm able to use it, it doesn't function at ALL. I have an open floor plan with a foyer, kitchen, dining room and living room. The first time I used it, it was so loud we couldn't hear the TV. I set it to go when we left the house. Came back and it hadn't done anything. It also won't even return to the dock so it was dead and I couldn't figure out the problem. Let it charge overnight, tried it again. It got stuck on my fireplace like five times. It only vacuumed one small section of the living room over and over. I had it set to rotate between all three settings. Had to let it charge again. Next time, it gave me a brush roll error every 30 seconds or so. If the tiniest piece of anything gets vacuumed up, or it gets some hair (human hair, not even pet hair.. so just the little bit of natural shedding from a woman's hair), it gives a brush roll error. Six or seven brush roll errors later, even when it had been cleaned and I verified there was NOTHING in or near the brush roll, it just wouldn't even try. Wouldn't return to the dock, either. Charged it again. Next time, it got stuck in the very open not even really a corner where the back door and couch meet. It just sat there. In the end, it hasn't vacuumed up anything at all and doesn't work. You can't run it when you're home because of how insanely loud it is, but if you run it while you're out it won't work because it gets stuck on absolutely everything and gives an error every 30 seconds where you have to manually fix it. Very, very disappointed.

Note: Open floor plan, most of it is flat tile, the only obstructions would be walls, the dining room table and chair (which isn't even where it got stuck) and a couch. No pets or pet hair.
