title: Great concept but overall has design flaws
text:
The idea of a vibrating pillow that you can hug is a fantastic concept! The pillow itself is pretty soft and is a nice texture.
Personally I think there's a couple design flaws, I'm sure with little more work they could easily revamp the product to make it more user friendly.
First off the zipper for the space to insert the vibration button / battery pack sticks out quite a bit which may not work too well for some folks for a few different reasons (such as getting poked by the zipper while laying on it). My suggestion is to put an extra flap of fabric over it and seal it with velcro that way it's still accessible but also easily hidden.
Another design issue is how the vibration button fits into the pillow itself. The vibration button is about the size of my fist (width wise) and it just slides in and out of the pocket that's in the pillow. The pocket is fairly large. When the button is in the pillow it slides around A LOT which makes it so you have to move the pillow around and kind of go "fishing for The Sweet spot" to make it vibrate. Also you have to hold the button down to keep it vibrating which may not be very easy for some. My suggestion would be to make the pocket smaller for the vibration button so it's a little more secure and to put little Switch on the vibration button to either vibrate when it is squeezed or have the option to flip a switch and have it continuously vibrate, you could even put a 5 minute 10 minute etc time option on the switch.
Other than that it's a great idea.
One of my kids doesn't seem to mind having to search for The Sweet spot to make it vibrate but my older kid with autism (who I got the pillow for to begin with) lost interest pretty quickly because he couldn't keep hugging it tight enough or just right to make it vibrate the whole time with the vibration button sliding around in it.
It looks like this seller has a lot of interesting sensory gadgets so I will be exploring those other options very soon.

title: Good Shaker Cups will Last with Some Extra Care
text:
Got this in the mail and everything seems good. I don't mind that it's non insulated. it's sturdy enough and easy to use, nice design and colors. I cleaned them out before use. One will be for home, and the other for the gym. I tested them out already, and there are no issues. For the people that experience leaking, if you tighten it too much or the seal is out of place, it may leak as with any other rubber/silicone seals.

I hope to have these with me for years from now. I had a plastic GFUEL shaker, and the top flip spout started breaking apart. I'm hoping that these will last much longer. Also, with stainless steel, it still can collect scent, and stains- it's resistant, but not completely stainless, so the best thing to do is soak with a full cup of vinegar and 1/2 cup baking soda mix, and fill the rest with water. Add a little, few drops, of Dawn or other good dish soap if possible. Soak for full 24 hours every month to cut down on smell. You don't need to use hot water, either.

I usually try to keep away from hot liquids in shaker cups, as any plastic parts may expand and contract, warp and may not fit with the rest of the materials. Also, when you're using these, it's best to put the liquid in first and then the powder, as it may stick to the bottom if you do it the other way round.

Other good care that I do with these is wash them out after every use, or once a day at least if used multiple times a day. Taking the ring out to wash underneath at least weekly is important, as well. Once anything grows under there, it's easy to forget and it can grow black mold. Then you've hit a roadblock.

title: No more soggy clothing!  NO nasty chemical smells.
text:
My youngest loves to have "picnic lunches". Due to his allergies and severe asthma, we have been forced to take a sheet to sit on. All of the plastic backed, water resistant mats we have found have toxic chemicals in them. This of course means that many times we have finished eating and had damp clothing. This outdoor picnic mat was listed as being non-chlorinated and made with a PVC-free formula. I ordered and waited for delivery with fingers crossed. that it was as good as described. And it was!

When this outdoor picnic mat arrived, the first thing I checked for was chemical smells. I could not smell anything! Next I opened the mat and was surprised at how large it was. At nearly 6 feet long, this picnic blanket/mat is large enough to an entire family to enjoy a meal outside together. I also found a flat blow up pillow that was tucked neatly into the folded mat. I took this outside early to see how well it would hold up to a damp ground. I walked over most of it and left it outside for over an hour. I brought it back in before the sun could cry up anything. The fabric side was completely dry! The "plastic" side was visibly wet. I hung it up on the clothes line and it dried in no time. The next test was how well this would fold back up. A few accordion type folds, and then a few flips, and the velcro matched up and it was secure to carry! Photo #3 shows the picnic mat folded back up after we used it to sit under the stars last night!

Okay, so the final test was how well my son liked this. I surprised this weekend with a picnic lunch in the front yard. He was super excited and absolutely loves this picnic blanket as much as I do! We will be having regular picnics in our future!

I would highly recommend this for those who deal with allergies and/or asthma. Or if you are simply trying to avoid exposure to toxic chemicals. The quality of this blanket can not be shown well in the pictures. The "plastic" backing is much more durable then what I expected. And the fabric side is smooth and soft. If you are not a picnic person, this would be a perfect "beach blanket" as well!

I purchased this at a discount in exchange for an honest review of the product. I am selective in what I review, and I will always give an honest opinion.

title: Look elsewhere; safer options for keeping your toilet bowl clean and smelling fresh.
text:
I purchased these out of a desire to help keep my toilet clean and smelling fresh.

At first glance I was pleased with the product since it’s pretty much the only one that could promise it would not decay the internal workings of the toilet plumbing, plus I’m a fan of pine scent and colored water helps me keep track of when it needs replaced.

I was not overly wowed by the pine scent, it was very subtle and seemed to fade quickly. Likewise the color was faint from the get go but still was noticeable without too much scrutiny.

My biggest issue with these toilet cleaning tablets was that even with proper placement, they were still swallowed up rather quickly which considering their size is relatively alarming. The first tablet lasted about two weeks before I noticed the color was completely gone so I checked the tank and saw it was gone without a trace! Scared me as I was worried about causing plumbing issues that I’d have to pay for ultimately. Didn’t seem to cause the toilet to malfunction so I tried adding a second tablet after about a week. Sadly this one did not even get through a week without also being sucked down the tank’s pipe and now I’m too concerned to try using this product any longer.

I followed the directions and places far from the pipe outlet while the water was at a low level and waited a few hours before flushing for the first time during both applications. Tablet seemed to adhere to the tank, but eventually got sucked down. Also, I don’t have a special high flow toilet or anything, just a standard one.

I would not recommend purchasing and would instead suggest a cleaning gel like scrubbing bubbles to stick inside the toilet under the rim as a method to help keep the bowl clean and smelling fresh.

*I was not offered any incentive for submitting this review*

title: Helps this side-sleeper reduce shoulder pain
text:
Because I am a side-sleeper, I sometimes develop shoulder pain. To take some weight off my shoulder, I place a wedge pillow under my torso and a regular pillow under my head. If I am sleeping on, say, my right side, I place my upper right arm with a Pillow Aid down into a gap between the two pillows. By lifting up my upper body (but not my arm), the wedge pillow takes some of the weight off my arm. The Pillow Aid serves to anchor my upper arm in position. The rest of my body and my head can move, but my upper arm is sort of locked in place. Also, the Pillow Aid optionally makes it possible to rest my head on my arm which is not only comfortable, but also the weight of my head pushes my arm slightly further down, which takes even more weight off of it. The wedge pillow has the added benefits of reducing acid reflux and snoring. It's a great arrangement.
The Pillow Aid also packs well. Since you can stuff it full of underwear it actually can save you space in your baggage.

title: It's not 100% no slip solution but worth a try.
text:
Works pretty good and its better than nothing. I have a really nice pair of Oakley Tailspin thick black frame glasses that I got 2 years ago and can barely wear them b/c the constantly would slide down my nose at the slightest bit of sweat... I live in TX. There are no nose pads and its just a little bump in the frame for them to rest on my nose unlike my previous pair of Oakley wire frames with the traditional nose pads. Both pair of glasses have the frames where they just go straight back over the ear and not bent down any to stay on my face.

I have used the Nerdwax for both sets of my Oakley glasses, sunglasses and it works pretty good. It's not 100% no slip solution as they still slide down my face but its a lot less noticeable than it was before and my black pair I can actually wear all day now. As long as I am not really hot and sweating it works great otherwise I have to keep reapplying every 30 minutes or so. There isn't much room between the nose pads on either set of glasses to apply the chapstick sized tube so I used the side of the stick to rub it on. It works best if you are very liberal with the wax until you know what works and doesn't work for you. Be mindful of the temperature out b/c if its hot use more. Pay attention to the instructions and clean your glasses first before you apply the wax or you won't get the desired results. TIP: I have also found that it works pretty good to apply it directly to your nose but get a wet wipe or alcohol swab and wipe your nose down before you apply it to your skin. I will apply the wax to both the frames nose pads AND my nose.

title: Probably invalidated warranty,  but so worth it
text:
I have a large, semi active bone tumor in my left hip, a metastases of multiple myeloma. When it gets to throbbing, only thing that breaks the cycle is a soak in a hot bath. But, the hip gets sore sitting on the hard tub surface.

Enter the wondergel seat cushion. It is soft to sit on, cradles the bum hip really well. I use it in the tub, which according to the limited warranty, the water invalidates the warranty. I am not concerned.

The cushion is kind of heavy when opening the package. In the water, it floats. I have to find a towel to wrap it in. If I soak to long, my toes are prunes, and my butt has a grid pattern.

The piece dries very fast. I always rinse after a bubble bath so soap doesnt stay on it to weaken it.

I have also found it makes a decent substitute pillow. Wrap in a pillow case and its fabulous.

Update - been using this cushion now for six months, almost daily to soak in a hot bath. There has been zero degradation in the gel. It did absorb the perfume from bubble bath, so has a nice floral scent now.

title: Lightweight, quiet and works well
text:
I've been using Braun electric toothbrushes with reciprocating/rotating brush heads for several years and have been happy with the results, but I had heard that the Sonic type often rated better. After using this unit, I'm thinking that alternating between the two might be the ideal solution.

In terms of this specific brand, I was impressed with its ease of handling, light weight, and quiet operation. It is effortless to hold and its four 30-second cycles encourage you to brush the full two minutes that dentists recommend. After using the reciprocating type brushes, the vibrating brush seemed a bit odd at first, but I quickly got used to it and even enjoyed the sensation. It would seem to be an ideal candidate for a travel.

On the slightly negative side, the packaging is unimpressive, the directions are a bit confusing, the light weight could suggest fragility, and there is a question about availability of compatible brush heads in the future. Since it doesn't come with a base, brush cover or carrying case, there is an issue of what to do with it when not brushing. I defaulted to laying it flat on a washcloth. I see no particular reason for six cycles, as I expect most folks will almost always use it at setting number one. Since the vendor has chosen to provide two complete brush sets in an order, it would seem that they intended for two different people to use them. In that case, you would expect them to come in different colors.

text:
I was thrilled when I got the chance to try this product for a discount in exchange for my review.. I received my diffuser on time and the packaging was first class. The box it arrived In is pretty enough to gift it in. When it arrived I was so anxious to use it. It is beautiful! I loved the weight of it. My plastic diffusers also put out a LOT more mist than this one. I used the replacement four times in my living room. It is open into the kitchen, but a small room. My other diffusers have no problem filling that room with fragrance. I use Plant Therapy oils and have a few from Apalachian Valley. I resorted to using a few more drops than normal and had very little difference. I placed it in my spare bathroom thinking it would do well in there and I'm still not impressed. For the price of this diffuser this thing should really put out a lot of fragrance and it doesn't. I'm sorry. I really wanted to love this product. It is beautiful.

title: Small Removal Tips  = Large Potential for a Trip to Urgent Care
text:
My friends formed an alternative rock group a few years ago, and after several of their concerts, at the end of the night, I was left with an angry, persistent ringing in my ears. As a safety precaution, I purchased these DownBeats Concert Earplugs, expecting to use them at a very cramped concert venue with very huge amps.

Unfortunately, due to work, I was unable to attend their most recent concert. But since I had the earplugs already, I figured I'd check their fit and quality.(Just to give any potential customers some background, I typically wear the standard buds that come with most noise-canceling earphones, and they fit perfectly. In addition, my fingers aren't enormous. Compared to most guys, my hands look smaller than average.)

In retrospect, I am so relieved that I did not try these out at the concert. As I inserted them into my ear, I found the plastic tips for inserting and removing the plugs very difficult to grab. Then, I tried to remove the plug from my right ear by "using my phalanges to gently stretch my ear canal opening to dislodge the seal" as specified on the instruction insert. I thought the removal tip was difficult to hold when the plug was out of my ear. That was NOTHING compared to what it was like once the plug lodged itself more deeply into my ear canal! It took 10 minutes and a combination of tweezers, the handle end of a cuticle pusher, and swearing in three languages before I triumphantly removed the offending nub of silicone and plastic!

Given the sterling reviews offered up by other customers, I'm willing to concede that it's possible that my ear canals may be larger than average or that the tips on the pair I received may have been incorrectly manufactured. However, after this experience, I CANNOT RECOMMEND these earplugs. That being said, the customer service representative who assisted with my return was gracious and expedient despite the fact that the ear plugs had been used, and the sturdy and attractive aluminum case would have been perfect had the product itself not been so flawed.

title: my skin is much better now. I have stopped using powerful prescribed medication ...
text: I am someone who has suffered from severe acne throughout my teenage years. I have tried every product you can find within your local pharmacies but nothing really worked. I even went to my dermatologist for prescribed medicine, and it did yield positive results but not without consequences. The prescribed medicine while it cleared up my skin, it left me with burnt skin and made skin peel overtime. I was left with dark spots all over and dry irritated skin which was bright red. Fast forward 4 years to my current state, my skin is much better now. I have stopped using powerful prescribed medication and my skin has healed tremendously from using moisturizer and sunscreen on a daily basis. However the problem is every few weeks I will go through a mini breakout where I experience several large pimples. With my current products the problem seems to be persistent. When this manufacturer reached out to me I thought to myself what do I have to lose, and I was curious to figure out if this would help me resolve my problem of occasional breakouts. I am glad to say while it may not have completely stopped by breakouts, it did however reduce the number of pimples I have experienced drastically. However there are a few kickbacks. I absolutely dislike the fragrance of this product. It has a very soft floral scent, however it is very strong. For a man such as myself, it is sort of awkward to walk around and wreak of a flowery scent. Also, the product is very strong. My initial impression was that it was burning my skin but it wasn't really. It does dry up your skin so I suggest that you start with one application before going to sleep (make sure to apply moisturizer after applying this product) and then progress to using it twice a week as your skin adjusts to it. Overall it is a very good product with a few kickbacks which aren't major issues, but they were bothersome enough for me to mention within the review.

You charge it with the charger provided or with an Android phone charger type. Then you press the middle button and the lights will light up showing you the intensity of the current. Because the directions are in a foreign language - I am assuming the intensity goes from left to right.

IF YOU PURCHASED THIS ITEM AND PUT IT DIRECTLY ON YOUR FACE WITHOUT A CONDUCTIVE GEL...YES YOU WON'T FEEL ANYTHING OR HAVE ANY RESULTS. You have to use something on your face to help conduct the current (I use Spectra Electrode Gel). You can also use something as simple as Aloe vera gel. Putting this on your face before starting the treatment also allows for the device to glide across your face seamlessly. It periodically beeps to let you know to move on to another area of your face and then shuts down *possibly* after a 3 min treatment. I looked up the Nuface face diagram treatment areas and went off that.

This is great and I have only used this for 2 weeks and I felt like my cheeks looked more sculpted. I have not used it consistently enough to have a picture to show but I plan to update this review in 2 months with my thoughts!!! I would suggest this to anyone on the fence about purchasing the Nuface....I would try out this one first to see if you can commit before buying the real deal. This might even be the same for less!!! title: A Percentage Of The Power Use, Better Light, And Easier Reading
text:
When I moved our household to Verilux lighting my 'beloved' was initially unhappy. She found the light too bright, too wide in the spectrum department, and visually hard to handle. That was the initial reaction.

Three or four days later she didn't notice it anymore--and in the coming month we'd go somewhere that had halogen or incandescent or (much worse) WARM CFL's that flickered and she hated the way it made her clothing colors looked, and made food look, and generally the way in which it behaved with the environs.

The kicker was that as soon as she saw our power bill drop by 21 percent as a result of changing the light bulbs, she hasn't looked back.

I personally love them for cooking, reading, and living around the household--in the dead of winter it is sunny and nice indoors.

I couldn't ask for a better product... and more? We had a few fail early on... and Verilux replaced them on the spot. That is good customer service.
Customer service that ranks with L.L. Bean, Craftsman, and so on--is wonderful by me.

Thank you Verilux!!!
I am a very happy customer and just got some for my sister as gifts.

title: Finally, all the lamps in our household are Verilux
text:
Over a three year period, we've migrated all the various lamps in the house to Verilux. They are not only incredibly cost effective--but once you get used to having full spectrum lighting around the home--you'll never go back.
These lamps don't have the harsh glow of the cool white CCFL or the soft yellow of the other brands. I can't stand florescent lights, and stuck with regular bulbs until we found these babies from Verilux. They don't flicker and your meals don't look odd (look at a fresh, hot roast under florescent bulbs... ICK!)

They show everything in perfect color accuracy whether it is your face in the mirror, your clothing, the food on your table--or just a page in a book--as they are perfect for reading as well.

We've gone from nearly 10K watts of bulbs (previously using daylight incandescent bulbs) to just less than a thousand watts of bulbs overall. [Not that anyone has the whole household lit at the same time--but you get the picture.]

Now if videocards would go in that direction so we weren't buying Kilowatt Power Supplies for computers. ;-)

Great product. Great feel to the lighting. Even my beloved who disliked the look and feel initially, loves it now--and swears that it is not Stockholm Syndrome--but instead seeing things in their proper color. Go Verilux! Go Vermont!

title: Sending it back
text:
Yeah. I usually look at reviews before I dive in to hundred dollar purchases...but because I have been using the Fitbit Flex, with no problems at all, I thought the company was good to go. I don't think so. Like so many users before me, I was unable to set up my scale successfully...but my problem seems different. I have never gotten an error message. I was able to get my weight every time, and it even posted a weight to fitbit! MY problem is that after setting it all up (presumably properly), 10 minutes later I will walk by my scale and it is lit up saying "setup active"...and at that point if I step on it, I will get my weight, but only as a guest. After HOURS of this setting up and re-setting up using the software, using the web on my computer, using the web on my phone, I THOUGHT I had it finally right because it gave me my actual initials when I weighed myself. BUT NO. Later in the evening again it mysteriously came on with the "setup active" scrolling again. I really just wanted a wifi scale to use with trendweight so that I wouldn't be so frustrated with my fluctuations, but this is SO not worth the time and effort. I can just as easily plot my trend myself on my old, crappy scale.
PS: I do not appreciate the user that said that we are all stupid and that's why we can't set our scale up. Maybe if it was one review out of 100 I would agree that it was user error, but all these reviews are the same regardless of tech savvyness.

title: Love it!  Get painless exercise while watching TV.
text:
I bought this to use at the office under my desk.
But then I had knee surgery so I used it mainly at home for rehabilitation.

Now I use it for exercise while I'm watching TV. I just leave it in front of my viewing chair so whenever I sit down my feet end up on it and next thing you know I'm pedaling without even thinking about it. I can easily do 45 minutes while watching a show on tivo and it's painless.

Others have commented that the unit will slide across the floor, and that's true it does slide a little bit gradually as you use it, but that's not a product defect as I see it. Other than using glue or screws, it is unreasonable to expect that any device resting on the floor isn't going to slide as you apply a large lateral force to it with your legs. However, fixing this is TRIVIAL! Just get a couple 4-6 foot lengths of rope, strap, or something similar and loop one around each side of the rear bar on the unit. Loop the other ends around your chair leg(s) and the unit won't go anywhere. This has worked like a charm for me and takes 10 seconds to put on or take off.

UPDATED: Well, I pedaled this thing to death, literally. The pedals started grinding and slipping after about 6 months of nearly daily usage for about 20 minutes each. I opened it up and there are two gears that form the main mechanism. The teeth on the smaller gear had been rounded down until they no longer interlocked with the larger gear. Had to trash it. Maybe I should've splurged for the magnetic version.

title: This sunscreen is the best!
text: I found this sunscreen in the summer of 2015 after my very light skinned son kept on getting nearly sunburned with any sunscreen I tried on him.  I have 3 children, and he is the one with the most sensitive skin.  Any other sunscreen I used worked just fine for my other 2 kids, but not for my oldest. I have since found a few sunscreens that work on him and they are all the mineral based sunscreens with a high zinc oxide content. We live near Phoenix, AZ, and are at the pool 4 days a week during the summer, so finding something that protects their skin is VERY important.  I only use mineral sunscreens on my children now as I have learned that they are much safer.  This sunscreen is our favorite!  My kids will happily let me put the 'chocolate sunscreen' on them, but complain when we use any other one (sometimes we run out of this one).  All 4 of us love the smell of this sunscreen.  All of my children have very light skin complexions, and this sunscreen doesn't leave the dreaded white cast that is so familiar with mineral sunscreens. It blends in very well and is really moisturizing for their skin. They still get dry skin from the chlorine in the pool, but I think this sunscreen helps a bit.  The hardest part about using this sunscreen is that I have a hard time not eating them all up once they are slathered in this stuff ;-)

title: I am not a Germaphobe but I love the Bidet
text:
I am not a germaphobe. I am regularly doused with the bodily fluids of my patients. That being said, after 20 years of using a bidet (butt sink) I can't really believe that America is still addicted to toilet paper. Think about it, you keep wiping with TP until you can't see any more brown and that means your clean? Can you imagine applying that same logic to washing hands? Or if you stepped on a dog's land mine while walking barefoot in the park? The whole idea is gross, but if it's your butt I guess smelly and dirty is ok. This product and others like it actually use water to spray you clean. It is wonderful, being clean. No itching, smelling, or skidmarks in your boxers. Clean, Clean, clean just like a shower.
I have had the GoBidet in my bathroom for 4 years now. It is a great unit for existing homes because most homes don't leave room for a stand alone bidet. This little unit converts your toilet to a Bidet. With a handy pull of a lever the spray arm swings out from its hiding place under the toilet rim like a James Bond Gadget. The spray head is aimed at the bulls eye. You pull a second lever that controls the strength of the spray. It goes from gentle to colonic geyser. After your done, you pat dry with some toilet paper. All done.
The neat thing about this product is you can install it in about 15 minutes usng your existing toilet seat. It uses the water supply that fills the tank on the toilet. It can be plumbed for hot as well as cold water as well. The hot water installation looked a little more complex, so I thought I would see how it worked with just cold. I actually don't mind the cold water, it feels wonderfully refreshing. I would recommend this product to every one. Lets quit chopping down forests for our ultrasoft TP and actually get clean for a change.

title: Ted's has changed my life.
text:
I have written about Ted's pain gel before. I use it for neuropathic pain. I had a number of wounds that didn't heal properly and developed inclusion cysts, tiny pockets of nerves and vascular tissue that were exquisitely sensitive to friction and or pressure that caused me intractable pain for many years. The only relief I could find was lidocaine, but of course there was the downside of total numbness.

I have been using Ted's for about 3 years and my life is entirely changed. My activities had largely been ruled by pain avoidance. My pain is not entirely gone at all times, but pain does not ruin my life and I can pretty much do whatever I want. I attribute this entirely to the use of Ted's pain gel.

By the way, most doctors have no idea that Ted's exists. So, I always take the roll on bottle of Ted's pain gel with me and I ask them if they have heard about it. Not one single doctor has said yes. And I tell them my story. Most of them have forgotten about it by the next visit, but I always take my Ted's and I always retell my story.

title: (Almost) Exactly What I Needed
text:
I don't know about you guys, but finding a comfortable chair at a coffee shop to sit on for a couple of hours is more difficult than it appears. Especially for someone like me who...ahem...doesn't have much built-in cushion.

I've heard of the Purple brand before and saw commercials for them. As usual, I read into the comments here on Amazon to see what other people said about the product. I am one of those consumers that are willing to spend more for a quality product.

The product itself is as advertised as far as the comfort. Almost any surface you place this cushion becomes 10x more comfortable. I have not had the cushion collapse and not bounce back into shape. For reference, I'm 5'2" and 140lbs.

I also appreciate that it comes with a washable 'pillow-case' so I can sanitize it as needed. One side of the cloth case also has a rubber-like texture which helps anchor the cushion to whatever surface you place it on. No slip and sliding for this!

My only one-star deduction is that it's not the MOST portable. Though the exterior sleeve does have handles on two sides, the cushion tends to flop around when holding one. It doesn't seem to be advisable to fold it in half to make it smaller. I have to transport in in a large tote bag or backpack. I think this is the main reason I've also misplaced and lost it at least once. I've yet to figure out how best to bring this cushion around.

title: Looks promising (upon arrival)... Looks beautiful (day after use)... Lasts (tbd)
text:
Arrived earlier than expected and as very nicely presented with packaging and even a carry case; however, no instructions at all were included.

Excited to try this, but now need to google how to use these different bottles.

Update April 7, 2017 - Changed rating from 3 stars to 4 because LOVE THIS but no instructions. I found a good step by step at prettyfulz.blogspot.com and just assumed each treatment correlated to the bottles in ABC order. I did my own lashes but would not recommend it unless you are great with detail and can "poke around" your own eyeballs.

My guess is this is these items were bought in bulk and resold as this kit. I got mine in the mail on the 5th although it wasn't expected until the 15th, so, yay for free shipping. I found a good tutorial online (step by step with pics, not video) and did my own lashes the same day I received the kit, after my son went to bed. I used the largest rod of the 3 sizes because I read somewhere that the small rod size made the lashes too kinked.

The rod is very sticky. I found it somewhat difficult to apply in that it would stay stuck to my finger when trying to place on my eyelid. Threw away the first rod of my attempt as it stuck too far away from my lid line, stuck to my finger and pulled off my lid (ouch!) and after repeating this torture, I felt I had removed the best stickiness in my novice process. So, with as little contact as possible by holding the tiniest bit of one end with the tweezers and other with my finger/thumb, I bent the rod with snake-like movements to make to more flexible and to better lie across my eyelid. I still had to reposition it a few times and un-stick my lid from it, but I got it where I wanted.

My steps are pictured, but I only included some from my process because I didn't want to bore my friends with tons of eyeball pictures. I began with one eye and when I got to the waiting 10-15 minutes for the perm treatment, I prepared the second rod, applied it to my lid, and put on that eye's perm treatment. I still had to wait several minutes with both eyes pretty much "glued open" but it wasn't difficult for me. Of my circle of friends, I honestly cannot imagine any of them doing this to herself, maybe one of them. If I could get someone to apply the rods for me, I'm certain I could relax my eyes to a closed position. But I don't trust any of them with this delicate process! LOL

So far, I love love love the results! The "day after" look is more "fluffed" and excitingly beautiful than the "same night" look. I'll update my review to say how long the perm lasts. There's plenty of product to repeat the process many times.

title: Performance Varies Greatly
text:
I own 7 of these ERDVDMAX battery packs. I decided to test them for longevity by running each from a full charge to complete drainage, using them to run my 9 inch Philips DVD player. I tested each battery twice, so there were 14 test runs. Results:

First Charge: Worst: 204 min. Best: 580 min. Average: 330 min. (5 H 30 M)
Second Charge: Worst: 291 min. Best: 674 min. Average: 474 min (7 H 54 M)

All batteries showed improvement on the second charge. But performance varied enormously from one battery to the next. I can see why some reviewers gave this product one star; they received under performers.

I bought 6 of my ERDVDMAX when someone on E-Bay was selling them for $20 each, which I still consider a pretty good deal (but no longer available).

Prices on Amazon change daily. But as I write now, this item costs $39.15 (incl. shipping). Not such a great deal. Also as I write, you can get the Lenmar DVDU923 battery pack for $40.94 (free shipping) which is smaller, lighter, more powerful, and more consistent. To date, 8 test runs on my 4 Lenmars average out to 565 min (9 H 25 M). The worst performance was 428 min; the best 630 min.

[[ASIN:B0011MZORU Lenmar DVDU923 Universal Li-Ion Battery for Select Portable DVD Players]]

The low is high air but cooler air, medium is low air and hot, the high is high air and hot. I just wish this had come with a glove being I can't grab my hair and I lost my glove. But either way this is great. I don't need a brush to help me with this one. I had to have a brush with my other one as it would pull my hair. This one doesn't at all. I hope I get more years out of this one being my daughter uses it also and it gets used. My other one lasted about 3 years. Hopefully this one will last much longer. I would totally recommend it to anyone. Yes it's big but worth it. I took a chance being it was only 18.99 when I purchased it and I paid almost 30 for my other one. Well worth the money!

title: Great BCAA, Okay Shaker Bottle
text:
I received both the shaker bottle and the BCAA powder with my order. The bottle itself is of decent quality. There are some minor blemishes on some of the rubber padding on the bottle, but that isn't that big of a deal to me. Similar to other customers, I also experienced some leakage when using this bottle. A little annoying to have to work around something like this when that is the main function of the bottle, but it is possible to use without making that big of a mess. That being said, the size of the bottle is great, and the fact that you can store your protein/other powders in the removable container on the bottom of the bottle is a very nice feature for people who are on the go a lot but still need to get their supplements in.

The BCAA powder definitely isn't "flavorless" in the true sense of the word. The flavor was a little medicine tasting, but isn't the most unpleasant thing you will ever taste or anything like that. Mixed with other flavored drinks or juices, this powder is hardly noticeable. The amount of BCAAs you get with this product is very nice compared to a lot of other products out there, so you can expect to feel a lot better after workouts and be that much more ready for your workout the next day. BCAA supplements are a must have for anyone who is serious about hitting the gym hard and often, so I would definitely recommend picking up this supplement to help you with that journey.

Overall, I would definitely recommend picking up the BCAA powder from this company. Even though the taste isn't very pleasant, it will help you get the results you are looking for by helping you push yourself harder and recover faster. I don't think I can recommend the shaker bottle in this package however, simply due to the fact that I have plenty of other bottles that function much better without any leakage.

title: Weight Loss: YES!
text:
I used Okinawa Flat Belly Tonic, along with sensible eating (i.e., not an entire pizza or box of doughnuts at a time!), to start my 90 lb weight loss goal. In 3 weeks, I've lost over 10 lbs.
There are some caveats to this. 1) My husband locks all the food compartments in our house before he goes to bed. This is my normal binge time. So I have lost weight just through that difficult experience. 2) I fight several thyroid diseases, so I expected to lose much LESS weight than I did. In fact, my PCP said that he thought I would average losing 1 lb a MONTH. 4) I have a pretty good idea of what is not good for me, and WHEN it's not good for me, so I do tend to eat more mindfully. I don't deny any food. But if I have a carbohydrate, I immediately follow it by eating a piece of cheese or other protein. That seems to keep my blood sugar numbers down. Yes, I'm also diabetic. 5) Okinawa Flat Belly Tonic makes me have (sorry to say it aloud!) more frequent bowel movements. I think that also helps with weight loss.
Every person is different, so I can't say if it will work for you. But, taking 2 capsules each a.m. has helped me. Good luck, you can do it!

title: Updated Review: Not recommended...
text: Update: I changed my rating to 1/5 stars. I wasn't expecting these sheets to do any real cleaning, I just wanted them to freshen up a couple of tops that don't need a full cleaning after every wear. After trying to clean one lightweight, stain-free, lightly worn sweater with one of these sheets (EXACTLY according to package directions), I realized they do nothing - absolutely nothing! They *temporarily* freshen up your clothing by depositing fragrance, but within a few hours, the Woolite smell fades...and it's like you never did anything to clean/freshen the garment at all. I had a perfume smell on one of my shirt sleeves that I didn't like, and the Woolite sheet didn't even neutralize that - much less minimize the usual deodorant/BO smell or remove deodorant streaks from the inside of the sweater. I thought my garment was at least clean *smelling,* but after a few hours on the hanger, it smelled just as worn as before I used the Woolite sheet. You can achieve the same result by putting your clothes in the dryer (if they won't shrink) and tumbling with a regular old fabric softener sheet, or by hanging them up over a steaming hot bath tub.

title: It smells SO bad!!! -- UPDATED
text:
Oh. My. GOSH--this stuff smells SO bad!!! It smells like vomit! Maybe even worse! Holy cow!!!!! Plus it's sticky and makes wrinkles I don't have stand out on my face.

I have read some amazing reviews of this substance, but I haven't read anything about how bad it smells. Whew! So if/when I notice anything different about my skin, I'll update this review. And maybe I'll learn to live with the smell.

04/17 -- As promised.here's an update: I have used the product a total of THREE times and I can see a difference in the clarity and tone of my skin--and I had good skin to start with. I have been holding my nose when I use it and mixing it with a moisturizer that has a pretty strong fragrance. The smell is still beyond belief, but if my skin looks this good after just a day and a half, I may need to get over myself.

05/28 -- Second update: It has been pointed out to me that it smells like Parmesan cheese. OK--that may explain why I dislike the smell so much. Anyway--it doesn't smell any better to me after more than a month BUT I am sold on the product. It has removed dark spots and the odd blemish. I use WAY less than it suggests and that may be the key here. I use ONE teeny, tiny drop on specific areas of concern and rub it in really well. I then just add a couple of larger drops to the moisturizer I use and put it all over my face. I will never get to the point where I can use 10-12 drops. I'd keel over from the odor. I've upgraded my star count to four--we'll see if I can get it to five.

Just know that it's REALLY sticky and it kind of makes a lather when you rub in it. Weird stuff--but pretty amazing.

title: Some Benefits, Some Difficulties
text:
I purchased these orthotics from a high end comfort shoe store near Washington, DC and expected to find them selling for quite a bit less on Amazon. Instead, that high rent store sold them for the same amount as they are offered here ($69.95). I think that's a rather high price for mass produced insoles----but that said, used in the right application, these things are very nice, very comfortable.
I have wide, flat feet----no arch to speak of. These orthotics offer noticeable arch support and are said to align the foot to take pressure off ankles, feet, possibly even knees and hips depending on your individual situation. I've had very bad luck with television infommercial orthotics in the past----actually caused a significant knee injury that took weeks to heel and of course, I pitched those. That same knee had a tingle of looseness the first full day I wore these----but it passed and since then, no issues and lots of comfort----and I wake up the next day without the normal heel pain I've had in the past. These seem to be doing something right----comfort and possibly taking pressure off my feet. It's still early (have had them under two weeks) but I'm encouraged----guardedly optimistic. That's the good. The bad is that unless you have some extra room in your shoes, these might take up too much space and make your shoes/sneakers too tight. They might elevate your foot to the point where your heel slips out of your shoe as you walk----if they are low back shoes. This is a substantial insole. If your shoes "just fit" and there is no removable insole in them----these won't work. They will make your shoes too tight to wear. If you have a removeble insole----it's possible this can replace it and leave you enough room for comfort----but also possible this will be slightly larger/thicker and you'll have the tightness issue. I've found that for some of my roomier but uncomfortable shoes (like a pair of Puma sneakers), these are wonderful---they make shoes far more comfortable. But for tighter shoes I have (like a pair of Hippopotamus casuals) these insoles take up way too much space and they made that pair unwearable. It's case by case. I suppose if you really like these, you can bring them when you buy a new pair of shoes and put them in before buying. What I am very curious to find out is how long they will last. The salesman told me that if I remove them from the shoes daily and let them air out, they can go a couple years. If that's true, they're probably a good investment.

text:
This scale is a great concept. Unfortunately, the actual user experience is far from perfect. First and foremost - scale is simply not accurate. Now the body fat: it is complete joke. It seems to give a random reading every time, with difference 3-4%
Finally, syncing with multiple accounts doesn't work correctly either - sometimes it syncs my weight with my wife's account and vice versa (even though weight difference between us is 55 lbs).

So the bottom line is:

The good:
- syncs with your Fitbit account
- looks good

The bad:
- extremely inaccurate and inconsistent
- body fat measurement is joke
- syncing with multiple accounts doesn't work correctly sometimes
